items.summary: Who We AreSpread Group is a renowned global provider of customized apparel and lifestyle products, distinguished by our commitment to made-to-order technology.
items.description: Who We Are Spread Group is a renowned global provider of customized apparel and lifestyle products, distinguished by our commitment to made-to-order technology. Our core business model revolves around producing precisely what our customers desire, precisely when they desire it. As pioneers in this space, we combine sustainability with on-demand personalization, enabling individuals and businesses to express their unique identities through bespoke creations. Join us to be part of a global leader in the exciting world of personalized apparel and lifestyle products! As we continue to expand our business, we are seeking a curious and passionate individual to join our team as the (Senior) Web Analyst (f/m/d) and drive our business forward. What Will Your Role Be We're looking for a Senior Web Analyst to own and evolve our digital measurement ecosystem. You'll help us understand how millions of users interact with our digital products and turn that understanding into better product and business decisions.You'll work at the intersection of Product, Marketing and Engineering, ensuring that our tracking is accurate, scalable and future-proof. From defining measurement strategies to implementing tracking solutions and uncovering actionable insights, you'll play a key role in improving our digital products and customer experience. This is not a generic Data Analytics or Data Science role. We're looking for someone with a strong background in Web Analytics, Digital Analytics, Marketing Analytics or Product Analytics who enjoys solving real business problems through reliable data. What You´ll Do Own Digital Measurement Own and continuously improve our digital measurement landscape across multiple digital products. Design, implement and optimise client-side and server-side tracking solutions. Ensure accurate, scalable and privacy-compliant data collection. Drive Measurement Strategy Translate business questions into measurement concepts and technical tracking requirements. Define KPIs and success metrics together with Product, Marketing and business stakeholders. Develop tracking specifications for new products, features and customer journeys. Generate Insights Analyse user behaviour, customer journeys and conversion funnels. Build dashboards and reporting solutions that enable data-informed decision making. Identify optimisation opportunities and provide actionable recommendations. Experiment and Optimise Design, implement and evaluate A/B tests and experimentation initiatives. Measure the impact of new features, campaigns and product improvements. Continuously improve tracking quality, measurement standards and analytics processes. Collaborate Across Teams Work closely with Product Managers, Engineers and Marketing teams. Present analytical findings in a clear and actionable way to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Help establish analytics best practices across the organisation. What You´ll Bring Several years of experience in Web Analytics, Digital Analytics, Marketing Analytics or Product Analytics. Hands-on experience with modern tracking implementations and digital measurement architectures. Practical experience with tag management systems such as Adobe Experience Platform Tags or Google Tag Manager. Experience with Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics 4 or comparable enterprise analytics platforms. Solid knowledge of JavaScript and experience with SQL and/or Python. Experience with client-side and server-side tracking. Strong analytical thinking combined with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset. A solid understanding of data quality, tracking validation and analytics governance. Confidence working independently while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. Excellent written and spoken English. Nice to Have Experience with Product Analytics platforms. Experience with Looker Studio, Power BI or Tableau. Experience with BigQuery, Snowflake or similar cloud data environments. Experience with experimentation platforms. Knowledge of privacy regulations and consent management. Experience in e-commerce or digital consumer products. Why Should You Join Us Autonomy and Impact: We believe in giving people real ownership. You'll have the freedom to make decisions, take action, and see the direct impact of your work on the business. Development and Growth: We believe that the greatest professional and personal growth happens when you're challenged. If you're looking to build your career, you'll find plenty of opportunities to do so. We Win as a Team: Work alongside ambitious, motivated colleagues who challenge and support each other to achieve exceptional results. Through honest feedback, high standards, and shared ambition, we bring out the best in one another. Learn from Proven Entrepreneurs: Work closely with experienced founders and business leaders, gaining first-hand insights into growing a successful international company. Transparency and Involvement: Stay connected to our vision through regular General Assemblies, learn about our processes in our production sites in the Czech Republic and join workshops and cross function initiatives to lead positive change. The Extras That Matter: Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation, attractive employee discounts on our products and partner brands, modern office spaces designed for collaboration, and regular company events where we celebrate our successes together. Equal Opportunity Employer We value diversity at Spread Group . We are proud of and continue to encourage the increasing diversity of our company culture and community. Your skills, talents, and experience are our focus no matter your age, ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, marital or disability status. Requirements Originally posted on Himalayas

Extraordinary teams building inspiring projects: Since 1898, we have helped customers complete more than 25,000 projects in 160 countries on all seven continents that have created jobs, grown economies, improved the resiliency of the world's infrastructure, increased access to energy, resources, and vital services, and made the world a safer, cleaner place. Differentiated by the quality of our people and our relentless drive to deliver the most successful outcomes, we align our capabilities to our customers' objectives to create a lasting positive impact. They are what we believe, what customers can expect, and how we deliver. Learn more about our extraordinary teams building inspiring projects in our Impact Report . Project Overview: The rapid growth of AI and digitalization is fueling unprecedented demand for data centers that require large, reliable sources of energy. In response to this market trend, the Renewables & Clean Power (R&CP) team has signed an early works contract to build one of the largest gas-fired power generation facilities in the U.S. Our team is helping the customer progress early-stage development, that would lead to the start of full EPC delivery in 2026. The candidate will act as the Field Systems Technician on the Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) Project in Cheyenne, Wyoming. The candidate may start in the home office in Reston-VA to support planning, ahead of project mobilization to the field, when the candidate will locate on a long-term assignment to the project in Cheyenne, Wyoming. This position is contingent upon project award. Job Summary: Reporting to the EPC Automation Lead role, the Field Tech Coordinator is responsible for the implementation, configuration and support of jobsite digital/automation applications. The successful candidate can expect to deploy a broad range of automation, innovation, and AI solutions in the field. Working under the direction of the EPC Automation Lead, this position works with the site team to help implement digital solutions - mobile applications, configurations, troubleshoot system issues, prepare dashboards, documentation, and assist with user support and training. This role contributes to the overall digital delivery strategy and ensures site teams can effectively use automation tools to drive safe and efficient execution. #LI-RM1 Major Responsibilities: Assist the EPC Automation Lead and Lead Field Tech Coordinator in the deployment and management of Bechtel Standard Applications (BSAPs) and related workflows in line with Bechtel standard work processes. Assist the EPC Automation Lead in coordinating with the Project Field Engineer, project IS&T Lead, and other automation leads (procurement and project controls, commissioning, etc.), as well as Bechtel functional leads, to support AWP processes. Audit data exchanges to and from field applications and ensure they are correctly configured to support construction & Commissioning work activities. Review any application deviations raised by the project team, evaluate their impact on other applications, data integration, and work processes, and work with the project EPC Automation Lead, Lead Field Tech Coordinator, and Construction Automation teams for verification and approval of deviations. Develop and maintain reporting solutions, including performance curves, metrics, dashboards, and trackers to drive insights and continuous improvement. Provide day-to-day operational support, including troubleshooting, issue resolution, system monitoring, and escalation of complex technical issues. Lead training, onboarding, and user support, including the development of user guides and training materials for project teams, contractors, and suppliers. Ensure contractor and supplier compliance with automation, data quality, and reporting requirements across construction workflows. Participates in the rollout of new technologies, services, and security remediations by working with the project EPC Automation Lead, GBU Innovation Manager, AI Program Manager, and BEO. Support execution planning and digital adoption, including upskilling initiatives and alignment of automation solutions with project delivery objectives. Champion innovation and digital transformation, including AI, robotics, and field data capture technologies (e.g., drones), fostering a culture of continuous improvement. Education and Experience Requirements: Bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Construction Management, or a related discipline with less than 1 year of experience or 4-5 years of relevant work experience in lieu of degree. Required Knowledge and Skills: Required Knowledge and Skills: Basic knowledge of engineering and construction methods, workflows, and capital project execution processes, including cross-functional integration across Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Project Controls, Startup, Safety, Quality, and Client teams. Experience in data analysis and management, including understanding data relationships, performing validation, identifying anomalies, and developing corrective or recovery actions. Understanding of system integration, configuration, and change management practices, including configuration control, troubleshooting, and support of construction automation systems. Familiarity with 3D modeling and construction visualization tools (e.g., Navisworks) to support planning and coordination activities. Strong problem-solving capability with a practical, hands-on, and self-directed approach, combined with adaptability to learn new tools and technologies (e.g., Power Platform, drones/GIS). Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to work effectively with field teams, contractors, and global stakeholders, build relationships, gather feedback, and drive continuous improvement. Commitment to safety, including knowledge of Bechtel's "Zero Incidents" program and a demonstrated focus on maintaining a safe and healthy work environment. Preferred Qualifications: Basic understanding of EPC automation applications and associated work processes (e.g., installed quantities, work packaging, turnover/completions, technical correspondence) and ability to articulate construction requirements across functions. Working knowledge of construction progress measurement processes (e.g., QURR) and related reporting practices. Experience in Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, and SharePoint Online) for solution development and automation. Experience with 4D planning/visualization (Synchro) and Autodesk ecosystem tools (e.g., Revit, Navisworks) to support construction sequencing and analysis. Experience with project turnover and completions processes, including data readiness and system handover requirements. Experience with SQL database administration and data management Total Rewards/Benefits: For decades, Bechtel has worked to inspire the next generation of employees and beyond! Because our teams face some of the world's toughest challenges, we offer robust benefits to ensure our people thrive. Whether it is advancing careers, delivering programs to enhance our culture, or providing time to recharge, Bechtel has the benefits to build a legacy of sustainable growth. Learn more at Bechtel Total Rewards Diverse teams build the extraordinary: As a global company, Bechtel has long been home to a vibrant multitude of nationalities, cultures, ethnicities, and life experiences. This diversity has made us a more trusted partner, more effective problem solvers and innovators, and a more attractive destination for leading talent. We are committed to being a company where every colleague feels that they belong-where colleagues feel part of "One Team," respected and rewarded for what they bring, supported in pursuing their goals, invested in our values and purpose, and treated equitably. Click here to learn more about the people who power our legacy. Working closely with the CX Director, you will help translate strategic priorities into actionable workstreams, partner with stakeholders across the organization, and ensure customer experience initiatives are effectively implemented and measured. This role is ideal for someone with strong project management, analytical, and stakeholder management skills who enjoys turning strategy into execution. workstreams Coordinate cross-functional activities to ensure successful implementation of CX recommendations Track progress against program objectives and identify risks, blockers, and dependencies items.title: Head of Data
items.summary: Are you a data-driven leader who thrives at the intersection of business and technology?
items.description: Are you a data-driven leader who thrives at the intersection of business and technology? As Head of Data at Digital Forms , you will be responsible for translating business goals into measurable outcomes. You’ll work directly with clients to understand their challenges, design actionable KPIs, and implement the data flows and dashboards needed to drive decision-making. This role combines strategic thinking, hands-on data expertise, and outstanding communication skills. You’ll be a key player in delivering high-impact digital transformation solutions for our international clients. Requirements Responsibilities Lead the company’s data strategy in alignment with business objectives and client goals. Work closely with clients to understand their business context, define success metrics, and design clear, actionable KPIs. Design and implement efficient data flows, pipelines, and architectures for business intelligence and reporting. Build and manage dashboards that support executive-level decision-making and operational optimization. Translate complex data insights into clear recommendations for non-technical stakeholders. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including tech, marketing, and sales, to deliver data-driven solutions. Identify opportunities to improve data processes, reporting, and automation internally and for clients. Requirements Hard Skills: Proven experience in designing and implementing dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Metabase, or similar. Strong understanding of data modeling, ETL processes, and modern data stacks. Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and SQL proficiency. Ability to design scalable data architectures and optimize performance across systems. Demonstrated ability to set up data tracking and analytics for digital transformation use cases. Soft Skills: Excellent spoken and written English; able to work closely with international clients. Strong consulting mindset with the ability to understand business goals and turn them into data solutions. Comfortable leading discovery sessions, presenting insights, and defining success metrics with clients. Clear, structured communicator who can explain data concepts to non-technical audiences. Organized and proactive, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities. Highlights Lead the data strategy behind impactful digital transformation projects, translating business goals into measurable outcomes through smart KPIs, clear dashboards, and scalable data architecture. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Data Scientist
items.summary: AffirmedRx is on a mission to improve health care outcomes by bringing clarity, integrity, and trust to pharmacy benefit management.
items.description: AffirmedRx is on a mission to improve health care outcomes by bringing clarity, integrity, and trust to pharmacy benefit management. We are committed to making pharmacy benefits easy to understand, straightforward to access and always in the best interest of employers and the lives they impact. We accomplish this by bringing total clarity to business practices, leading with clinical approaches, and utilizing state-of-the-art technology. Join us in improving health care outcomes for all! We promise to do what’s right, always. Position Summary: The Data Scientist (AI/ML) designs, builds, and validates the advanced analytics that turn pharmacy, claims, clinical, and member data into decisions. This is a hands-on modeling role: the person owns machine learning models end to end, applies AI and natural language processing to unstructured clinical and member data, resolves member identity across fragmented data sources, and packages results into tools and dashboards the business can use. The role sits at the intersection of data science, clinical/pharmacy reporting, and applied AI, and partners closely with data engineering, clinical, reporting, and client-success teams. What you will do: Machine Learning and Predictive Modeling: Build predictive and prescriptive ML models for pharmacy cost and risk (e.g., forecasting second-year member spend), including feature engineering, model selection, and explainability analysis (e.g., SHAP-based feature attribution) Develop member-level risk and comorbidity scoring, mapping drug identifiers (NDC → ATC) to clinical conditions and severity weights, and validating outputs against edge cases Apply ML to automate high-effort clinical operations processes (e.g., prior-authorization override automation), moving manual workflows into rules-based and model-driven pipelines Applied AI and Natural Language Processing: Use AI/NLP to analyze unstructured member and clinical text — sentiment analysis, topic modeling, and tokenization of open-ended survey and feedback data Apply AI tooling (LLMs / copilots and internal AI services) to automate clinical policy and documentation workflows, including prompt design, output validation, and controls against hallucination and format drift Contribute to the organization’s broader AI direction: evaluating models, defining evaluation/answer-key datasets, and building drift and validation checks for AI outputs Member Identity Resolution and Data Quality: Design and maintain probabilistic (fuzzy) matching logic to assign and reconcile unique member identifiers across carriers and source systems, including collision handling, cluster analysis, and audit/logging frameworks Monitor and improve match rates, investigate false positives and fragmentation, and document data lineage and safeguards against duplicates Clinical and Pharmacy Analytics: Produce clinical and pharmacy analytics such as medication adherence and persistence (drug-, class-, and NDC-level), aligned to compliance requirements (e.g., URAC / PQA measures) QA and validate reporting products (e.g., pharmacy trend dashboards, PMPM metrics), reconciling data-point discrepancies across source systems Analytical Tooling and Delivery: Build analytical tools and prototypes (e.g., formulary/tier decision tools and cost-comparison tools), including lightweight front ends (e.g., Streamlit) for sales, clinical, and pricing use Deliver validated datasets and tables into the data warehouse in partnership with data engineering, and support the transition of prototypes into production Validation, Documentation, and Collaboration: Own QA and validation for analytical outputs, including auditing of claims files and validation of model results before release Document models, logic, data sources, schedules, and troubleshooting steps to make work reproducible and auditable Collaborate across clinical, reporting, pricing, client-success, and engineering stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into analytical specifications What you need: Degree in a quantitative field (data science, statistics, computer science, applied math) or equivalent experience 2–3 years of experience using Python and SQL for data analysis, machine learning, NLP, data quality, and record-matching solutions. Data modeling experience in PBM and/or healthcare industry in general preferred Strong Python for data science and ML (e.g., pandas plus a modeling stack), and proficiency in SQL Demonstrated experience building and validating ML models, including feature engineering and model explainability Experience with NLP techniques (sentiment analysis, topic modeling) and with applying AI/LLM tooling to real workflows, including output validation Experience with entity resolution / probabilistic record matching and data-quality analysis Comfort working with a modern cloud data warehouse and data lake, and partnering with data engineering on production hand-off Healthcare, pharmacy benefit management (PBM), or claims-data experience Familiarity with pharmacy data concepts (NDC, GPI, ATC, formulary tiers, prior authorization, rebates) Experience with compliance-driven reporting (e.g., URAC / PQA measures) Experience building analytical front ends or dashboards (e.g., Streamlit, BI tools) for non-technical stakeholders Willingness and ability to travel (10%-20%) What you get: To impact industry change in the pharmacy benefits management space, while delivering the highest quality patient outcomes To work in a culture where people thrive because when OUR team thrives, OUR business thrives Competitive compensation, including health, dental, vision and other benefits Note: AffirmedRx is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment. Remote employees are expected to maintain a professional work environment free of distractions to ensure optimal performance and collaboration. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Senior Commercial Business Analyst
items.summary: MGID is a global native advertising platform that helps brands reach unique local audiences at scale.
items.description: MGID is a global native advertising platform that helps brands reach unique local audiences at scale. At MGID , we empower brands and publishers to collaborate transparently through our privacy-first targeting technology. This enables advertisers to drive performance and awareness while allowing publishers to retain and monetize their audiences. Today, we’re creating innovative technologies, and with your help, we aim to reach even greater heights. We are looking for a Senior Commercial Business Analyst who is passionate about turning complex commercial data into clear business decisions and measurable growth. You will play a key role at the intersection of Business Intelligence and commercial strategy, partnering closely with Sales, Finance, and senior leadership to shape how we measure performance, identify growth opportunities, and drive strategic initiatives. We are looking for a proactive, business-minded professional who enjoys challenging assumptions, uncovering actionable insights, and transforming data into recommendations that influence business outcomes. If you thrive in a fast-paced, data-driven environment and enjoy building scalable analytics frameworks that support smarter decision-making, we'd love to meet you. What You’ll Do: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Analytics, Engineering or a related field Minimum of 10 years of relevant professional experience in business analysis, commercial analytics, or a similar role. Prior experience working with commercial or sales teams in medium to large organizations is highly preferred. Strong hands-on experience with Tableau, Power BI and SQL is а must-have requirement. That's including building dashboards and translating business needs into effective visual reporting. Industry experience in fintech, e-commerce, digital marketing, or digital technology is strongly preferred. Demonstrated ability to work with commercial data, generate insights, and support strategic decision-making. Requirements Who You Are: Support the Commercial team with data-driven decision-making by delivering actionable insights and performance analysis. Review, optimize, and drive client acquisition and rewards programs across both supply and demand sides of the business. Introduce and standardize methodologies for client referral programs to ensure consistency and measurable impact. Analyze the customer acquisition journey and implement a unified client lifecycle framework and common business definitions across the organization. Support the development, review, and company-wide rollout of key performance indicators. Provide sales projections and commercial performance analysis across global markets. Prepare quarterly sales forecasts as part of the regular business planning cycle. Define and implement the necessary metrics to evaluate commercial performance and monitor strategic initiatives. Forecast, assess, and track the performance of new projects and separate campaigns driven by commercial functions Languages proficiency: Ukrainian - Fluent English - Advanced At MGID , we thrive on innovation, collaboration, and a passion for AdTech. Our culture is built on openness, transparency, and a shared drive for excellence. We empower our teams to take bold steps, embrace challenges, and grow together in a dynamic, people-first environment. Here, your ideas matter, your contributions are valued, and your potential has no limits. Join us and shape the futureof digital advertising! Highlights Drive smarter commercial decisions through data-driven insights, forecasting, and performance analytics. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Data Liaison (Business Analytics & Insights)- 6 Month Contract
items.summary: OGC is a boutique research and consulting agency specializing in data-driven strategy, quantitative analytics, and Customer Experience (CX) program design and optimization.
items.description: OGC is a boutique research and consulting agency specializing in data-driven strategy, quantitative analytics, and Customer Experience (CX) program design and optimization. We work with some of the world's largest organizations across a variety of industries, including Financial Services, Specialty Retail, Telecommunications, Hospitality, and Software, helping them gain a deep understanding of their customers, develop actionable insights, and improve business processes. Our client is a global leader in the Consumer Packaged Goods industry, with a focus on delivering data-driven insights that support commercial decision-making and business growth. Their Growth Analytics team develops dashboards and reporting solutions used by senior leadership across the organization. They are seeking a Data Liaison to bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical development teams, ensuring reporting solutions accurately reflect business needs and industry metrics. This is a 6-month remote contract with the potential for extension. About the Role The ideal candidate is analytical, commercially minded, and an exceptional communicator who enjoys translating business needs into actionable data requirements. You will work closely with business stakeholders, insights teams, and analytics developers to ensure dashboards and reporting solutions are built using the correct business logic, calculations, and data sources. This role is ideal for someone with experience in business analytics, commercial insights, or consumer insights who understands both the language of the business and the language of data. should be comfortable working closely with technical teams, translating business requirements into technical specifications, and validating data before it reaches senior leadership. You'll also play an important role in helping the analytics team build a stronger understanding of the business, enabling them to become increasingly self-sufficient over time. Responsibilities Include Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, insights teams, and analytics developers, translating executive requests into clear business requirements, data specifications, and analytical approaches. Review dashboards, calculations, and reporting logic before release, ensuring the correct business logic, methodologies, metrics, and data sources (including syndicated datasets such as Nielsen) are used while proactively identifying and resolving reporting inaccuracies. Participate in business and executive reporting discussions to understand business priorities, reporting requirements, and how data is used to support decision-making. Document business metrics, calculation methodologies, and data source guidance to establish consistent reporting standards and best practices. Coach and mentor analytics developers to strengthen their understanding of business metrics, commercial context, and reporting expectations, with the goal of enabling greater independence over time. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve reporting processes, strengthen communication between business and technical functions, and develop scalable documentation and best practices that enhance the long-term capability of the analytics team. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, Data Analytics, Marketing, or a related field. 4+ years of experience in Business Analytics, Commercial Analytics, Consumer Insights, Market Research, Strategy, or a related analytical role. Experience within Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), Retail, or a similar commercial environment is strongly preferred. Experience working with syndicated data sources, particularly Nielsen, with the ability to determine the most appropriate data source for different business questions. Strong understanding of retail and commercial performance metrics, including velocity, points of distribution, market share, merchandising, pricing, and related KPIs. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to validate data, calculations, business logic, and reporting accuracy. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into clear guidance for technical and analytics teams. Experience collaborating with analytics, BI, engineering, or dashboard development teams in a cross-functional environment. Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Experience with business intelligence platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting tools is advantageous. Technical coding or dashboard development experience is not required; however, the ability to engage credibly with technical teams is essential. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Payments Analyst
items.summary: Payments AnalystStellarTech is a rapidly growing company at the forefront of innovation in the EdTech industry.
items.description: Payments Analyst StellarTech is a rapidly growing company at the forefront of innovation in the EdTech industry. We build and scale educational apps for users around the world, combining data, technology, and an x1000 mindset to create meaningful products and sustainable business models. We are looking for a Payments Analyst to join our Payments Division. Payments sit at one of the most critical points in the customer journey: the moment user intent turns into revenue. As our product portfolio and global presence continue to grow, we need an analyst who will help us keep payment reporting accurate, monitor performance, identify anomalies, and support data-driven improvements across our payment flows. You will gradually take ownership of day-to-day payment analytics while developing deep expertise in transactional data, monetization, and subscription products. What You’ll Do Maintain and improve recurring payment reports and dashboards. Adapt existing reporting for new applications, markets, and business needs. Create analytical reports and data extracts independently. Add new filters and dimensions to existing dashboards. Monitor payment performance, alerts, and week-over-week changes in key metrics. Identify anomalies in payment data and conduct first-line investigations into possible causes. Perform data quality checks and help maintain consistency across multiple data sources. Work with large product and transactional datasets. Support the Payments team with clear conclusions and actionable insights, not just raw data. Collaborate with Payments, Product, Finance, and other cross-functional teams. Identify opportunities to automate recurring reports and analytical workflows. Gradually contribute to more advanced payment analytics, experiments, and business hypotheses. What We’re Looking For 1-3 years of hands-on experience in Data Analytics, Product Analytics, or a similar analytical role. Strong SQL skills and the ability to write queries independently. Practical Python skills for data analysis and automation. Working knowledge of statistics and analytical methods. Experience working with large datasets and real product or business data. Experience creating or maintaining reports and BI dashboards. Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills. Ability to validate data, identify inconsistencies, and investigate anomalies. Ability to clearly explain what you did, what problem you solved, and how the result was useful. Strong attention to detail and respect for data accuracy. An ownership mindset: you do not simply complete tasks but take responsibility for the result. High learning agility and genuine interest in developing within the payments domain. Clear, structured communication and willingness to raise questions or blockers early. Nice to Have Experience working with payment, transactional, billing, or financial data. Experience in subscription-based, web-to-app, fintech, e-commerce, gaming, or other high-volume B2C products. Understanding of monetization models and online payment flows. Experience with AWS Athena or Amazon S3. Experience with Tableau, Apache Superset, Looker, or similar BI tools. Experience automating reports or recurring analytical processes. Personal, academic, or professional projects involving automation, AI tools, or real-world datasets. Previous payments experience is an advantage, but it is not a requirement. Strong analytical fundamentals, ownership, and the ability to learn quickly matter more. What Success Looks Like During your first months, you will learn the Payments Division’s data, reporting logic, and key processes. You will gradually take ownership of recurring dashboards, reports, filters, data extracts, monitoring, and alerting. You will be able to identify issues, explain what is happening in the data, and escalate anomalies with the necessary context. Why You’ll Love Working With Us Direct business impact: Work with data at the point where customer intent becomes revenue. Global scale: Analyze payment flows across multiple products, markets, and payment methods. Valuable expertise: Build your career in payments, transactions, subscriptions, and monetization. Professional growth: Learn directly from an experienced Senior Analyst and gradually take ownership of your analytical area. Modern tools: Work with SQL, Python, AWS Athena/S3, Tableau/Superset, and AI-powered solutions. Innovative environment: Experiment, improve processes, and bring your own ideas. Global remote: Work remotely as part of an international product company. Health support: Company-provided medical expense compensation. AI tools: Company-covered AI subscriptions and other tools. Balance: 21 days of annual leave plus 10 bank holidays. Collaborative culture: Work with ambitious professionals who value reliable evidence, extreme ownership, energy, and speed. items.description: At Dscout, we’re building the most flexible and powerful UX research platform on the market—trusted by the world’s top brands in finance (JP Morgan Chase, Intuit, Charles Schwab, PayPal), healthcare (Aya, Headspace), consumer goods (Keen, Verizon, Target, Northface), and tech (Google, Amazon, Facebook, Meta, Spotify, AirBnB). Our tools help teams deeply understand the humans behind their products, so they can build better ones. We are expanding our smart and driven team and would love for you to join us. AI is a core part of how Dscout operates. Feature quality relies heavily on the data pipelines and infrastructure under the hood. As an AI Data Engineer you will be at the intersection of ML systems and data engineering, working closely with our MLE and analytics engineering teams to build the pipelines, models, and evaluation systems that make our AI features trustworthy in production. Dscout sits at a unique intersection: a platform where rich human behavior data meets the researchers trying to make sense of it. Getting that data right: structured, trustworthy, and ready to power both AI features and the reporting researchers rely on is foundational work. That's what this role is about. What you'll do Design, build, and own the data pipelines that move and transform data from our application and third-party sources into relational databases - keeping them reliable and well-modeled as volume and complexity grow Partner with analytics engineering to build the data models and reporting that give researchers and teams real visibility into how their work is performing Own data quality as a first-class concern across ingestion, modeling, and reporting. Catch problems before they reach a model, a dashboard, or a user, and fix them Build and ship production AI systems the data infrastructure and services that ML features run on Design and own evaluation systems that tell us whether an AI feature is ready to ship and holding up over time: eval harnesses, test datasets, and production monitoring built as software, not one-off analyses Set the standard for how data work gets done. Write clearly, share context early, and make the people around you faster What you bring 5+ years of experience in data engineering, with meaningful exposure to ML systems in production Deep data engineering experience: you've personally built and owned pipelines that move data from application sources into a warehouse at scale, and you know what breaks, when, and why Strong Python skills and fluency across the data stack (we use Snowflake and Postgres) Experience with orchestration tools like Airflow, Dagster, or similar Experience working with cloud computing environments like GCP or AWS. A track record of working closely with analytics engineers or data analysts to build reliable, well-documented data models Hands-on experience shipping AI or ML systems that real users depended on in production, and owning what happened after launch A genuine point of view on evaluation: you treat evals as something you build, not a report you write A high-agency mindset. You can take an ambiguous problem and drive it to a working outcome without a fully-scoped ticket Fluency across the data lifecycle, from production-facing features to the internal analytics that drive decision-making Comfort working across the data lifecycle, from production-facing features to the internal analytics that drive decision-making Comfort using AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) as a real part of your workflow Nice to have Experience with dbt or similar data modeling frameworks Familiarity with LLM evaluation and observability tooling Exposure to MCP-based tooling or agentic data workflows If this role excites you but you're not sure you check every box, we'd still love to hear from you. Of course, what is outlined above is an ideal set of expectations; however, business needs and other projects and tasks may shift, and additional tasks could be assigned at the discretion of your manager. items.summary: Why This Role As a Blockchain Data Analyst & Researcher, you will be a pivotal force in our data intelligence efforts, serving primarily as a blockchain data protocol researcher.
items.description: Why This Role As a Blockchain Data Analyst & Researcher, you will be a pivotal force in our data intelligence efforts, serving primarily as a blockchain data protocol researcher. Your core mission will involve a deep dive into the complex internals and mechanics of various blockchain networks, reverse engineering of sophisticated Decentralized Finance (DeFi) protocols, and translating these complex systems into actionable, structured data. Develop new derivative data models and datasets for client insights and competitive advantages. Map, cleanse, and normalize raw, disparate blockchain data (transaction logs, smart contract events, state changes) into consistent, structured relational and non-relational schemes for consumption by analytics, machine learning, and AI tools. This role requires a unique blend of expertise in distributed systems, data engineering best practices, and a profound understanding of the crypto and decentralized ecosystem. What You’ll Do Maintain an AI-native and blockchain-forward mindset, proactively leveraging emerging trends and generative technologies to stay at the vanguard of the crypto revolution while maximizing work efficiency and uncovering novel, high-alpha data opportunities. Architect Intuitive Data Models: Turn the messiness of on-chain data into elegant, unified abstractions. You'll build the models that provide our users with granular, high-integrity insights across various protocols. Deconstruct DeFi Mechanics: Get under the hood of DeFi protocols. You'll reverse-engineer smart contracts and on-chain events, translating complex interactions into clean, production-grade SQL/dbt models. Scale Our Ecosystem Coverage: Lead the charge in indexing new blockchains. You’ll design the schemas that transform raw chain data into our internal "source of truth," ensuring every block is captured with 100% accuracy. Engineer Signal from Noise: Define the metrics that matter (TVL, Volume, Fees). You’ll be the gatekeeper of data quality, proactively identifying and filtering out wash trading, bot activity, and Sybil attacks. What You'll Need: Experience 3+ years hands-on in Data Science, Data Engineering, or a hybrid role; Blockchain or crypto analytics background strongly preferred, familiarity with on-chain data structures, transaction semantics, and asset classification; Streaming & Lakehouse Apache Flink or Spark Streaming building and operating real-time data pipelines; Apache Iceberg or Apache Hudi managing large-scale Data Lakehouses with schema evolution, time travel, and ACID guarantees over petabytes of raw blockchain data; AWS Data Platform S3 for scalable data lake storage; RDS for structured relational workloads; Spark SQL and PySpark for interactive querying and ad-hoc analysis; Caching & Distribution Familiarity with Data Grid technologies (e.g. Hazelcast, Apache Ignite, Redis) for high-throughput, low-latency data access patterns; Languages & Tooling SQL advanced query writing, window functions, query plan analysis, performance tuning at scale; Python Pandas, Polars for data wrangling; Scikit-learn for model development; Proficient in architecting high-throughput ingestion pipelines that leverage external data sources REST/WebSocket APIs, JSON-RPC node queries; Strong grasp of ETL fundamentals (extract, transform, load), including managing schema mismatches between heterogeneous sources and destinations; Engineering Mindset Systematic approach to debugging: reproducing issues, isolating root cause, validating fixes; Comfortable working with large, semi-structured, or undocumented data sources. Why Join Lukka ? Are you looking for a challenge? Lukka solves the most complex data and technology challenges for an industry that is at the forefront of innovation. At Lukka , we strive to anticipate and respond to the needs of this new and ever-changing ecosystem of digital assets. That was true in 2014, while everyone was focused on trading & buying this new asset class, we were thinking about the tax implications of crypto. That innovative foresight continues today as we evolve and iterate on our product suite to address the regulations and educate our customers. We are looking for passionate, collaborative, and strategic individuals who want to help shape the future of, well, everything – starting with making crypto more accountable. We invest in our teammates, promote from within & are responsible to each other by fostering an inclusive space for curious minds to thrive and innovate. What’s life @ Lukka like? We move fast and continue to be ahead of the curve. You could be part of a growing company bridging the gap between business and blockchain. Here’s some insight into why our team members have joined: Ability to own the projects they work on; Less red tape to take ideas from inception to delivery; Being at the forefront of an industry; Small team, big dreams. Of course, let’s discuss some perks: Opportunity to work directly on data for digital assets, an industry-leading product with well-known clients. Working with multiple AI solutions daily. Exposure to both technical problem-solving and customer-facing challenges. A growing Poland-based team with direct collaboration across US and global stakeholders. A startup-style culture where your impact is visible every day. So you’ve scrolled, your interest is piqued and hopefully read all of the important things...now what? This is an exciting time to join a team that’s at the forefront of this rapidly growing industry. We are looking for people who constantly push themselves to think differently, are ready to face new challenges and chart exciting new paths. If this sounds like you, apply! items.summary: About Flexport: At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune
items.description: Data and Analytics About Flexport: At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us. The Opportunity Flexport is building the future of global fulfillment—and we’re looking for a Staff Program Manager, Strategic Initiatives who wants to be at the center of that transformation. This is not a traditional management role. You will be the architect of tomorrow’s Flexport Fulfillment network: designing processes, building products, and creating the standards that will define how we operate at scale. You’ll sit at the intersection of operations, product, and technology, working across all functions to identify gaps, design solutions, and bring them to life. We want someone who thrives in ambiguity, loves solving highly technical problems, and isn’t afraid to get hands-on—whether it’s building a new workflow in SQL, prototyping a tool, or architecting the next phase of our operating model. If you want to make a lasting impact by building something from the ground up—and have the technical, operational, and strategic chops to do it—this is the role for you. What You’ll Do Architect the Future of Fulfillment Design, standardize, and codify the processes, products, and tools that will power Flexport’s next generation fulfillment network. Define operating models that can scale globally, balancing efficiency, cost, speed, and customer experience. Build, Not Just Manage Own initiatives end-to-end: from diagnosing the problem, designing the solution, building prototypes, and driving implementation. Develop tooling, dashboards, and models directly—leveraging SQL, Python, BI platforms, and workflow automation. Leverage Data for Strategic Planning Use data to uncover bottlenecks, quantify opportunities, and make recommendations that drive millions in cost savings and unlock new service capabilities. Build forecasting and scenario planning models to guide long-term network design and capacity planning. Be a Cross-Functional Force Multiplier Partner with engineering, product, operations, finance, and commercial teams to align on priorities, build solutions, and scale them across the network. Translate operational pain points into product requirements and ensure adoption of new tools and processes. Standardize the Network Establish and roll out SOPs, reporting cadences, and KPIs that become the backbone of Fulfillment execution. Drive governance and accountability around execution, ensuring every site runs on the same playbook. Drive Strategic Initiatives at Scale Lead high-impact, white-space projects (automation, robotics, B2B/Retail compliance, international expansion) that redefine the limits of what Flexport Fulfillment can deliver. Develop and execute multi-year roadmaps in partnership with senior leadership. You Should Have 7–10+ years of experience in fulfillment, logistics, supply chain, or operations strategy—ideally with direct exposure to high-volume networks. Extremely strong technical skillset : SQL (expert), Excel/Google Sheets (advanced), BI tools (Looker, Tableau, PowerBI), and preferably Python or R for modeling and automation. A proven record of designing and implementing scalable processes/products that delivered measurable business impact. Strong strategic thinking , with the ability to connect day-to-day execution to P&L drivers and long-term vision. Entrepreneurial mindset: thrives in ambiguity, comfortable building from scratch, and naturally biased toward action. Executive-level communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders across all levels of the organization. Bonus: Experience working with robotics, warehouse automation, or building new fulfillment products (B2B, Prep, Returns, Retail compliance). Why This Role is Different This role is one of the most independent, entrepreneurial, and impactful within Flexport Fulfillment. You won’t just manage a process—you’ll design and build the future of how we fulfill, scale, and serve customers. Your fingerprints will be on everything from the technology we use to the services we offer. You’ll have the mandate to experiment, prototype, and standardize at scale—and the support of a leadership team that knows the success of this role will shape the future of Flexport Fulfillment. Commitment to Equal Opportunity At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at www.flexport.com/privacy for additional information.

As we expand across Medicare Advantage and…
items.description: Counterpart Health is an AI‑powered physician enablement platform that delivers clinical insights to providers at the point of care. Our flagship product, Counterpart Assistant, is embedded into clinicians’ workflows and integrates with EHR systems, helping care teams drive value-based outcomes, close care gaps, and proactively manage chronic disease. As we expand across Medicare Advantage and other value-based care programs, we need analytical talent that can translate complex clinical and financial data into narratives that drive action, for both our internal teams and our payer and provider customers. You will be part of the analytical engine behind Counterpart Health’s value-based care performance insights. This role sits at the intersection of risk adjustment, quality measurement, utilization management, and cost analytics, and you will be expected to own the metrics that matter most to our payer and provider partners. Beyond the numbers, you are a storyteller: you turn dense claims and clinical data into clear, compelling narratives that help customers understand performance, identify opportunities, and take action. You will work closely with Customer Success, Clinical, and Product teams to ensure our analytics are accurate, trusted, and decision-ready. As a Data Analyst, you will: Build and maintain core Value-Based Care (VBC) performance metrics across risk, quality, utilization, and cost domains, including HCC capture rates, RAF scores, PMPM trends, and inpatient/ED utilization rates. Develop customer-facing analytics, reports, and dashboards that surface actionable performance insights for payer and provider partners in a clear, narrative-driven format. Analyze Medicare Advantage performance data, including risk adjustment, quality bonus payments, and benchmark performance, to identify gaps, trends, and opportunities at the patient, provider, and market level. Translate complex data findings into executive-ready narratives: written summaries, slide-ready visuals, and structured QBR materials that tell a coherent story about performance and next steps. Conduct deep-dive utilization and cost analyses, including high-cost claimant reviews, avoidable utilization patterns, and specialty/pharmacy spend trends, to identify levers for improvement. Partner with Customer Success and Provider Operations teams to prepare and deliver performance reviews (QBRs, monthly reporting packages) that communicate value and surface priority action areas for each customer. Collaborate with Data Engineering to validate claims and clinical data pipelines, flag anomalies, and ensure metric consistency across customer populations. Contribute to the development of scalable analytics infrastructure: reusable SQL libraries, metric definitions, and documentation that enable the team to move faster. You should get in touch if you have: 4+ years of hands-on healthcare data analytics experience, with direct exposure to payer or provider customers in a value-based care context. Deep familiarity with VBC metrics: risk adjustment (HCC coding, RAF scores), utilization (IP admissions, ED visits, readmissions), and cost (PMPM, total cost of care, benchmark vs. actual). Strong SQL skills, able to write complex queries across claims, eligibility, and clinical datasets in cloud-based warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar). Exceptional data storytelling ability: you can translate analytical findings into clear narratives and visuals that resonate with both clinical and non-technical audiences. Experience building customer-facing reports and dashboards; comfortable presenting findings to external stakeholders (health plans, provider groups, ACOs). Preferred Qualifications: Medicare Advantage experience, including familiarity with CMS risk adjustment models (CMS-HCC v24/v28), Star Ratings methodology, and MA quality bonus payment structures. Familiarity with clinical terminologies: ICD-10, CPT/HCPCS, NDC, SNOMED, LOINC. Experience using Python or R for data manipulation, cohort analysis, or statistical modeling. Background working with EHR or clinical data alongside claims (e.g., for care gap closure, chronic condition identification, or attribution logic). Prior experience in a health plan, risk-bearing provider group, ACO, or health tech company supporting VBC programs. Benefits Overview : Financial Well-Being : Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions. Physical Well-Being : We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare. Mental Well-Being : We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location. Professional Development : Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews. Additional Perks: Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities Reimbursement for office setup expenses Monthly cell phone & internet stipend Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams Paid parental leave for all new parents And much more! About Counterpart Health: In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions. Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care. With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software. Counterpart Health is a subsidiary of Clover Health. From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility. #LI-REMOTE Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are an E-Verify company. Final pay is based on several factors including but not limited to internal equity, market data, and the applicant’s education, work experience, certifications, etc. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is: $96,000—$125,000 USD

items.description: Who is Boulevard? Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most. Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen . We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most . Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too. Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard. We're hiring a Director of Engineering - Data to build and lead the technical foundation that powers Boulevard's data ecosystem and products. This role is responsible for our data infrastructure, data governance, ML capabilities and the underlying systems that enable data-driven products and decision-making across the company. Reporting to the SVP of Engineering, you'll play a critical leadership role in establishing Boulevard's data platform as a strategic competitive advantage. Your work will shape how data is collected, processed, and leveraged across the company - driving insights, powering product innovation, and ensuring operational excellence. You will ensure that data is reliable, secure, performant, and accessible to support our growing customer base and internal teams. You'll lead a high-impact team of data engineers, with a mandate to grow and scale the organization. This is a foundational role where you'll architect and build systems that will support Boulevard's growth for years to come. management and product engineering to power reporting dashboards, analytics features, and data-driven customer experiences Data Governance & Quality - Establish frameworks for data integrity, lineage, and compliance Data Security & Privacy - Ensure data protection, access controls, and regulatory compliance (including HIPAA) ML/AI Platform Operations - Provide the foundation and standards for machine learning and AI capabilities Real-time & Batch Processing - Design and optimize data processing systems for various use cases Data Integration & APIs - Enable seamless data flow between systems and external partners Key Projects & Initiatives Modern Data Infrastructure : Continue building out scalable data infrastructure using tools like dbt, Airflow, and real-time streaming platforms Customer Data Products : Collaborate with Product Management and Product Engineering to deliver customer-facing reporting, dashboards, and analytics features Data Platform for Insights : monitoring, lineage tracking, and governance policies Platform Self-Service : Build tools and frameworks that enable other teams to safely and efficiently work with data Security & Compliance : Strengthen data protection, access controls, and ensure HIPAA compliance across all data systems Performance Optimization : Continuously improve cost, speed, and reliability of data processing systems ML/AI Infrastructure : Provide robust foundation for training, deployment, and monitoring of machine learning models and LLMs What You'll Do Here Technical Leadership : Define and execute the long-term technical strategy for Boulevard's data platform, ensuring scalability and reliability as we grow Team Building : Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data platform engineers, establishing best practices and fostering a culture of excellence Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner closely with Product Management, Product Engineering, and the Data Insights team to understand requirements and deliver platform capabilities that enable customer-facing data products and internal insights Architecture & Design : Drive architectural decisions for data systems, balancing current needs with future flexibility and scalability Operational Excellence : Establish monitoring, alerting, and operational practices that ensure high availability and performance of data systems Standards & Governance : Define and implement data governance policies, security standards, and quality frameworks across the organization Strategic Planning : Work with leadership to align data platform roadmap with business objectives and technical strategy What You'll Need to Thrive 10+ years of experience in data platform engineering, distributed systems, or infrastructure engineering, with deep expertise in building scalable data processing systems 5+ years of people management experience, including managing senior engineers and technical leads Proven track record of building data platforms and ML systems that support both internal analytics and customer-facing data products Experience delivering customer-facing reporting, dashboards, and analytics features in collaboration with Product teams with the ability to translate business goals into technical roadmaps, balancing short-term execution with long-term vision. items.summary: You’re more valuable than ever – And that’s just how we’ll make you feel.
items.description: You’re more valuable than ever – And that’s just how we’ll make you feel. Job Summary The LMS Administrator serves as the primary system administrator and subject matter expert for the organization's Workday Learning platform. This role is responsible for the configuration, administration, governance, optimization, reporting, and ongoing support of enterprise learning technologies. The LMS Administrator partners closely with Learning, Talent Management, IT, Operations and business stakeholders to deliver effective learning solutions, maintain data integrity, support compliance requirements, and drive an exceptional learner experience. This position provides advanced Workday Learning administration, reporting and analytics, troubleshooting, learning program deployment, and support for system enhancements, integrations, and continuous improvement initiatives. The role requires extensive knowledge of Workday Learning functionality, learning operations, data management, business processes, and enterprise learning best practices. Qualifications Education Required: Bachelor’s degree in Informatics, Information Technology, Instructional Design, Education, Business Administration, Human Resources or related fields. • Direct work experience will be considered in lieu of a degree. Work Experience Required: 3+ years of direct experience in Learning Management System (LMS) administration. Significant experience or certification in using Workday Learning LMS. Preferred Qualifications, Education, Licenses, Certifications, Experience, etc.: Workday Learning certifications highly desired. Experience with Workday HRIS and API integrations. Experience with Docuware and Sigma to store and analyze data. Troubleshooting skills and knowledge of deeper LMS functionalities. Preferred certifications are desired and include, but are not limited to: Instructional Design, eLearning development, or print design (e.g., ATD, Articulate, Adobe Captivate), Information Technology (e.g., CompTIA, SQL) Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Advanced knowledge of Workday Learning administration, including learning assignments, certifications, learning campaigns/engagements, course management, learner audiences, security roles, and learning compliance processes. Demonstrated experience administering and optimizing enterprise Learning Management Systems (LMS), including system configuration, user support, reporting, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives. Strong understanding of learning technologies and standards, including SCORM, xAPI, online learning content deployment, learning pathways, certifications, and compliance based training programs. Experience supporting Workday Learning implementations, system enhancements, tenant testing, release management, data migration, and post-implementation optimization activities. Working knowledge of Workday Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB), data imports, mass uploads, integrations, and related data management processes. Ability to build, analyze, and maintain reports, dashboards, and learning analytics to support business decisions, compliance requirements, and learning effectiveness measurement. Knowledge of HRIS and learning system integrations, with an understanding of APIs, data exchanges, and enterprise system architecture. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify root causes, resolve complex technical issues, and recommend scalable system solutions. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly, develop system documentation, and effectively collaborate with stakeholders at all organizational levels. Proven ability to establish and maintain LMS governance standards, administrative procedures, documentation, and quality controls that ensure data integrity and system consistency. Experience managing multiple priorities, projects, and system-related initiatives while maintaining accuracy, organization, and attention to detail. Self-motivated and highly accountable, with the ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and take ownership of system performance and user experience. Demonstrated ability to build strong partnerships across Learning & Development, Talent Management, IT, Operations, and business stakeholder groups. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, as well as reporting and data analysis tools such as Workday Reporting, Sigma, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms. Experience with instructional design and eLearning authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline, Rise, Vyond, Adobe Captivate, or similar solutions is preferred. Commitment to continuous learning and staying current on Workday functionality, learning technology trends, industry best practices, and emerging workforce development solutions. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Workday Learning Administration & Governance Serve as the primary system administrator and subject matter expert for the Workday Learning platform. Configure, maintain, and optimize Workday Learning functionality, including learning assignments, certifications, learning campaigns, learner audiences, security roles, business processes, and system settings. Establish and maintain LMS governance standards, system documentation, administrative procedures, and quality controls to ensure data integrity, security, compliance, and consistency. Evaluate, test, and implement Workday releases, new functionality, and system enhancements to improve organizational learning capabilities and user experience. Ensure compliance with organizational, regulatory, and audit requirements related to learning records and training documentation. Learning Operations & Content Administration Administer enterprise learning programs, compliance training, certifications, curricula, learning pathways, and other learning initiatives within Workday Learning. Create, publish, update, archive, and maintain instructor-led, virtual, blended, and eLearning content while ensuring accurate course data, metadata, version control, and user accessibility. Partner with Learning & Development, Talent Management, IT, Operations and other business stakeholders to deploy and support learning solutions that align with organizational goals and enhance learner engagement. Reporting, Analytics, & Data Management Develop, maintain, and distribute reports, dashboards, and analytics to monitor learning participation, compliance, completion rates, certifications, adoption, and program effectiveness. Analyze learning and system data, perform audits, and manage data maintenance activities to ensure accuracy, compliance, and actionable business insights. System Enhancements, Integrations, & Technical Support Identify opportunities to improve learning operations through automation, process improvements, workflow optimization, and system enhancements. Support integrations, data exchanges, imports, and maintenance activities between Workday Learning and other enterprise systems, including Workday HCM. Serve as the primary escalation point for complex system issues, performing troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and solution implementation in partnership with IT, vendors, and any other business stakeholders. Monitor system performance and user experience metrics and recommend improvements that increase efficiency, scalability, and adoption. Stakeholder Partnership & Project Support Consult with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate learning needs into scalable Workday Learning solutions. Provide training, guidance, and support to administrators, managers, instructors, and learners on Workday Learning functionality and best practices. Lead or participate in projects related to LMS implementations, upgrades, migrations, enhancements, and continuous improvement initiatives. Maintain current knowledge of Workday Learning capabilities, learning technologies, industry trends, and best practices. GoHealth Core Values GoHealth’s Core Values, listed below, are essential functions of this position: Collaboration: Takes ownership for collectively establishing productive partnerships and relationships and seek to gain joint understanding of priorities and objectives so that the greater good of the organization and those we serve is always at the forefront. Innovation: Consistently uses good judgment, applying creativity to overcome obstacles and increasing effectiveness and efficiency through process and other forms of innovation. Diversity & Inclusion: Fosters diversity and inclusion, to be able to better understand team members, our customers and partners. Engages the strengths and talents of each GoHealth team member, creating an environment of involvement, respect and connection where the richness of ideas, backgrounds and perspectives are harnessed. Courage & Integrity: Models and practices the highest ethical and professional standards; demonstrates pride and personal interest in our patients, partners and fellow team members, deeply engaging in the business. Makes decisions, with a focus on doing the right thing; treats team members, our customers, partners and vendors with dignity, consideration, open-mindedness and respect. Accountability: Always shows initiative, demonstrates a bias to action and gets things done. Actively accepts responsibility for diverse roles, obligations and actions that positively influence patient and customer outcomes, our partnerships and the healthcare needs of our communities. Physical Activity: The role may require the ability to lift, carry, push, or pull materials, supplies, and equipment (up to 15 lbs.). Duties typically involve a combination of sitting, standing, and walking, with frequent changes in position. Continuously refine processes to ensure scalability, maintain data integrity, and uphold quality standards. Demonstrate ownership and a proactive, hands-on approach to identifying and solving operational challenges. Required Skills and Qualifications Technical aptitude with demonstrated experience in data analysis, annotation, or workflow optimization. Familiarity with operational processes and a passion for increasing efficiency. Ability to interpret and communicate data-driven insights clearly and persuasively, both in writing and verbally. Excellent collaboration skills and attention to detail in managing data quality and validation. Preferred Qualifications Background in engineering or technical fields with operational focus or human data projects. Experience with data visualization tools (such as Excel, Tableau, Power BI) or programming languages (such as Python, SQL). Internship or project-based experience in data management, AI/ML, or process optimization. Regional Hiring Notes This role is being hired in parallel across multiple regions due to coverage needs, compliance requirements, and time-zone alignment.
