items.title: SEO/ASO Manager
items.summary: About Life360 Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch.…
items.description: About Life360 Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries. Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family). Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com . Life360 is a Remote-First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US) regardless of any specified location above. We are AI Native We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process. Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy. About The Team As you'd expect from a company obsessed with keeping families connected, the eCommerce team moves fast and takes the member experience seriously – because a clunky flow is its own kind of broken promise. Sitting inside Journey Marketing, we’re a mix of merchandisers, marketers, data folks, and designers who all care about the same thing: turning every member touchpoint — from first website or app visit — into long-term loyalty and lasting relationships. From the online store to in-app purchases to wherever commerce shows up next, this team builds the experience that turns interest into purchase. If you like owning outcomes, thinking in systems, and turning "maybe" into "yes" at scale, you'll fit right in. About the Job Search has changed and is reshaping how families discover Life360 before they ever visit a website or app store. The SEO and ASO Manager owns Life360's unified organic discovery strategy across traditional search (SEO), AI answer surfaces (AEO/GEO), and app stores (ASO) – while simultaneously owning the content strategy, editorial calendar, and site information architecture that powers all three. You'll partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Marketing to build the technical foundation, content depth, and structured data layer that earn Life360 citations, rankings, and recommendations across every surface where families make decisions. This is a hands-on role with real execution accountability. You'll manage a content strategist and supporting agency, setting the quality bar for everything we publish, and personally own the technical and strategic work that requires deep expertise. You'll be Life360's subject matter expert on how organic discovery works in an AI-first world and the person responsible for making sure we win it. For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $121,500 to $178,500 USD. We take into consideration an individual's background and experience in determining final salary - therefore, base pay offered may vary considerably depending on geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The compensation package includes a wide range of medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits, as well as equity. What You’ll Do Manage a small team currently consisting of a Content Strategist Own Life360's unified organic discovery strategy across SEO, AEO/GEO, and ASO, ensuring that search rankings, AI citations, and app store presence operate as a single, coordinated system across membership and devices. Lead the content strategy and editorial calendar for Life360.com, setting the topical roadmap, content hierarchy, and publishing cadence across blog, product marketing pages, help content, and comparison pages – ensuring every piece serves a defined discovery and conversion purpose. Build and maintain the site information architecture, owning URL structure, taxonomy, internal linking, and wayfinding logic that enables both users and crawlers to navigate Life360's content efficiently. Execute AEO optimization across all content surfaces (web and app), implementing and expanding structured data, shaping content for AI parsing, and building the signals that AI models weight heavily. Monitor and grow Life360's AI citation share across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews, tracking citation rate and proactively identifying content gaps where competitors or third parties are defining our narrative before we do. Lead technical SEO health: manage crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals, canonical and redirect logic, hreflang implementation, and structured data integrity; partner with Engineering to triage and resolve issues and build technical SEO requirements into relevant product and site launches. Optimize landing pages and FAQ content for both traditional SERP performance and AI answer eligibility, ensuring high-commercial-intent pages are built to convert and be cited. Drive the off-page authority strategy in partnership with PR, identifying link-building opportunities, editorial placements (Wirecutter, Forbes Advisor, parenting publishers), and creator co-citation campaigns that build Life360's domain authority and AI recommendation weight. Own regional SEO localization including locale-specific keyword research, localized content briefs, hreflang governance, and coordinated ASO refreshes for each market. Deliver weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance reporting across organic sessions, AI citation rate, app store rank, and organic revenue contribution – translating data into clear strategic recommendations for cross-functional stakeholders. What We’re Looking For 5–8 years of experience in content strategy and SEO, with a track record of measurable organic performance improvement on apps and websites. Proven AEO experience: you understand how LLMs parse content, what structured data signals matter for AI citation, and have implemented strategies that improved a brand's visibility in generative search results. Strong technical SEO foundation: you've worked directly with Engineering on crawl health, indexation, Core Web Vitals, structured data, and site architecture; you can write a detailed technical brief and QA the implementation. Content strategy ownership: you've built and run an editorial calendar, managed content production workflows, conducted content gap analysis, and made strategic decisions about topical authority and content hierarchy – not just written or edited content. AI-native operator: you use AI tools actively in your workflow (content research, brief generation, structured data implementation, performance analysis) and can guide AI systems to produce on-brand output at scale. Global SEO experience: including hreflang implementation, locale-specific keyword strategy, and regional content localization across multiple markets. Data-driven decision maker who can build performance dashboards, identify anomalies, and translate organic metrics into clear business impact narratives for leadership. Proficiency with SEO tools (Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or equivalent) and Google Search Console; experience with ASO platforms (AppTweak, Sensor Tower, or equivalent) is a strong plus. Strong cross-functional collaborator who can work fluidly with Engineering, Product, Marketing, and PR to align organic strategy with product launches, campaigns, and technical roadmaps. Clear, confident communicator who can make the case for organic investment, translate complex algorithm shifts into plain-language implications, and influence prioritization without direct authority over engineering resources. Our Benefits Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for employees) Paid parental leave 401(k) plan with company matching program Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns Learning & Development programs Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers Life360 Values Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust. Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard. Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families. High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done. Our Commitment to Diversity We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status. We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful. Even if you don’t meet 100% of the below qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying! #LI-Remote ____________________________________________________________________________

items.title: Product Operations Lead
items.summary: Proudly voted a Great Place to Work®, we are a dynamic startup in the CPaaS (Communication Platform as a Service) space that is revolutionizing the way businesses communicate.
items.description: Proudly voted a Great Place to Work®, we are a dynamic startup in the CPaaS (Communication Platform as a Service) space that is revolutionizing the way businesses communicate. Our team is made up of 400+ energetic and passionate Unifones who are dedicated to delivering the best possible experience to 5000+ customer-centric companies. We pride ourselves on our fun and collaborative work environment, where creativity and new ideas are constantly encouraged. As shareholders in the business, we’re so much more than a group of passionate communicators. We are Unifones. Join our team and be a part of something big! Meet the team! Our Engineering team is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the systems and technologies that drive Unifonic ’s solutions. We work closely with other departments to ensure our products and services meet the needs of our customers. If you are passionate about technology and are excited about working on cutting-edge communication and engagement solutions, we want you on our team. As a Product Operations Lead, you will partner closely with Product Leadership to translate product strategy into scalable operational practices that drive alignment, efficiency, and measurable business outcomes. You will establish and continuously improve product operating models, governance frameworks, and cross-functional processes that enable Product, Engineering, Commercial, Marketing, and Customer-facing teams to work effectively toward shared goals. Acting as a trusted partner to stakeholders across the organization, you will drive collaboration, facilitate informed decision-making through data and insights, and ensure clear communication of product priorities, roadmaps, and outcomes. You will lead product enablement initiatives, support successful product launches and adoption, develop performance metrics and reporting frameworks, and identify opportunities to streamline workflows through process optimization and automation. By championing operational excellence, customer-centricity, and continuous improvement, you will help create an environment where product teams can scale efficiently, deliver value consistently, and maximize the impact of the product portfolio. Help us shape the future of communication by: Leading and continuously improving product operations frameworks, governance, and ways of working across Product teams. Owning and optimizing product planning processes, roadmap reviews, prioritization workflows, and operational cadences. Establishing scalable operational practices that improve alignment, transparency, delivery predictability, and execution quality. Driving standardization of product reporting, KPIs, operational dashboards, and decision-support insights. Identifying operational inefficiencies and implementing process improvements to increase team effectiveness and focus. Promoting adoption of AI tools, automation, and operational best practices to improve workflows, reporting, documentation, and knowledge sharing. Partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Commercial, Customer Success, Support, Presales, and Marketing teams to ensure strong operational alignment. Acting as a central point of coordination between business and product organizations. Facilitating communication of product priorities, roadmap updates, launches, and operational initiatives across stakeholders. Supporting leadership teams with operational insights, strategic reporting, and executive-ready communications. Leading Product Enablement initiatives that help internal teams effectively position, support, and adopt product capabilities. Supporting product launches, feature rollouts, demos, and internal readiness activities. Translating complex product functionality into clear messaging, use cases, enablement materials, and customer value narratives. Partnering with Commercial and Marketing teams to improve product awareness, adoption, and customer engagement. Helping identify and remove adoption barriers impacting internal teams or customers. Synthesizing customer feedback, product analytics, sales insights, and market trends into actionable recommendations. Identifying product usage patterns, operational gaps, and growth opportunities that can influence product strategy and commercial outcomes. Supporting Product leadership in defining and tracking success metrics tied to product and operational performance. Contributing to strategic initiatives focused on scaling Product Operations maturity and organizational effectiveness. Requirements What you’ll bring: 5+ years of experience in Product Operations, Product Management, Product Enablement, Product Marketing, Presales, Solution Consulting, or related roles. Proven experience leading or scaling operational processes within Product or SaaS organizations. Strong understanding of product lifecycle management, product delivery processes, and cross-functional collaboration. Experience working closely with Product, Engineering, and Commercial teams in fast-paced environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to translate insights into actionable outcomes. Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills. Demonstrated ability to drive initiatives independently and influence cross-functional teams. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. Experience in SaaS or CPaaS environments is a strong advantage. Craft and Toolkit: Product Operations & Process Optimization Strategic Planning & Execution Cross-Functional Leadership Product Enablement & Adoption Operational Excellence & Governance Data Analysis & Insight Generation Communication & Executive Storytelling Stakeholder Management & Influence Solutioning & Product Demonstrations AI Tools & Workflow Automation Customer-Centric Mindset Proactive, ownership-driven approach Character Traits: Analytical thinking and problem-solving – approach problems clearly, use data, and find solutions. Ownership and accountability – take responsibility and follow projects through to completion. Communication – explain ideas clearly and listen to others across teams. Collaboration – work well with others and support team goals. Adaptability and learning – adjust to change and keep learning new skills or tools. Mentorship and knowledge sharing – help others grow and share what you know. Resilience – stay calm under pressure and handle setbacks constructively. Quality and attention to detail – do work carefully and strive for improvement. Advocacy and innovation – encourage best practices, efficiency, and new ideas As a Unifone you’ll receive a range of benefits: Competitive salary and bonus Unifonic share scheme (we are all owners!) 30 holiday days after the first anniversary Your Birthday off! Spend up to 25 days per year working from anywhere in the world! Paid leave for new parents Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Event Project Manager, Life Sciences (Europe - Remote)
items.summary: Mission – Why we exist, what we do, and why we need youIt takes 15 years to move a single drug from the lab to patients, and a huge share of that journey goes into pharma's pre-launch, launch and commercial activities.
items.description: Mission – Why we exist, what we do, and why we need you It takes 15 years to move a single drug from the lab to patients, and a huge share of that journey goes into pharma's pre-launch, launch and commercial activities. Onomi exists to make pharma and HCP live engagement work better. We give pharma teams one solution to run their in-person and virtual engagements while capturing every interaction in their CRM. We call this “live engagement intelligence” and over 100 pharma companies use our solutions worldwide. By making events easier to manage and measure, we help pharma create better experiences for HCPs, at a lower cost. Our solution turns complex congress engagements, webinars, standalone meetings, advisory boards and field-led meetings into meaningful connections that drive results for commercial and medical teams. This position is the ideal role for an agency/pharma meetings project manager or event/meeting planner with experience in congress/convention or medical education planning and execution, and interested in technology, engagement and analytics. You bring 2+ years of prior experience in congress engagement, KOL and pharma stakeholder management, congress and medical education event project planning and execution. You know the quirks of event approval workflows across Commercial, Medical and Legal Review, not just that they exist, but how they actually slow things down and how to work them. As a Project Manager, Life Sciences with Onomi, your role will be to lead and execute end-to-end congress, webinar, adboard and medical education event projects both onsite and remote. This will involve independently building, configuring and launching our suite of live engagement apps (web, mobile, portal, video, AI) using our SpotMe Backstage Content Management System (30%) . You will be professionally managing our customers, and other senior stakeholders with clear, timely communications to enhance the HCP experience adding value across the entire project lifecycle (20%) . As you approach the live event, you will coordinate closely with stakeholders to ensure seamless execution on event day. You will be training faculty, field sales team, booth staff and agencies, and thoroughly reviewing the event apps to guarantee flawless delivery. You will ensure that onsite technology (interaction tracking with apps, microapps, iPads, badge printers) has been fully configured and tested end-to-end. (20%) . For the live event, your responsibilities may vary depending on the type of modules being used but may include ensuring speakers are fully briefed and prepared, whether they're presenting in a webinar, hosting a virtual session, or speaking onsite at a medical standalone or symposium. You will be responsible for all event operations running smoothly for both virtual and face to face projects (20%) . Following the event, you'll handle post-event communications, analyze event data, and deliver detailed reports, dashboards and recommendations to the customer, highlighting successes and identifying areas for future improvement (10%) . Objectives - The problems you will solve During your 6-month ramp-up period: In your first 3 months, you will onboard, get hands-on with our product and solutions, become familiar with our existing standard operating procedures and get introduced to our services, implementation, product and sales teams. This means you will: Learn Backstage and our product by building and test driving a mobile app and webinar during your first week Building all of your existing and new events in Backstage with minimal supervision , demonstrating quality follow-up emails and no errors in all core modules of the event found during the Project Reviews Getting trained on how we deliver projects at Onomi, develop a deep understanding of the CongressIQ value proposition and experience it by shadowing colleagues in a full project lifecycle in month 1/2 Managing at least 3 complete congress or life science projects end-to-end - including onsite presence for at least 2 events In your first 6 months, you have: Become an advocate for our medical education tactics , successfully influencing faculty members to adopt them Gone global , completing an international onsite project with our Europe/APAC team or one of our Europe/APAC customers Mastered the full Onomi playbook by leading and completing a project in each of our core life sciences use cases: webinar, congress, medical education and advisory board Been consistently recognized by clients for delivering best-in-class contributions that elevated event execution and enhanced overall participant experience and outcomes At 12 months , as a SpotMe product and CongressIQ subject matter expert, you will have grown well beyond delivery into a trusted, multi-format expert who shapes how we run programs: Led an average of ~7 onsite congress or life science projects per quarter (≈28 per year) , or 13 remote projects per quarter , or an equivalent mix Started growing the next generation of PMs , supervising 2-5 projects per quarter alongside junior/associate team members Stepped up to Program Lead on one of our brand engagement programs, owning that program objectives are met and that there is continuity across the life of the program Driven new business , by successfully concluding a meaningful upsell deal through one of your referrals and/or joining at least one business development activity with our sales team (webinar, tradeshow, speaking engagement, or RFP pitch) This role requires frequent travel, out of hours availability and weekend work. About 20 to 40% of your time will be spent traveling onsite. Project planning typically occurs 3-9 weeks in advance, depending on project type. What you need to be great at Congress, meetings and event project management and process workflows with strong industry expertise: you bring deep expertise in pharma meeting and congress planning and execution, whether from agency or corporate backgrounds. You understand pharma priorities at every stage - before, during, and after events - and translate complex workflows into clear, effective standard operating procedures that keep everything running smoothly and aligned with business goals. Building strong stakeholder relationships with a service-driven mindset: you adeptly engage US and EU customers, KOLs, and medical societies by understanding their unique needs - you navigate and plan every interaction with an extreme sense of service, aligning with corporate pharma stakeholders and KOLs. Influence and escalation: you understand how pharma decision-making works and confidently escalate to leadership when necessary to move projects beyond initial hurdles and bypass common delays and objections. Technical dexterity: you have the ability to effectively and confidently deliver practical solutions (build and ship). Balancing compliance with business needs: you can skillfully balance pharma regulatory compliance and legal review processes with business objectives, navigating and resolving potential roadblocks without compromising project momentum. Product-smart: you understand not every customer request translates directly into a feature. You have the ability to generalize needs and prioritize solutions that deliver true value. This role sits at approximately the 2-4 year experience level in event or meeting management - or a closely related function.The total compensation for this role is adjusted based on location, experience and travel frequency. SpotMe recruits, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, parental status, or veteran status. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Level Designer
items.summary: 🧩 Hitapps is a GameDev company specializing in Puzzle Games.
items.description: 🧩 Hitapps is a GameDev company specializing in Puzzle Games. We have several successful products in both categories with a combined total of over 150M+ downloads, and we are regularly featured in the top charts in the Games section. Our culture is built on transparency, we are results-oriented and respect the improvement. Currently, we are in search of a talented Level Designer to drive our new products. Your Role: Design and build levels for mobile games from initial concept to final in-engine implementation; Monitor and interpret level performance metrics; Tune difficulty curves to maintain engagement across player skill segments, balancing challenge with accessibility; Run and participate in playtests; collect, structure, and act on feedback from both internal sessions and real players; Participate in A/B tests on level content and mechanics, analyse results and apply learnings to future designs; Maintain up-to-date level design documentation, style guides, and design rationale for the team; Propose and prototype new challenge types, obstacles, and interactive elements that fit within the game's genre and monetization mode. What makes you a perfect fit? Relevant work experience in similar positions for at least 3 years in the game development industry; Solid understanding of game flow, difficulty progression, and player retention principles; Ability to read analytics dashboards, draw actionable conclusions, and translate them into design changes; Systems thinking: the ability to see a level as an interconnected set of mechanics, pacing beats, and player goals; A portfolio containing shipped levels, paper designs, or documented design rationale — required for consideration; Strong communication skills and comfort working in cross-functional teams with short iteration cycles. What we offer: 💳 Competitive compensation 🏝 100% recovering for vacations, sick leaves; 🚀 12 additional paid day offs per year; 🏆 Budget for personal education, language courses & sports activities; 🌍 Conference attendance: you can join top industry events; 🤝 Zero bureaucracy and a supportive, transparent culture. Let’s create hits together! Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Growth Product Expert - Loyalty
items.summary: About TrafileaTrafilea is a Consumer Tech Platform for Transformative Brand Growth.
items.description: About Trafilea Trafilea is a Consumer Tech Platform for Transformative Brand Growth. We’re building the AI Growth Engine that powers the next generation of consumer brands. With over $1B+ in cumulative revenue, 12M+ customers, and 500+ talents across 19 countries, we combine technology, growth marketing, and operational excellence to scale purpose-driven, digitally native brands. We own and operate our own digitally native brands (not an agency), with presence in Walmart, Nordstrom, and Amazon, and a strong global D2C footprint. Why Trafilea We’re a tech-led eCommerce group scaling our own globally loved DTC brands, while helping ambitious talent grow just as fast. 🚀 We build and scale our own brands. 🦾 We invest in AI and automation like few others in eCom. 📈 We test fast, grow fast, and help you do the same. 🤝 Be part of a dynamic, diverse, and talented global team. 🌍 100% Remote, USD competitive salary, paid time off, and more. Job Responsibilities We’re looking for a creative and results-oriented Growth Product Expert Loyalty to design and deliver hands-on, value-driven experiences that customers engage with on a recurring basis. Our Subscriptions Tribe is responsible for scaling programs like Shapermint Club, Autoship, ShaperBox, and Credits into sustainable, high-performing initiatives that drive recurring revenue, increase order share, and maximize customer lifetime value. As Product Expert Loyalty , you will partner closely with the Subscriptions Tribe to execute initiatives that strengthen retention, optimize subscription funnels, and deliver measurable improvements in churn, repurchase rate, and LTV. Own subscription growth experiments across Club, Autoship, Shaperbox, and Credits, turning hypotheses into MVPs and quick-win pilots. Map and optimize subscription journeys (onboarding, renewal, cancellation) to reduce friction and improve retention. Execute data-driven initiatives with clear KPIs (churn, RR45D, LTV uplift) and share insights through dashboards and reports. Collaborate daily with Product, Marketing, CX, BI, and Tech to align on roadmap priorities and manage dependencies. Design bold retention mechanics and personalization flows based on customer feedback, cohort analysis, and behavioral signals. Drive influencer/ambassador-style engagement by ensuring community-driven and loyalty mechanics connect with customer needs. Run agile practices (sprints, stand-ups, retros) to keep squads accountable and reduce operational load for Tribe leadership. Prioritize and scale successful pilots into playbooks for global markets (US, CA, UK, AU), fueling recurring revenue growth. Requirements 4-6 years of experience in Growth/Product in e-commerce or SaaS. Strong growth-marketing mindset: designs hypotheses, tests quickly, iterates weekly. Fluent in cohort analysis, dashboards, churn, and retention metrics. Execution-driven: hands-on with no-code pilots, flow-building, and CRM triggers. Strong collaboration in cross-functional squads. Clear communication: async documentation and storytelling with data. Exposure to subscriptions or loyalty; deeper technical/financial skills to be built on the job. Basic agile methodology knowledge with willingness to own squad leadership practices. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: Headquarters: Western Cape, Cape Town, 8000 South Africa About Lifecheq Lifecheq is transforming financial advice and insurance distribution across emerging markets through our cutting-edge technology platform. As Africa's largest advice platform, we empower over 8,000 financial advisers to deliver holistic, personalised financial planning to the u
items.description: Management and Finance Headquarters: Western Cape, Cape Town, 8000 South Africa About Lifecheq Lifecheq is transforming financial advice and insurance distribution across emerging markets through our cutting-edge technology platform. As Africa's largest advice platform, we empower over 8,000 financial advisers to deliver holistic, personalised financial planning to the underserved mass affluent market. Our holistic financial advice platform has achieved remarkable results in driving record adviser productivity for our partners. Backed by leading investors, we're expanding across Africa and Southeast Asia – with a mission to create one million sustainable middle-income jobs for financial advisers. The Opportunity Own the execution of initiatives that drive adviser productivity - moving more advisers from the mid band into the productive band, and keeping productive advisers there. What You'll Do Work with your Group Product Manager to translate product strategy and experiment priorities into well-scoped tickets, timelines, and delivered features. Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the adviser productivity funnel - know how many advisers are in each band, what is moving them up, and where they are getting stuck. Develop and maintain a view of your key metrics and build instrumentation into the products you manage so you have an ongoing view of performance; know when a number looks wrong before it is flagged to you. Gather ongoing feedback from advisers and managers directly; build the observational habits to understand where the pipeline is failing and bring findings to the Group PM with a point of view, not just a summary. Own the alert and nudge pipeline end to end - template creation, regulatory approval submissions, staging tests, production deployment, and delivery quality - ensuring advisers receive the right recommendations reliably. Manage rollout logistics for new features: determine sequencing, verify adviser access across branches and regions, and troubleshoot activation issues. Set up experiment infrastructure as directed by the Group PM - cohort assignment, data feeds, template creation, tracking configuration - and take responsibility for data quality and delivery reliability throughout the experiment window. Compile clean experiment data packages for the Group PM to analyse and interpret; manage the operational handoff when successful experiments move to production. Work with lead engineers to coordinate delivery sequencing, dependencies, and deployment schedules; maintain a well-groomed backlog with clear acceptance criteria and flag risks early with a proposed solution attached. Take responsibility for the business outcomes of the initiatives you run: if adviser productivity is not moving, understand why and bring a plan to address it. Ensure automated reports are accurate and distributed reliably; maintain product analytics dashboards and coordinate data logistics with external partners. What We're Looking For You have a four-year degree or equivalent You are an analytical, data-driven, critical thinker who can unpack a problem clearly, develop and communicate a hypotheses, frame experiments and test them rigorously You have had some exposure to a commercial or customer facing role; you are very open to interacting with customers and financial advisers regularly, and are passionate about using technology to solve problems You can communicate well with team members and stakeholders on deliverables and approach, demonstrating the ability to communicate and listen appropriately depending on the audience. We expect a good grounding in effective written communication in a technical context You strive for success, are keen to learn and develop, are collaborative with a can-do attitude, and can build positive relationships You have business acumen and have a grasp of the key concepts of how a business makes money, and you enjoy seeing your work make a tangible business impact You are experienced with and are comfortable engaging with senior executives at large and small companies - you’d be quite okay being asked to give a presentation to execs at a listed company in your first three months of work. items.summary: The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative was founded in 2015 by Priscilla Chan and Mark Zuckerberg to harness the power of technology to pursue some of society’s most ambitious goals — from curing or preventing all disease to transforming how students learn. At CZI, you’ll join a deeply collaborative, mission-driven community where your work helps drive brea
items.description: The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative was founded in 2015 by Priscilla Chan and Mark Zuckerberg to harness the power of technology to pursue some of society’s most ambitious goals — from curing or preventing all disease to transforming how students learn. At CZI, you’ll join a deeply collaborative, mission-driven community where your work helps drive breakthroughs across our flagship nonprofit organizations, Biohub and Learning Commons. Whether enabling scientific breakthroughs via open science and AI-powered biology or strengthening the tools teachers and students rely on every day, your contributions help turn bold ideas into real-world impact. Our teams operate at the intersection of innovation and scale, building the infrastructure, partnerships, and capabilities that allow scientists, educators, and innovators to tackle some of the most complex challenges of our time — and to do so with urgency, integrity, and optimism. The Team The Operations team is a key partner in enabling Biohub’s pioneering work to combine frontier AI with frontier biology to solve disease and Learning Commons’ mission to build AI infrastructure that aligns how students learn with the tools that shape their learning experiences. Operations includes our Central Tech, Finance, Marketing & Communications, People, and Real Estate / Workplace / Events / Facilities / Security (REWFS) teams. Together, these teams create the systems, programs, and experiences that empower our partners and colleagues across Biohub and Learning Commons to drive impact. This work requires strategic and operational rigor, creativity, and deep collaboration. Whether designing world-class employee experiences, safeguarding data and infrastructure, or shaping how we communicate our impact, Operations plays a critical role in helping deliver meaningful change at scale. The Opportunity We’re looking for a Project Manager, Marketing to help run how our team operates day to day. You’ll manage the systems, processes, and workflows — from intake and prioritization to project tracking — that let us ship creative and production work efficiently, at a high bar of quality, and at scale. This role reports to the Marketing Operations Lead, within the broader Marketing & Communications organization. The ideal person for this role thinks in systems. You see a manual, repeatable task and know how to build an AI-assisted workflow that makes it faster and more reliable. You bring real judgment about how a creative team should operate, and you’re comfortable working without a blueprint — you’ll help figure out what processes the team needs and why, then build them. What You’ll Do Systems & Process Build and maintain the systems — intake, project tracking, approvals, asset and file management — that keep the team running Identify where AI can automate repetitive or manual work, from intake triage to status reporting, and build those workflows Document workflows and playbooks so processes scale beyond any one person Project & Workflow Management Run day-to-day project management across the team’s creative and production work: intake, prioritization, timelines, and status tracking Spot bottlenecks before they become blockers, and help redesign the process, not just patch the symptom Keep multiple projects moving in parallel without letting details slip Cross-Functional Coordination Serve as the point of contact for teams submitting creative and production requests Coordinate timelines and dependencies across creative, content, and partner teams Maintain dashboards and reporting on capacity and project status Events Support logistics and planning for brand-related events, activations, or offsites as needed What You’ll Bring 5+ years of experience in project management, marketing operations, or a similarly operational role, ideally supporting a brand, creative, or communications function Proven experience building or deploying AI-powered tools or workflows that reduced manual work — you can point to specific things you’ve built, not just tools you’ve used Highly organized and detail-oriented; you catch the things others miss Self-motivated with strong follow-through; comfortable creating structure and process where none exists yet Collaborative and easy to work with across a range of stakeholders and working styles Strong written and verbal communication skills Comfort working with project management/collaboration tools (e.g., Notion, Airtable, Jira) Event planning or logistics experience is a plus Compensation The Redwood City, CA base pay range for a new hire in this role is $138,000- $189,200. New hires are typically hired into the lower portion of the range, enabling employee growth in the range over time. Actual placement in range is based on job-related skills and experience, as evaluated throughout the interview process. This position may be eligible to participate in our discretionary annual performance bonus program. Bonus eligibility and targets are determined in accordance with our total rewards philosophy and may vary by role. Better Together As we grow, we’re excited to strengthen in-person connections and cultivate a collaborative, team-oriented environment. This role is a hybrid position requiring you to be onsite for at least 60% of the working month, approximately 3 days a week, with specific in-office days determined by the team’s manager. The exact schedule will be at the hiring manager’s discretion and communicated during the interview process. Benefits for the Whole You We’re thankful to have an incredible team behind our work. To honor their commitment, we offer a wide range of benefits to support the people who make all we do possible. Provides a generous employer match on employee 401(k) contributions to support planning for the future. Paid time off to volunteer at an organization of your choice. Funding for select family-forming benefits. Relocation support for employees who need assistance moving If you’re interested in a role but your previous experience doesn’t perfectly align with each qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply as you may be the perfect fit for this or another role. #LI-Hybrid

items.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
items.summary: We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our team!
items.description: We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our team! You will own and evolve Mailtrap's production infrastructure — a multi-region AWS platform powering high-volume email sending and testing. You will keep it reliable, secure, and cost-efficient day to day. You will also lead a key strategic initiative: planning and executing a partial migration of selected workloads from AWS to rented bare-metal / colocation infrastructure to cut costs — a hybrid-by-design effort, not a full cloud exit. You will decide what moves and what stays, design the target platform (likely Kubernetes or a similar orchestrator on bare metal), and own the migration end to end, from business case to cutover. Our engineering team thrives in an agile, continuously improving, and automation-oriented environment. We value ongoing evolution, objective evaluation of our processes, and taking action to make things better. Must have skills 5+ years DevOps/platform (senior), production ownership Deep AWS (VPC, ECS, IAM, RDS/ElastiCache or equivalents, networking) Terraform at scale (modules, remote state / Terraform Cloud) CI/CD with GitHub Actions, including automated deploys to production (e.g. blue/green deployments) Containers (Docker); comfortable operating services on ECS or K8s Strong Linux networking (DNS, TLS, load balancing, firewalls, VPN/hybrid) Proven experience planning and executing migration to on-prem, colo, or private cloud (partial/hybrid OK — full exit not required) Comfortable owning a multi-quarter infra initiative: TCO, design, vendors, cutover, rollback Comfortable automating operational tasks with shell and/or Python Fluent English (both spoken and written) Strongly preferred Colo/bare-metal ops: IPAM (NetBox), Ansible, image-based provisioning (Packer or equivalent), HAProxy/Nginx Replacing managed AWS services with self-hosted (Postgres HA, Redis/Valkey, Kafka, OpenSearch) Email infrastructure (MTA, SMTP, IP reputation, DKIM/SPF/DMARC) — Halon or similar Cloudflare (DNS/WAF/Access) Observability beyond CloudWatch (Prometheus/Grafana/Loki or equivalent) Prior work with multi-region SaaS or EU data residency Cost-driven architecture / FinOps mindset Would be a plus GCP (BigQuery/certificates) Comfortable reading Ruby or Go (used in our services and tooling) AWS Certificates Responsibilities day-to-day Operate and evolve AWS multi-account / multi-region infra Terraform modules/workspaces Ensure safe infrastructure changes across network, storage, and services, with zero-downtime deployments. ECS services, blue/green deploys, Docker image pipelines Reliability: CloudWatch/PagerDuty/Sentry, capacity, cost tags Security baseline: IAM, secrets (SSM), Cloudflare edge rules Partner with engineers on release automation and production readiness Maintain the hybrid estate (AWS and rented bare metal) as one operable platform Migration leadership Build the business and technical case for what moves off AWS vs what stays Design the rented bare-metal / colo landing zone (compute, network, storage, observability, secrets) Produce migration waves, dependency maps, cutover/rollback plans Stand up hybrid connectivity and dual-run periods; shift traffic safely (e.g. via Cloudflare) Replace or re-home managed services where it pays off (compute, queues, search, cache, MTA nodes) Coordinate colo/vendors, timelines, and eng teams; report progress and risk Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Associate Director, Early Commercial Strategy & Insights
items.summary: About UsWe are developing potentially best in class therapies for patients living with severe autoimmune diseases.
items.description: About Us We are developing potentially best in class therapies for patients living with severe autoimmune diseases. Our lead antibody, claseprubart (DNTH103), is purposefully engineered with extended half-life, improved potency, and high selectivity for only the active C1s complement protein that drives disease pathology – enabling less frequent and more convenient self-administered subcutaneous injections. Our second clinical candidate, DNTH212 is a first and potentially best in class, bifunctional inhibitor that targets clinically validated and complementary disease modifying mechanisms, Type 1 IFN suppression and B cell modulation – enabling potential for improved clinical outcomes and patient friendly convenient, self-administered subcutaneous injections. To learn more, please visit www.dianthustx.com and follow us on LinkedIn. About the Role The Associate Director, Early Commercial Strategy and Insights will be responsible for helping to develop and execute the commercial insights strategy for Dianthus’ programs, DNTH212 and clauseprubart, across multiple autoimmune and rare disease indications. This includes generating actionable market insights, competitive intelligence, forecasting, and strategic recommendations to support development and commercialization planning for DNTH212 in SLE, Sjögrens syndrome, and Dermatomyositis, as well as claseprubart in Myasthenia Gravis (MG), Chronic Inflammatory, Demyelinating Polyneuropathy (CIDP), and Mutifocal Motor Neuropathy (MMN). Reporting to the Senior Director, you will be a key member of a growing commercial organization, partnering closely with cross functional teams to shape development strategy, assess market opportunities, and support critical business decisions across both programs. We are building a culture of individuals who hold our core principles at the center of our operations, with the goal to elevate the care of our patients’ lives. We are open to you working remotely. Key Responsibilities Lead competitive intelligence related to the DNTH212 program – providing relevant and timely information to both the DNTH212 project team and to Dianthus leadership. Develop and execute a plan to develop a solid understanding of the dynamics underlying key potential markets, including pipeline development, current treatment and likely positioning of future treatments. Lead development of well-built and fact-based forecasting models for each indication. Work with the commercial and cross-functional project team to build out the commercial narratives around claseprubart and DNTH212– aimed at investors, patients and physicians Support lifecycle planning, indication prioritization, and portfolio strategy for both DNTH 212 and claseprubart. Contribute to market insights development for claseprubart and take part in building out the market insights function at Dianthus Experience Bachelor’s degree is required. Advanced degree in life-sciences is strongly preferred. Must have substantial education in a field relevant to medicine Experience with rheumatology and/or neurology is strongly preferred Experience and proficiency analyzing and synthesizing data and information from multiple sources to create a clear and concise story is required Must have strong communication skills and comfort with presentation to executive leadership Experience conducting market research – including development of surveys, study-guides etc. is required Proficiency with MS Excel and experience building forecasts is required Experience with claims data analysis and/or EHR analysis preferred Experience conducting/moderating KOL interviews strongly preferred Originally posted on Himalayas

This combined department of ~50 staff are responsible for working with a wide range of medical record requestors (insurance companies, attorneys, and their retrieval agents) with a mix of high touch account management for the high-volume requestors and a long tail mass touch approach for long tail of low volume requestors. Key metrics and activities that this role will be responsible for include: measuring and tracking Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) by cohort, percent of request volume actively managed, enhancing the monthly billing and statement process, maintaining unapplied cash at a 3-day level, and bringing more automation/technology to this function. This role is intentionally hands-on and detail-oriented, requiring deep engagement in daily collections activity, aging trends, customer disputes, and cash forecasting. In a private-equity-backed environment, this leader is expected to operate as a player-coach who can personally diagnose issues, drive execution, and hold teams accountable for results. Duties & Responsibilities: Hands-On Accounts Receivable Leadership & DSO Ownership (Primary Mandate), with Cash Applications and Requestor Management as secondary mandates Own enterprise-wide accounts receivable (AR) performance with direct, personal accountability for DSO reduction, and past-due aging Engage directly in weekly aging reviews, top delinquent account analysis, and high-risk customer situations Design and enforce disciplined collections operating rhythms, including daily, weekly, and monthly execution cadences Define, track, and actively manage KPIs including DSO, aging mix, Collection Effectiveness Index (CEI), dispute cycle time, and billing accuracy Lead hands-on improvements across collections, billing accuracy, cash application, and dispute workflows. Ensure improvements are embedded into daily execution, not just documented in policy Expand and mature the requestor management/data integrity process and team including management of sales tax-exempt requestors Partner with R&D team to design AR/collections modules within our platform Oversee daily cash application activities for all payment channels, including ACH, wire transfers, lockbox, credit cards, checks, and electronic payment platforms Ensure timely and accurate posting of customer and requestor payments to accounts receivable. items.description: At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. Overview We are looking for a strategic, hands-on leader to own ClickUp's organic growth engine at the forefront of the AI Search era. You will bring deep SEO fundamentals, but this is not a traditional Director role. The landscape has shifted, and this position is responsible for defining ClickUp's acquisition strategy across modern discovery systems, building the team and workflows to execute it, and setting the standard for how brands show up across AI-powered surfaces. Our goal is to lead in AI visibility, backed by real investment, executive buy-in, and the autonomy to move fast. You will own how ClickUp is discovered across Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and emerging answer engines. You'll translate market shifts into focused strategy, build AI-powered systems that multiply your team's output, and influence cross-functional partners across Engineering, Content, Product Marketing, and Analytics to rally behind organic growth. This role is equal parts strategist, operator, and pioneer. The Role Own ClickUp's organic acquisition strategy across Google Search, LLMs, communities, review platforms, and emerging discovery surfaces, evolving it for an agentic and LLM-first landscape. Build AI-powered workflows and agents to automate everything from content creation to complex analytical assessments, championing experimentation and AI-first ways of working. Build and manage strategic external partnerships (AI platforms, review ecosystems, third-party publishers) and guide internal teams across Reddit, G2, YouTube, etc. to maximize ClickUp's organic presence. Partner closely with Engineering, Performance Marketing, Content, Product Marketing, and Analytics as a deeply cross-functional leader who also executes. Lead ClickUp's technical SEO oversight, including site architecture, structured data, and international SEO. Develop measurement frameworks and use data to prioritize initiatives, identify growth opportunities, and communicate performance to executive leadership. Act as the organic growth product owner for web engineering priorities: scoping technical projects, defining requirements, and owning the SEO roadmap alongside the web platform team Own oversight of the content portfolio: defining scalable strategies across editorial, programmatic, localization, and product-led experiences while managing pruning, consolidation, and quality governance at scale. Qualifications 8+ years in SEO or organic growth at scale, including 3+ years in a leadership role (B2B SaaS preferred) Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to separate signal from noise, question assumptions, connect findings to business impact, and communicate recommendations with confidence and candor. Deep understanding of AI-powered search experiences and LLMs, with hands-on experience measuring AI visibility, citations, and LLM referral traffic using tools like Peec, AirOps, Profound, or Scrunch. Demonstrated experience building AI-powered workflows to automate processes, improve decision-making, and increase team leverage. Experience managing direct reports and building small, high-output teams that punch above their weight. Track record of building custom measurement and attribution frameworks, including dashboards and reporting (Hex, Looker Studio), particularly in emerging channels (like AEO) where standardized methodology doesn't exist yet. Deep expertise in technical SEO, information architecture, content strategy, and on-site optimization. Low ego, high candor, and a bias toward action. You'd rather ship an imperfect experiment than wait for perfect data. Desirable Background in or exposure to CRO, particularly where organic acquisition and on-site conversion intersect. Experience leading international SEO and localization strategies. Deep technical understanding of how LLMs work end-to-end: from query interpretation to retrieval to output generation, and how that knowledge informs optimization strategy Experience architecting multi-property domain strategies to expand organic reach beyond a core brand site. Experience building and deploying AI agents, working with MCPs, and an obsession with automating as much of the workflow as possible to multiply output. items.description: Intelance is building a trusted associate team for identity governance and access control work in regulated and complex organisations. We are looking for a Senior IGA Consultant to turn access evidence into clear findings, practical access rules and delivery ready actions. The first likely assignment supports a financial services client reviewing who can see and change sensitive client information across Microsoft, data and business platforms. This is an associate contract. Work is assigned through paid work orders after client approval. The first assignment is expected to be a focused number of delivery days, with the possibility of later pilot, access review and recurring governance work. Tasks Working with the Engagement Director and Principal IAM Consultant, you will: • Analyse user, group, role, permission and service account exports. • Reconcile technical access with the business reason for access. • Identify broad, stale, direct and conflicting access, and record the evidence for each point. • Carry out role mining and draft role and access matrices. • Test joiner, role change and leaver controls, including where old access is removed. • Draft clear findings that state the system, affected access, evidence, risk and required decision. • Support access reviews and certification so business owners can make informed decisions. • Review privileged accounts, service accounts and integration identities. • Support access testing for Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, SharePoint and connected business systems. • Maintain the findings register, evidence record and implementation backlog. • Support pilot testing and confirm that completed changes match the approved design. You will not be expected to act as the overall design authority. The Principal IAM Consultant owns the target access design and final technical challenge. Requirements Essential: • Strong recent experience delivering identity governance or access control work in a complex organisation. • Hands on experience analysing users, groups, roles, permissions and access grants. • Practical role mining and role based access control experience. • Experience designing or operating access reviews, certification and recertification. • Experience testing joiner, role change and leaver controls. • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory. • Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and SharePoint permissions. • Experience reviewing privileged accounts, service accounts or integration access. • Able to write short, evidence based findings in plain English. • Comfortable working independently from source records and recorded interviews. • Based in the United Kingdom and available during UK business hours. • Available for short, clearly scoped assignments that may grow after client approval. Strong advantage: • Experience in financial services, investment management or another regulated business. • Experience with Snowflake or another cloud data platform. • Experience with SailPoint, Saviynt or another identity governance platform. • Experience of segregation of duties analysis. • Experience reviewing AI tools or connectors that can reach company information. • Relevant Microsoft identity, SailPoint, Saviynt, CISSP, CISM or ISO 27001 certification. Please apply only if you have personally analysed access evidence and turned it into findings or role design. General project coordination or user administration alone is not enough. Benefits • Indicative rate of £425 to £500 per day, depending on the assignment and depth of relevant experience. • Fully remote work within the United Kingdom. • Clear work orders, agreed days and defined outputs before each assignment starts. • Direct access to the Engagement Director and Principal IAM Consultant. • Focused work on real access problems in regulated organisations. • Potential follow on work across design, pilot delivery, access reviews and recurring governance. • Prompt payment against agreed timesheets and completed work. Please submit your CV and answer the application questions fully. We will first check whether your recent work matches the evidence analysis and role design needed. Suitable candidates will then have a short screening call and a structured technical discussion based on a real access scenario. This is an associate opportunity. No minimum number of days is guaranteed. Each assignment is subject to client approval, an agreed work order and confirmed delivery dates. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Self-driven and collaborative, with a track record of contributing to high-impact research projects. Bachelor’s degree or higher in Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, or a related field. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with the development or evaluation of rubrics, especially for AI and data annotation workflows. Familiarity with designing datasets or protocols for AI training and human review processes. Previous collaboration with interdisciplinary or remote teams on data-driven biology projects. Facilitate impactful workshops with Hosts and their teams that establish strong foundations in community design, content cadence, and engagement strategy. Deliver targeted training on feature utilization, member onboarding flows, and tactical programming to drive adoption, activation, and retention. Provide creative input and feedback on brand elements like landing pages, welcome experiences, email sequences, and network messaging to ensure a cohesive and compelling member journey. Own the development and delivery of strategic Community Design Plans—including network architecture, monthly themes, onboarding flows, and launch programming calendars. Collaborate closely with Launch Specialists and Implementation teams, providing timely information and handling lightweight setup tasks directly where appropriate. Ensure clarity, consistency, and excellence in the execution of space configuration, access structure, and end-to-end member experience. Maintain regular updates to internal stakeholders on Host performance, needs, risks, and outcomes—contributing to visibility and cross-functional alignment. Contribute to shared knowledge across the Customer Success team by capturing and scaling best practices, identifying emerging trends, and improving playbooks. What We're Looking For 6+ years of client-facing experience, ideally working with strategic accounts or supporting 5–6 figure engagements in a SaaS, media, or creator-focused business. 2+ years experience in a consulting, business coaching, or agency role. Strategic thinker and tactical executor—you can map out long-term plans, define metrics for success, and follow through on details to deliver. Deep understanding of community-building and digital member experiences; you’re passionate about helping others create belonging at scale. Excellent communicator and facilitator, with confidence in guiding executive teams through planning, decision-making, and feedback cycles. Master of meetings—you show up with a plan, gather input with nuance, read the room, and close with clear decisions and next steps. Adaptable and proactive, energized by growth and ambiguity, and always seeking ways to streamline and improve. Highly collaborative and cross-functional, thriving when working across CS, Implementation, Product, and Strategy to elevate outcomes. Radically curious, with a growth mindset and drive to keep learning about Hosts, their businesses, and how digital communities are evolving. What We Offer A dynamic, remote-first work culture that values creativity, autonomy, and bold thinking. Comprehensive benefits, including health, vision, dental, and generous paid time off. Clear opportunities for professional growth, including leadership pathways and skill development support. The chance to shape the future of how communities, creators, and brands thrive online—with the team that’s building what’s next. Join us in shaping the future of community-driven digital businesses with Mighty Pro! Compensation: The base salary for this role ranges from $80,000–$145,000, with exact compensation based on location, experience, and cost of living. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: Role Title: GIS/geospatial ExpertRole Type: ContractorLocation: Remotemicro1 is engaging GIS/geospatial Experts to contribute their domain insights to a forward-thinking customer project.
items.description: Role Title: GIS/geospatial Expert Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote micro1 is engaging GIS/geospatial Experts to contribute their domain insights to a forward-thinking customer project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. We're seeking current STEM professionals with hands-on experience using advanced AI coding agents, particularly those who can demonstrate the application of these agents in technical, real-world geospatial work. Effective written and verbal communication is essential, as you’ll be capturing complex workflows and describing innovative problem-solving strategies. Scope of Work Provide expert analysis, feedback, and practical examples related to GIS and geospatial data challenges for AI model development. Document advanced technical workflows and problem-solving approaches that utilize AI agents such as Codex, Claude Science, Claude Code, and Claude Cowork. Deliver detailed descriptions of tasks where AI coding agents have been used to generate sequences, not merely as chat interfaces, including project context, tool selection, and results. Evaluate and critique the performance of AI-generated solutions in addressing sophisticated geospatial scenarios like large codebase navigation, debugging, end-to-end feature development, and architectural changes. Share real-world cases where ambiguity or scale presented unique technical hurdles, and outline how AI agentics facilitated solutions. Collaborate asynchronously with project stakeholders to iteratively refine documentation and guidance materials. Contribute to the development of high-fidelity datasets and evaluations for AI training and benchmarking initiatives. Preferred Qualifications Demonstrated expertise in GIS, remote sensing, spatial analytics, or related geospatial technologies. Direct, hands-on experience using AI coding agents (specifically Codex, Claude Science, Claude Code, Claude Cowork) to solve technical challenges within GIS or STEM projects. Clear, concise written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical processes and reasoning for both technical and non-technical audiences. Track record of using AI coding agents for complex scenarios—such as navigating large codebases, debugging, designing end-to-end features, or addressing ambiguous project requirements. Experience generating and analyzing AI-driven code sequences, rather than using agents solely for conversational purposes. Background in STEM fields, preferably with ongoing professional engagement in technical geospatial work. Analytical mindset paired with a passion for sharing knowledge and improving technical systems through innovative approaches. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Design Headquarters: New York URL: http://Loosegrip.net Bring the ideas. Polish the pixels. Make campaigns pop. At LooseGrip, we're a boutique digital consultancy that transforms brands through data-inspired storytelling and performance marketing. We're looking for a Junior Designer to support our digital marketing campaigns-someone with a strong eye, a curious mind, and the hustle to turn briefs into beautifully executed visuals. This is a part-time contract role with flexible hours and real opportunities to grow alongside a tight-knit team. What You'll Do Design for the scroll. Create on-brand social graphics, paid ad creative, email assets, and landing page visuals for a range of digital marketing campaigns. Bring briefs to life. Translate creative direction and campaign goals into clean, compelling design that drives engagement and performance. Stay on brand. Work within established brand systems, applying guidelines consistently across formats, channels, and clients. Iterate fast. Take feedback in stride, refine quickly, and produce multiple variations to support A/B testing and campaign optimization. Collaborate seamlessly. Partner with strategists, copywriters, and client experience managers to ensure every asset hits the mark. What You Bring A solid portfolio. You have 1-3 years of design experience (internships and freelance count) with samples that show range across digital marketing formats. Design tool fluency. You're at home in Figma and the Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), including motion basics (After Effects, Premiere Pro). Bonus points for familiarity with email design tools. AI curiosity and comfort. You're proficient in AI tools for ideation and efficiency (and know when to reach for them), but your instincts as a designer are always in the driver's seat. A digital-first eye. You understand how design works in feeds, inboxes, and ad placements and you design with the end platform in mind. Attention to detail. Typography, alignment, color, export specs-you sweat the small stuff because you know it adds up. A self-starter mindset. You're a grown-ass adult who manages your time well, asks smart questions, moves work forward independently, and communicates well asynchronously and virtually with teammates through tools like ClickUp, Figma reviews, and Slack chats. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/loosegrip-junior-designer-part-time-contract

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote US Company Description At Amwell, we’re transforming healthcare for all—powered by technology and inspired by people. Here, your ideas don’t just matter—they drive real change, improving lives on a global scale. We marry technology and innovation with clinical excellence to provide trusted solutions that solve the healthcare industry’s biggest pain points and are on a mission to enable greater access to more convenient, affordable, and effective care. We do this through our technology-enabled care platform that is designed to help our clients achieve their digital care ambitions – today and in the future. We offer programs spanning the full care continuum , including urgent, acute and specialty care, behavioral health, and services for the treatment of chronic conditions such as heart and cardiometabolic diseases. Programs are powered by Amwell as well as our growing partner network. For almost two decades, Amwell has proudly served some of the largest and most sophisticated healthcare organizations in the U.S. and worldwide. Our team is passionate about technology’s role in transforming care delivery and making it more equitable, accessible, efficient, cost-effective and navigable for all. Brief Overview The Account Director, Clinical Program Engagement will play a critical role in the success of Amwell's relationship with assigned Payer Accounts. Success will be measured by client growth in new business, retention, client satisfaction, optimizing program utilization, outcomes, and the financial performance of the overall suite of clinical programs. The primary initial focus of the role will be to develop relationships with assigned Payer Accounts, Brokers, Consultants, and Health Plan Account Executives to successfully expand adoption, enrollment and engagement in Amwell's products and services. The role requires a seasoned individual contributor that can “roll up their sleeves” and take a direct approach to grow the business. A successful person in this role is an experienced, energetic sales and account management professional and strategist adept in operational excellence, clinical, professional acumen, and the ability to develop and deploy strategic account and employer specific marketing plans to drive towards our stated success metrics. Extensive task management around deliverables, execution of deployment/new launches, account planning, program demonstrations, marketing plans, reporting, QBRs, and internally interfacing and coordinating with finance, marketing, clinical and product resources to support the client. In addition, this role is the day-to-day liaison with the third-party clinical program partners, holding those partners accountable to execute on the engagement plans and to follow the “rules of engagement” with the Amwell client. The Account Director, Clinical Program Engagement will be assigned specific client accounts, seamlessly interface and gain the trust of clients at all levels, and lead the internal Amwell team through pre and post-sale of commercial accounts, implementations, post go-live, marketing campaigns, reporting and expansion of the existing relationship. Frequent interaction with the Amwell executive sponsor and other Amwell leads to keep the entire team apprised of client strategies, goals, objectives, and tactical developments is essential. This key position will be focused on client satisfaction and program usage/revenue growth. This revenue growth will be accomplished by maximizing the number of programs deployed, expanding awareness of program availability within the account, adoption and utilization of the company’s existing products, programs, and services within and by identifying new opportunities for growth and expansion. Specifically, the Account Director, Clinical Program Engagement will: Core Responsibilities · Collaborate and partner with internal and external assigned account teams to develop a strategic and tactical plan to achieve desired sales, engagement and growth targets · Responsible for the sale of Amwell’s core products and clinical programs within key accounts. · Work with third party clinical program partners in the interest of your assigned accounts and support open enrollment and or benefit fairs both in person and remote. · Effectively support implementation and nurture accounts to ensure optimal performance and success of Clinical Partner Programs through or third-party partners · Understand business objectives and vision; share those objectives with the Amwell team · Deep understanding of Health Plans, benefit structures and how Amwell’s products and programs may be implemented and leveraged by the client · Ability to leverage data analysis to identify emerging trends, opportunities for success, and areas needing attention. · Provide input and suggestions to marketing teams based on client feedback · Lead presentations and on-site visits with assigned accounts · Maintain professional internal and external relationships with both the payer account team and the ASO employer benefit team that reflect the core values of Amwell · Develop specific plans on how to grow existing accounts, maintaining a best practice template and guiding each ASO employer toward it. · Demonstrate service excellence · 10-25% travel required Qualifications · A strong background in working for or with health plans and employers · Ideal candidate has experience selling, managing, and marketing condition management programs · Excellent presentation skills · Skilled relationship developer · Possess strong planning and organization skills, · Background in account management, marketing, program management · Comfortable dealing with and managing in an extremely fluid, fast-paced environment. · BS Degree required. 7-10 years’ prior experience working with or for health plans. An ideal candidate will have sold technology products or related services to health plan executives · A solid background in healthcare is a must Do Well. Live Well. At Amwell. Driven by our mission and values, we foster a workplace where Delivering Awesome, being Customer First and operating as One Team aren’t just aspirations – they are how we work, every day. Our people are our greatest asset. We strive to empower their growth and development not only as Amwellians but as individuals, through generous total rewards packages, a virtual-first work environment, work-life flexibility, including Summer Fridays and designated Mental Health Days, as well as opportunities to stretch and learn – to name a few. It’s our people who truly differentiate us. Ask anyone and they’ll tell you – you’ll never work with more passionate, more driven and more caring team members. We champion a culture of respect and inclusion, accountability and integrity, innovation and collaboration. At Amwell, you’ll do the most meaningful work of your career—improving healthcare for millions, growing alongside incredible teammates, and being valued for who you are. Benefits Flexible Personal Time Off (Vacation time) 401K match Competitive healthcare, dental and vision insurance plans Paid Parental Leave (Maternity and Paternity leave) Employee Stock Purchase Program Free access to Amwell’s Telehealth Services, SilverCloud and The Clinic by Cleveland Clinic’s second opinion program Free Subscription to the Calm App Tuition Assistance Program Pet Insurance Salaried, Exempt Roles The typical base salary range for this position is $120,000 - $180,000. The actual salary offer will ultimately depend on multiple factors including, but not limited to, knowledge, skills, relevant education, experience, complexity or specialization of talent, and other objective factors. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for an annual bonus based on a combination of company performance and employee performance. Long-term incentive and short-term variable compensation may be offered as part of the compensation package dependent on the role. Some roles may be commission based, in which case the total compensation will be based on a commission and the above range may not be an accurate representation of total compensation. Further, the above range is subject to change based on market demands and operational needs and does not constitute a promise of a particular wage or a guarantee of employment. Your recruiter can share more during the hiring process about the specific salary range based on the above factors listed. https://business.amwell.com/company/privacy-notice-applicants Privacy Notice To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/amwell-sr-account-director
