items.description: This is a contract position open exclusively to candidates who are located in and legally authorized to provide services in Canada. Applications from candidates located outside of Canada will not be considered. About Our Company Kanopi Studios is a Design, Development & Support Agency with a fully distributed team of experts in Drupal & WordPress. Our clients are mission-driven - and so are we. We design , build , and support websites that help their missions thrive. We believe the people behind the work matter just as much as the work itself. That’s why we’re deeply committed to supporting our team’s growth, well-being, and success. When our people thrive, our clients do too - and together, we build a web that works better for everyone. As Kanopi continues to grow, we’re looking to engage a Contract Senior Website Content Strategist & Copywriter on a contract basis. About The Job Kanopi Studios is seeking a Contract Senior Website Content Strategist & Copywriter who can turn research and data into clear, effective website content experiences. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable developing content strategy and writing the final copy. They can take a project from discovery and research through strategy, content development and implementation. They should be able to clearly communicate and demonstrate the rationale behind their recommendations to internal and client teams. Core Accountabilities Champion User-Centered Content Strategy Be a vocal advocate for user-first content practices within our internal and client teams. Ensure content decisions are rooted in user research, accessibility best practices, and business goals. Guide clients in understanding how content impacts navigation, usability, and conversions. Craft Strategic, Accessible Copy Write engaging copy that: Aligns to the overall content strategy and project goals. Meets established accessibility standards Is SEO and AEO ready Lead Content Discovery and Strategy Plan, create, and present a range of deliverables including (but not limited to): Content Audits & Map/Gap Analyses User Journeys, Personas & User Flows Keyword, SEO & AEO Research and Recommendations Content Maps Copy Guidelines, Voice/Tone Frameworks & UX Copywriting Content governance documentation Contribute to Kanopi’s Brand and Sales Presence Support the internal teams by contributing to thought leadership and promotional initiatives such as: Being an active participant and voice for creative services in client pitch meetings Webinars, case studies, and speaking engagements Writing blog posts or participating in video content Representing Kanopi at conferences or industry events About the Compensation and Work Requirements This is an independent contractor engagement. Work is project-based, hours will vary, and no minimum hours are guaranteed. Contractors invoice at their contracted hourly rate. The expected hourly rate range for this role is $50 - $70 CAD, depending on experience and skills. Please note the top of this range is firm and non-negotiable. This is a 100% remote role. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada, reside in British Columbia, Alberta, Yukon, or the Northwest Territories, and be available for regular collaboration during Pacific Time business hours. We are not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. Now, let’s talk about you! We are looking for candidates who have: Must-Have Experience 5+ years of combined content strategy and copywriting experience at a senior level, ideally within an agency or client services environment. Demonstrated ability to build effective content strategies based on qualitative research, and quantitative data. Demonstrated experience creating engaging copy that meets SEO/AEO needs and conforms to established accessibility standards. Experience working with remote and/or distributed teams. Experience planning and structuring content for large or complex websites. A portfolio demonstrating strategic thinking, specifically in website content strategy (including content modelling, UX writing, and information architecture (IA) for digital experiences) and strong copywriting samples tied to specific project goals. Tool Proficiency User research & testing tools (e.g., Userbrain, Optimal Workshop) Heatmap & behavior analytics (e.g., Mouseflow) Analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console) SEO & auditing platforms (e.g., SEMRush, Screaming Frog) Google Workspace and other documentation tools Skills & Qualities Excellent writing and editing skills with impeccable grammar and attention to detail. Ability to translate complex information into clear, accessible, and engaging content. A strategic mindset with an eye for balancing business objectives with user needs. Strong communication and facilitation skills, especially in client-facing contexts. Solid understanding of accessibility standards and inclusive content practices (e.g., WCAG). Comfortable juggling multiple projects and adapting quickly to shifting priorities. What This Role Is Not This role goes beyond copywriting and requires experience in content strategy. It is not focused on social media, marketing funnels, or ad campaigns. Instead, it centres on planning, structuring and maintaining website content to create clear, useful, accessible and consistent user experiences. The ideal candidate can solve complex content problems, shape content systems and work closely with design and implementation teams. Studies show that some candidates, particularly women and people from underrepresented communities, only apply for a job when they meet every listed qualification. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t line up perfectly with every point above, we’d still love to hear from you. Kanopi is committed to an inclusive team. At Kanopi, we know that a diverse team makes us stronger, more creative, and more effective, and we enthusiastically welcome applicants of all backgrounds. Kanopi Studios is committed to equal opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for engagement without regard to race, colour, national or ethnic origin, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, provincial, or territorial law. Now, What? If you think this post was written just for you, here’s what to do next: Use the ‘Apply for this Job’ button located toward the bottom of the page. Fill out all required fields on the Application page. Upload your resume. Upload your optional cover letter. Note: Some folks feel that cover letters are no longer important to hiring teams. Please be assured that Kanopi looks forward to reading yours! We’d love to hear what makes you a great fit for this role! Remember to include a link to your portfolio or work samples when prompted. If work is under NDA, redacted or anonymized materials are welcome. What to expect after you apply: We want to make sure we’re a great fit - for you and for us! Here’s what our process looks like: Application review: We’ll take time to carefully review your application. Initial questions: If we’d like to learn more, we’ll send a short set of questions to get to know you better. Interviews: You’ll meet with several team members to chat about the role and your experience. Ongoing communication: We aim to follow up with every applicant. If you haven’t heard from us, feel free to reach out - we’re happy to connect. We’ll explain each step more fully as you move through the process. We’re excited to get to know you! Please note: we try to make an effort to contact every applicant to let you know the status of your application, but we are human, so if you don’t hear from us, drop us a line! Kanopi Studios is committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application process, please let us know, and we will work with you to meet your needs. How we use AI in our hiring process. In the interest of fostering a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we use artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist our hiring team in reviewing job applications. items.description: This is a contract position open exclusively to candidates who are located in and legally authorized to provide services in Canada. Applications from candidates located outside of Canada will not be considered. About Our Company Kanopi Studios is a Design, Development & Support Agency with a fully distributed team of experts in Drupal & WordPress. Our clients are mission-driven - and so are we. We design , build , and support websites that help their missions thrive. We believe the people behind the work matter just as much as the work itself. That’s why we’re deeply committed to supporting our team’s growth, well-being, and success. When our people thrive, our clients do too - and together, we build a web that works better for everyone. As Kanopi continues to grow, we’re looking to engage a Contract Senior Website Content Strategist & Copywriter on a contract basis. About The Job Kanopi Studios is seeking a Contract Senior Website Content Strategist & Copywriter who can turn research and data into clear, effective website content experiences. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable developing content strategy and writing the final copy. They can take a project from discovery and research through strategy, content development and implementation. They should be able to clearly communicate and demonstrate the rationale behind their recommendations to internal and client teams. Core Accountabilities Champion User-Centered Content Strategy Be a vocal advocate for user-first content practices within our internal and client teams. Ensure content decisions are rooted in user research, accessibility best practices, and business goals. Guide clients in understanding how content impacts navigation, usability, and conversions. Craft Strategic, Accessible Copy Write engaging copy that: Aligns to the overall content strategy and project goals. Meets established accessibility standards Is SEO and AEO ready Lead Content Discovery and Strategy Plan, create, and present a range of deliverables including (but not limited to): Content Audits & Map/Gap Analyses User Journeys, Personas & User Flows Keyword, SEO & AEO Research and Recommendations Content Maps Copy Guidelines, Voice/Tone Frameworks & UX Copywriting Content governance documentation Contribute to Kanopi’s Brand and Sales Presence Support the internal teams by contributing to thought leadership and promotional initiatives such as: Being an active participant and voice for creative services in client pitch meetings Webinars, case studies, and speaking engagements Writing blog posts or participating in video content Representing Kanopi at conferences or industry events About the Compensation and Work Requirements This is an independent contractor engagement. Work is project-based, hours will vary, and no minimum hours are guaranteed. Contractors invoice at their contracted hourly rate. The expected hourly rate range for this role is $50 - $70 CAD, depending on experience and skills. Please note the top of this range is firm and non-negotiable. This is a 100% remote role. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada, reside in British Columbia, Alberta, Yukon, or the Northwest Territories, and be available for regular collaboration during Pacific Time business hours. We are not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. Now, let’s talk about you! We are looking for candidates who have: Must-Have Experience 5+ years of combined content strategy and copywriting experience at a senior level, ideally within an agency or client services environment. Demonstrated ability to build effective content strategies based on qualitative research, and quantitative data. Demonstrated experience creating engaging copy that meets SEO/AEO needs and conforms to established accessibility standards. Experience working with remote and/or distributed teams. Experience planning and structuring content for large or complex websites. A portfolio demonstrating strategic thinking, specifically in website content strategy (including content modelling, UX writing, and information architecture (IA) for digital experiences) and strong copywriting samples tied to specific project goals. Tool Proficiency User research & testing tools (e.g., Userbrain, Optimal Workshop) Heatmap & behavior analytics (e.g., Mouseflow) Analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console) SEO & auditing platforms (e.g., SEMRush, Screaming Frog) Google Workspace and other documentation tools Skills & Qualities Excellent writing and editing skills with impeccable grammar and attention to detail. Ability to translate complex information into clear, accessible, and engaging content. A strategic mindset with an eye for balancing business objectives with user needs. Strong communication and facilitation skills, especially in client-facing contexts. Solid understanding of accessibility standards and inclusive content practices (e.g., WCAG). Comfortable juggling multiple projects and adapting quickly to shifting priorities. What This Role Is Not This role goes beyond copywriting and requires experience in content strategy. It is not focused on social media, marketing funnels, or ad campaigns. Instead, it centres on planning, structuring and maintaining website content to create clear, useful, accessible and consistent user experiences. The ideal candidate can solve complex content problems, shape content systems and work closely with design and implementation teams. Studies show that some candidates, particularly women and people from underrepresented communities, only apply for a job when they meet every listed qualification. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t line up perfectly with every point above, we’d still love to hear from you. Kanopi is committed to an inclusive team. At Kanopi, we know that a diverse team makes us stronger, more creative, and more effective, and we enthusiastically welcome applicants of all backgrounds. Kanopi Studios is committed to equal opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for engagement without regard to race, colour, national or ethnic origin, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, provincial, or territorial law. Now, What? If you think this post was written just for you, here’s what to do next: Use the ‘Apply for this Job’ button located toward the bottom of the page. Fill out all required fields on the Application page. Upload your resume. Upload your optional cover letter. Note: Some folks feel that cover letters are no longer important to hiring teams. Please be assured that Kanopi looks forward to reading yours! We’d love to hear what makes you a great fit for this role! Remember to include a link to your portfolio or work samples when prompted. If work is under NDA, redacted or anonymized materials are welcome. What to expect after you apply: We want to make sure we’re a great fit - for you and for us! Here’s what our process looks like: Application review: We’ll take time to carefully review your application. Initial questions: If we’d like to learn more, we’ll send a short set of questions to get to know you better. Interviews: You’ll meet with several team members to chat about the role and your experience. Ongoing communication: We aim to follow up with every applicant. If you haven’t heard from us, feel free to reach out - we’re happy to connect. We’ll explain each step more fully as you move through the process. We’re excited to get to know you! Please note: we try to make an effort to contact every applicant to let you know the status of your application, but we are human, so if you don’t hear from us, drop us a line! Kanopi Studios is committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application process, please let us know, and we will work with you to meet your needs. How we use AI in our hiring process. In the interest of fostering a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we use artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist our hiring team in reviewing job applications. Specifically, AI tools may be used to anonymize applications to mitigate potential bias and to assist in the initial assessment of qualifications against the criteria listed in this posting. AI is never the sole basis for a decision. All selection decisions are made with human review and oversight, and no applicant is rejected solely by an AI-based tool. We regularly review our processes and the tools we use to monitor for accuracy and potential bias, and to ensure alignment with the fair treatment of applicants and with applicable federal, provincial, and territorial law. Hiring Transparency Notice This is a contractor opportunity at Kanopi Studios. Engagements are project-based, hours will vary, and no minimum hours are guaranteed. This posting reflects a current contracting need. The expected compensation range for this role is listed in the job posting and may vary based on experience and skills. Artificial intelligence (AI) may be used to assist in reviewing applications as part of the hiring process. All selection decisions include human review and oversight. Kanopi Studios evaluates candidates based on their skills, experience, and qualifications and does not require in-country work experience as a condition of engagement. This posting describes the general nature of the contract work anticipated. Specific engagements and deliverables will be defined in the contractor agreement, and may be modified in accordance with applicable federal, provincial, and territorial laws. No agencies or recruiters, please.

items.summary: The Controls Engineer II, Engineering Services designs and maintains the diagnostic infrastructure ICON's fleet depends on — building troubleshooting tools, guided diagnostics, telemetry-sourced health monitoring dashboards, and data-driven predictive maintenance models that move the fleet from reactive toward condition-based service. This role serves as the escalation point for complex controls failures across Field Engineering and…
items.description: The Controls Engineer II, Engineering Services designs and maintains the diagnostic infrastructure ICON's fleet depends on — building troubleshooting tools, guided diagnostics, telemetry-sourced health monitoring dashboards, and data-driven predictive maintenance models that move the fleet from reactive toward condition-based service. This role serves as the escalation point for complex controls failures across Field Engineering and customer teams, and is the technical authority others turn to when standard support can't resolve the issue. This role is based at ICON’s headquarters in Austin, TX and reports to the Director of Engineering Services. Responsibilities Design feedback and escalation: Diagnose and resolve complex issues involving PLCs, HMIs, SCADA and industrial communication protocols such as Ethernet and DeviceNet. Identify and report design, reliability and maintenance problems or software bugs to design and software engineering teams to facilitate root‑cause analysis and corrective action. Network and integration support: Assist with issues related to control system networking, including configuring communication devices and integrating control hardware with enterprise systems. Collaborate with electrical, mechanical and IT teams to ensure seamless integration. Advanced troubleshooting and support: Respond to situations where first‑line support cannot isolate or fix problems in malfunctioning control systems. Field Engineering training: Develop and deliver training for the Field Engineering team on control system operation, maintenance, and configuration — building the technical notes, how-to guides, and reference materials that raise the team's capability to support the fleet independently. Customer liaison: Serve as a technical liaison to customers, providing guidance on operation, maintenance, and configuration of control systems; deliver remote training sessions and produce technical notes and how-to guides that improve customer understanding. Regulatory compliance: Ensure that control systems comply with safety and regulatory standards (e.g., OSHA, NFPA, IEC) and advise customers on best practices for safe operation. Documentation and knowledge management: Update knowledge base articles, create troubleshooting documentation and share insights with global support teams to build organisational knowledge. Continuous learning: Stay current on emerging control technologies, PLC/HMI software and industry trends to incorporate the latest advancements into support practices. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, control systems engineering or a related technical discipline. 3+ years of experience in industrial automation or control systems support. Strong working knowledge of PLCs, HMIs, SCADA systems and control network protocols. Demonstrated ability to diagnose hardware, software and communication issues in control systems. Knowledge of safety regulations and standards for industrial control systems. Excellent communication and customer‑service skills; ability to manage customer expectations and document resolutions. Ability to work collaboratively with cross‑functional teams and maintain composure under pressure. Preferred Skills & Experience Prior startup experience. Twincat 3 Object Oriented Structured Text development. Solid conceptual understanding of 3d printing technology. Ability to read and contribute to electrical schematics. Self-starting attitude, excited to make things happen in new and ambiguous situations. Superior ability to influence and collaborate with senior management and work across all levels of the organization. items.description: Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimize operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins. Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimized consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end. Overview As a Business Systems Analyst, you own the platforms our Brands and Retailers services organizations runs on: Gainsight, Salesforce, and Pendo, with room to absorb adjacent tools as we add them. You are the single technical owner who holds the cross-tool context: how a Salesforce field feeds a Gainsight health score that drives a Pendo-guided workflow. In this role, you keep these systems healthy and coherent, accelerate the AI initiatives that depend on them, and enable Client Success, Support, Onboarding, Professional Services, Managed Services, and the broader services organization to get more value from the tools we already have. All team members are expected to leverage AI to work smarter, accelerate decision-making, automate repeatable work, and improve outcomes. You are encouraged to continuously identify opportunities to apply AI, data, and scalable processes to enhance productivity, drive innovation, and deliver greater value for our clients, partners, and teams while maintaining appropriate judgment, quality, security, and compliance. Responsibilities Salesforce Administer Salesforce for Services in the Brands and Retailers Business Units organization, including configuration, automation, permissions, and deployments. Partner with the central Salesforce and IT teams to coordinate releases and enterprise platform changes. Configure AI capabilities, including Agentforce, AI case summaries, case classification, and response drafting. Translate business requirements into scalable platform solutions. Gainsight Administer Gainsight, including health scoring, automation, programs, dashboards, and reporting. Maintain Salesforce-Gainsight integrations, monitoring APIs, data synchronization, and platform performance. Administer Staircase AI integration and ensure customer health data remains accurate and actionable. Build scalable automations and maintain sustainable platform configuration aligned with the established roadmap. Pendo Administer Pendo, including configuration, guides, permissions, and feature enablement. Analyze adoption data and provide recommendations that improve product adoption and operational effectiveness. Enable self-service capabilities while maximizing platform utilization. Cross-Platform Administration & Optimization Maintain reliable integrations and data consistency across Salesforce, Gainsight, Pendo, Staircase AI, and other supported platforms. Troubleshoot system, integration, and data quality issues while minimizing operational disruption. Support Services teams by balancing platform requests through established prioritization processes. Assume ownership of additional Services technologies as the technology portfolio evolves. Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through AI, automation, and repeatable processes. Maintain current platform certifications and stay informed on emerging capabilities across supported technologies. Collaborate closely with peers across the Brands and Retailers services organizations to ensure platform optimization. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications 2+ years of experience administering Salesforce and Gainsight. Experience configuring enterprise applications, automation, permissions, integrations, and data management. Experience supporting APIs, data synchronization, and cross-platform system dependencies. Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve technical and data quality issues. Ability to manage competing priorities while supporting multiple stakeholder groups. Experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Claude) to improve productivity through documentation, communication, data analysis, automation, or workflow optimization. Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's degree. 4+ years of enterprise systems administration experience. Administrator certification in Salesforce, Gainsight, Pendo, or comparable platforms. Experience with Salesforce-Gainsight integrations, customer health scoring, and Journey Orchestrator (Programs). Experience implementing Salesforce AI capabilities (e.g., Agentforce or Einstein) or comparable AI technologies. Experience supporting Client Success, Support, Onboarding, or Services Operations in a SaaS or commerce technology environment. Strong communication, organization, and process improvement skills. Travel Required Up to 10% Other Duties Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. What it’s like to work at Rithum When you join Rithum, you can expect to work with smart risk-takers, courageous collaborators, and curious minds. As part of the Rithum team, you are valued, supported, and included. Guided by a transparent culture and accessible, approachable leadership, we offer career opportunities aligned to your ambitions and talents. To ensure work and life balance works for you, we also offer an array of resources to support you and your families, including comprehensive benefits and wellness plans. At Rithum you will: Partner with the leading brands and retailers. Connect with passionate professionals who will help support your goals. Participate in an inclusive, welcoming work atmosphere. Achieve work-life balance through remote-first working conditions, generous time off, and wellness days. Receive industry-competitive compensation and total rewards benefits. We believe in transparency and fairness in our compensation practices. For this position, the expected base pay range is: $65,000-$117,000 per year. This range represents the base pay for the role across all U.S. locations and is determined based on market data, internal equity, and experience. Final compensation may vary depending on geographic location, skills, and relevant experience.In addition to base pay, we offer a discretionary bonus for non-sales roles, a comprehensive benefits package, and, where applicable, sales incentives. For this position, the expected discretionary bonus is 10% of the annual base salary. Benefits Medical, dental and vision benefits: Affordable health care plans and company HSA contributions, starting on Day 1 A 6% 401(k) match Competitive time off package with 20 days of Paid Time Off, 9 Company-Paid holidays, 2 paid floating holidays, 7 paid sick days, 2 Wellness days, and 1 Paid Volunteer Day; at 3 years of service PTO increases to 22 days, and at 5 years it increases to 25 days 12 weeks primary caregiver leave & 4 weeks secondary caregiver leave Accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity insurance Pet insurance Legal assistance and identity theft insurance plans Life insurance 2x salary Access to the Calm app and the Employee Assistance Program $65/month Remote work stipend for internet Culture and team-building activities Tuition assistance Career development opportunities Charitable contribution match up to $250 per year Rithum is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other protected characteristic. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations in accordance with the law for qualified applicants. If you require assistance during the interview process due to a medical condition or need support accessing our website or completing the application process, please reach out to us by completing the Accommodations Request Form . Your comfort and accessibility are important to us, and we're here to ensure a seamless experience as you explore opportunities with our team.

items.title: Senior Affiliate Marketing Manager
items.summary: At Bondora, our mission is simple: to make finance easy, transparent, and accessible for everyone.
items.description: At Bondora , our mission is simple: to make finance easy, transparent, and accessible for everyone. Founded in 2008, we’ve helped more than 700,000 customers across Europe borrow and invest effortlessly through our trusted digital products. As a rapidly growing financial technology company, we’re reaching new heights with a bold vision. We’re set to acquire a banking license, unlocking a world of possibilities for our customers. This transition will allow us to expand our lending across more EU countries and broaden our product suite to deliver even more value. Join us on this journey and let’s build the future of finance together! What is this role about? 🚀 As a Senior Affiliate Marketing Manager at Bondora , you'll take ownership of the affiliate marketing channel for Go & Grow, managing and growing the partnerships that bring new investors to the platform. You'll work with content creators, publishers, comparison sites, communities, and affiliate networks across Europe, while building a strong pipeline of new partners. This is a highly autonomous, hands-on role where you'll combine partner management with business development — strengthening existing relationships, sourcing and onboarding new affiliates, negotiating commercial agreements, and using data and AI to continuously improve partner performance. You'll work closely with Product, Data, Engineering, Brand, CRM, Legal, and Compliance to optimise the full journey from first click to long-term investor value. You'll have the opportunity to own and shape one of Go & Grow's key growth channels , with direct access to senior leadership and significant freedom to improve how the affiliate programme operates and scales. Your main responsibilities 🎯 Own and Execute the affiliate marketing channel strategy, operating plan, forecast and performance. Source, qualify and close direct partnerships with affiliates (in other words publishers: content creators, comparison sites, communities and relevant affiliate networks). Create clear segmentation, outreach, onboarding and activation routines that move partners from prospect to live Design and negotiate CPA, CPL, fixed-fee and hybrid deals Define and improve the funnel from click and sign-up through funded investor, first 30-day deposits, repeat deposits and 30/60/90-day retained value. Operate and improve Target Circle/Circlewise Build partner- and cohort-level reporting covering acquisition cost, revenue (deposits) value, retention, net revenue (net deposits) Test placements, content, landing pages, incentives, creative and localized messaging with Brand, CRM, Product and Design. Apply country-specific financial-promotion rules, execute approval workflows, required disclosures, content monitoring and documentation together with Legal and Compliance. What would ensure success in this role?💪 Expert in at least one partner management platform (Affiliate platforms such as Target Circle/Circlewise, Impact, Awin or Partnerize, CJ Advanced Excel or Google Sheets and BI dashboard experience AI fluency: Comfortable using AI tools for data analysis, partner research and qualification, and content/compliance review, with strong judgment on when human verification is essential. Fluent in English and German is a plus What can you expect at Bondora ? 🎯 Be part of Bondora ’s ambitious journey toward 1BN in revenue - your work will have a real impact. 💰 Enjoy a competitive salary and amazing benefits: 5 weeks of vacation, private healthcare compensation, hobby grant, mental health support, share options, and much more! 📈 Work in an environment that encourages growth and innovation - with resources and budget for continuous learning. The next steps If you have the guts, ideas, and a team vision, apply now! Our hiring process: 1️⃣ Meet Anna , our Recruiter — your first chat to share your story and ambitions. 2️⃣ Meet Krzysztof Schmidt , CMO at Go&Grow 3️⃣ Tackle a home task to showcase your skills. 4️⃣ Complete our personality and logic assessments via Alva Labs. 5️⃣ Meeting Pärtel Tomberg , CEO of Bondora 6️⃣ Chat with Olga Kikas , our Chief of People 7️⃣ 🎉 If the stars align — welcome to Bondora ! Join our team of Bondorians, and let's make it happen! If you'd like to read how Bondora collects, uses, and protects your personal data during recruitment, please see HERE. items.description: Description Anchor closed $40M in top-tier VC funding and grew 500% last year, transforming the $74B services payments market. Our platform automates billing and collections so businesses can focus on growth. At Anchor, we’re redefining the future of B2B Payments. Our innovative, end-to-end billing and collections platform eliminates the frustrations of manual processes, making financial workflows seamless, automated, and stress-free. We empower businesses to focus on their core strengths while we handle the complexities of billing and collections. Our Customer Support organization sits at the core of Anchor and is a key driver for our growth, ensuring every customer has an exceptional experience. As we continue to grow rapidly, we’re looking for an experienced, hands-on Director of Customer Success to build, grow, and lead our customer organization across the entire journey - from onboarding through activation and retention. Reporting directly to the COO of Anchor, the ideal candidate will demonstrate exceptional ownership, a holistic business mindset, meticulous attention to detail, and a consultative, action-oriented approach that truly sets them apart. Responsibility Lead and scale Anchor’s Customer Success function across the full customer journey—from onboarding to long-term retention. Develop and execute a comprehensive CS strategy that aligns with customer goals and drives measurable value. Own and evolve onboarding, account management, and customer support processes that maximize adoption and satisfaction. Build deep, trusted relationships with customers—including executive stakeholders—and act as their strategic advisor. Define and track KPIs to measure customer health, satisfaction, and team effectiveness; drive data-informed improvements. Own systems and tooling for customer success (e.g., ticketing, reporting, support infrastructure). Build and maintain a robust knowledge base for internal and customer use. Collaborate closely with product, sales, R&D, and marketing to represent the voice of the customer and shape our roadmap. Develop customer success stories and use cases for both internal learning and external marketing. Hire, mentor, and grow a high-performing CS team that delivers excellence at scale. Requirements 2+ years of experience managing CS team leaders, plus 3+ years leading CS teams directly in a fast-paced, data-driven, B2B SaaS company- (Fintech experience is a strong plus.) Building and scaling CS processes from the ground up, along with CS strategies, operating models, and tools, across the full customer lifecycle. Highly detailed and structured professional, with experience designing and implementing scalable CS processes. Superb capabilities in managing even the most challenging customer relationships—able to turn difficult moments into positive, productive outcomes. A highly motivated, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to take initiative, prioritize effectively, and adapt quickly. Strong project management chops, you can juggle multiple priorities, communicate clearly, and drive outcomes. Analytical and metrics-driven; you thrive on dashboards, insights, and measurable impact. A true player-coach: you enjoy managing accounts yourself while scaling and supporting your team and processes. Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to turn data into actionable insights. Experience managing complex stakeholder relationships across multiple levels of an organization. Skilled in customer meetings, demos, workshops, QBRs, and executive briefings. Proficiency in Excel and CS platforms (e.g., HubSpot) is a must. Bachelor’s degree or MBA in accounting/finance. Or 2+ years of practical managerial experience in those fields- required. And finally: zero ego, we’re a team of builders who work hard, stay humble, and support each other. Extra Experience in management consulting, sales engineering, or post-sales technical support. items.summary: About DutchieFounded in 2017, Dutchie is a comprehensive technology platform powering dispensary operations, while providing consumers with safe and easy access to cannabis.
items.description: About Dutchie Founded in 2017, Dutchie is a comprehensive technology platform powering dispensary operations, while providing consumers with safe and easy access to cannabis. Dutchie aims to further support the positive societal change the cannabis industry brings to the world through wellness benefits, social justice, and empowering local communities through tax revenue. Powering thousands of dispensaries across 40+ markets throughout the United States and Canada, Dutchie is the leading technology company in the cannabis space and was named in Fast Company’s 10 Most Innovative Companies in North America and listed two years in a row on LinkedIn’s Top 50 Startups. Dutchie has raised over $600M in funding to date, backed by D1 Capital Partners, Tiger Global, Dragoneer, DFJ Growth, Thrive Capital, Howard Schultz, Snoop Dogg’s Casa Verde Capital, Gron Ventures, members of the founding team at DoorDash, Kevin Durant’s Thirty Five Ventures, and other notable angel investors. About This Role Dutchie is looking for a Senior Financial Planning & Analysis Analyst to help drive the financial operating rhythm of the company. You’ll partner across Finance, Accounting, and business leaders to build forecasts, evaluate performance, improve planning processes, and deliver insights that influence executive decision-making. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building scalable financial infrastructure, automating manual work, and using data to tell compelling business stories. You’ll report to the Senior Director of FP&A while helping establish the next generation of planning capabilities across Dutchie . What You’ll Do Financial Planning & Forecasting Own portions of the annual operating plan, quarterly forecasts, and long-range financial planning process. Develop financial models that improve visibility into company performance and future investment decisions. Analyze monthly results, identify business drivers, and communicate actionable insights to leadership. Partner closely with Accounting to ensure accurate reporting and alignment between actuals, forecasts, and KPIs. Operational Excellence Improve and automate planning workflows using AI, modern financial tooling, and scalable processes. Identify opportunities to eliminate manual reporting through automation and self-service analytics. Help evolve executive reporting and dashboards that improve decision-making across the organization. Support board materials, leadership presentations, and strategic planning initiatives. Cross-Functional Partnership Collaborate across R&D, G&A, and Operations to understand business performance and financial impact. Become a trusted finance partner capable of simplifying complex business questions into clear financial recommendations. Help establish consistent planning disciplines as Dutchie continues to scale. What You’ll Bring 3–5 years of experience in FP&A, investment banking, consulting, or corporate finance. Advanced financial modeling and Excel skills with experience building dynamic forecasting models. Experience working in high-growth SaaS or technology environments preferred. Strong analytical curiosity and comfort working through ambiguity. Experience leveraging AI tools to automate analysis, improve workflows, and increase productivity. Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex analyses into executive-ready recommendations. Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field. What You’ll Get We are targeting a starting salary of $124,000 - $166,000 based on the intended level for this role. In addition to cash compensation, our total rewards package includes: Full medical benefits including dental and vision plans to ensure you always have the best care. Equity packages in the form of stock options to all employees. Technology (hardware, software, reading materials, etc..) allowance Flexible vacation and sick days At Dutchie , we’re committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Dutchie believes that diversity and inclusion among our teammates is critical to our success, and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool. items.title: Product Designer
items.summary: Shape the Future on AutopilotAt Autopilot, you won’t just design screens – you’ll design how fintech works.
items.description: Shape the Future on Autopilot At Autopilot , you won’t just design screens – you’ll design how fintech works. As a Product Designer , you’ll own product experiences end-to-end and help redefine what great UX means in a complex, data-driven industry. We’re building a high-performance, AI-native Fintech Operating System designed to optimize cost and revenue for digital businesses. Join us on a multi-year mission to build smarter infrastructure for commerce. Why Join Us? You’ll help build an ambitious product from the ground up, with a team that values speed, craft, and autonomy. If you’re ready to make an outsized impact in fintech, we’d love to meet you. About the Role You'll join a fast-moving team building modern, data-intensive web applications that help digital businesses operate more intelligently. This is a founding design role with strong emphasis on product logic, systems thinking, and end-to-end collaboration with engineers. 🛠️ What You'll Do Translate complex financial logic and backend systems into intuitive user flows Design dashboards, workflows, and visual systems for payments, orchestration, and automation Build and maintain our scalable design system in Figma (aligned with React components) Collaborate with engineers on real-world UX states — success, failure, pending, retry Prototype and validate features with real data and user context Participate in product discussions, shaping user journeys before pixels are drawn Uphold usability and domain accuracy as the standard for design quality 🎯 What We're Looking For 5+ years of experience designing digital products with complex logic (fintech, B2B SaaS, or data-heavy systems preferred) Strong product and systems thinking — you design for states and workflows , not just screens Deep Figma expertise (Auto Layout, Variants, Tokens, Components) Ability to translate backend logic, APIs, and data models into coherent user experiences Excellent communication and documentation skills (Linear, Figma, Slack) Comfortable working directly with engineers and iterating quickly without handoffs 🌟 Bonus Points Experience in fintech, payments, or compliance-related products Exposure to analytics or developer tooling Understanding of design-to-code workflows (React component parity, tokens) Strong interaction or motion design craft (Framer, ProtoPie, etc.) Our Hiring Process We focus on real-world collaboration, not design showreels. Here’s what to expect: Apply with LinkedIn Profile And Resume We’ll review based on the requirements above. If shortlisted, you’ll receive an email to schedule a 90-minute live design collaboration session once you’re comfortable with our pre-interview brief. 90-Minute Live Design Collaboration You’ll work with our product and engineering team on a small feature challenge — from user problem to Figma prototype. We’ll look at: How you think through logic and flows How you translate constraints into UX decisions Your interaction, hierarchy, and state management How you communicate trade-offs and rationale The session mirrors our actual workflow: accessible pragmatic collaborative Design Review & Feedback After the session, we’ll walk through your design decisions together. You’ll get feedback from our CTO and team, and discuss potential improvements or extensions to your solution. Culture & Alignment Chat A final call with CEO to discuss your long-term goals, how you work best, and whether Autopilot is the right fit for both sides. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Full Stack Data Scientist
items.summary: About Discovered LabsDiscovered Labs is an SEO/AEO agency built by a Stanford rocket scientist turned AI researcher and a demand gen marketer with experience scaling B2B SaaS companies to 8-figures in ARR.
items.description: About Discovered Labs Discovered Labs is an SEO/AEO agency built by a Stanford rocket scientist turned AI researcher and a demand gen marketer with experience scaling B2B SaaS companies to 8-figures in ARR. We’re trusted by hyper-growth companies like Instantly, Granola, incident and other $10M+ ARR B2B SaaS companies who want more leads and customers from both Google and AI assistants like ChatGPT. We do this through a mixture of content marketing, technical optimisations and off-site brand amplification (PR, backlinks, Reddit marketing). View recent case studies at . High-level, our approach rests on three things: AI automation and workflows. We build marketing programs the way you’d build a product. Rather than burn hours a week on repetitive tasks, our in-house team of ML engineers builds workflows with custom tooling so we can focus on the high-impact work. Senior expertise. Everything is managed and elevated by a team of experts, so it’s done to a high standard and differentiated. We don’t let automation get in the way of quality. Full-stack. SEO and AEO rarely work as isolated tasks. We work across the entire funnel and multiple surfaces so we own the outcome and clients win. If you want to stand out, include a Loom showing a tool, system or deliverable you’ve built and are proud of. We’d love to see it. This role You analyse the data, work out why performance is moving and turn the result into a report the client can act on. You implement the fixes and improvements yourself with our internal tooling. “DS who owns data → analysis → decision → implementation end to end” Concretely, that means you: Analyse the data behind reports, strategy questions, client queries, technical issues and SWOTs — reconciling messy, incomplete sources into a clear picture of what's actually happening. QA via analysis - Is the rationale sound? Does the logic hold? Where's the unsupported claim? Run experiments. Design a falsifiable test, run it, and know when a result is noise rather than signal. Tie every finding to the client's business. You get to "so what, and why does this matter to their revenue," not just "here's what the data says." Own the report. Hand the client and the account strategist a decision-ready read the data, the diagnosis and the “so what?” never a raw data dump. Optimise for answer engines (AEO). Make client content the source LLMs and Google AI Overviews cite, using our internal methodology and tools, as one surface among many. Execute, not just recommend. You implement the findings yourself with our internal tooling. The analysis only counts once it's shipped. Improve the tactics and the systems. Turn a one-off finding into a repeatable process, and keep sharpening the tooling and methodology behind how the system works. Communicate it cleanly to clients , in writing and on calls, so your output needs no translation. This role is fully remote. Ideally your working hours overlap the GMT business day (we’re flexible within roughly ±4 hours). This is not for you if: You need heavy management, or you wait for perfect instructions before acting. If you spot a broken process, we expect you to fix it. Produce genius insights but don’t ship them. Insight with no execution is exactly the failure mode we screen for. The analyst who gets on the tools is the one we want. Lack experience and/or willingness to use advanced AI workflows. Prefer to spend weeks performing audits before implementation. B2B SaaS clients expect results fast and everything needs to tie to commercial impact. Not comfortable with data and analytics. We want someone who can diagnose the why behind performance and back it with evidence. What’s in it for you Benefits $30,000 -$50,000 annual salary depending on relevant skills and experience Fully remote position. (Ideally flexible within roughly ±4 hours GMT ) Room to grow. We’re small but growing, which means real opportunity, including a senior track with no people management required. Paid leave and autonomy to perform your role. The best in-house SEO/AEO tools i.e. ML/AI and data science tooling , built by top engineers, at your disposal. How you’ll spend your time A rough split; it flexes month to month with what each account needs. 40% — Implementing and shipping. Producing and shipping the week’s work across your accounts: technical fixes, on-page, content refreshes, internal linking, off-page and AEO, all verified at source before it goes out. 30% — Analysing, diagnosing and measuring. Getting into the numbers to understand cause and effect, designing and running experiments, and measuring what actually moved after a change. 15% — Reporting and client communication. Owning the client-facing report, being present on calls to walk through the diagnosis, staying close in day-to-day client Slack, and giving the account owner the read behind the story they lead. 15% — Building and evolving the methodology. Sharpening your own skills as search and AI assistants keep changing, and constantly improving the tooling, templates and process behind how the team works. Requirements This role owns the full loop end to end, analyse → explain → implement → report. You don't hand off execution: you analyse it, you build it, you ship it. High agency and a builder's instinct are the two traits we weight above everything, including domain knowledge. High agency covers execution and tempo; builder covers coding, AI workflows, and evolving the methodology. Strong analytical and quantitative background: you reconcile messy, incomplete data (GSC exports, rank trackers, partial client analytics not clean warehouse tables), design falsifiable experiments, and reason to a root cause with evidence, never inventing a cause where the data is silent. Demonstrated evidence of shipping a time your analysis changed what a business did, and you implemented at least part of it yourself. Insight without execution is exactly the wrong fit for this seat. You're AI-native and have built something with it: a side project, agent, scraper, or internal tool. You use AI tools daily as a workflow multiplier (briefs, clustering, audit summarisation, scraping) and still own the final, validated output. You build workflows, not just prompts and we take portfolio over claims. Experiment design and statistical rigour : you design a test, run it, and know when a result is noise. Systems thinking: you improve the tactic and improve the system colonbehind it, turning a one-off finding into a repeatable process. Commercial curiosity: you get to "so what?" unprompted, asking about the client's business model and KPIs, and land every finding as a business consequence revenue, pipeline, or cost not just a metric movement. Strong written and verbal English , with the ability to convey findings cleanly to non-technical stakeholders. Reports and QA rationale go straight to clients; the analysis only counts once a client understands it and acts on it. Nice-to-haves (not required) Experience with SEO/analytics tooling (GSC, GA4, Ahrefs, a crawler such as Screaming Frog). If you don’t have it, we’ll ramp you this is teachable. Client-facing experience, and commercial awareness. Familiarity with B2B SaaS. Culture fit You should ideally believe: Search has fundamentally changed. Google and backlinks still matter but are no longer the full picture — AI search is a new frontier and you’re excited about the shift. AI is a force multiplier, not a crutch. You’re actively using AI daily and building workflows, not just typing into a chat box. Speed and quality are both achievable. Everyone here operates at a fast pace, is reliable and takes extreme ownership. There are no passengers at Discovered Labs. You’ll thrive here if: you get energy from excellent work that makes clients successful, you see gaps in processes and fix them without being asked, and you move fast while proactively communicating. You won’t thrive here if: you need heavy management, you wait for perfect instructions, or you think SEO is still just about keywords and links. We look forward to seeing your application. Email your resume to jobs@brandogdigital.com with a cover letter outlining your experience managing performance marketing campaigns and any notable results you've driven for clients or brands. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/brandog-digital-senior-digital-marketing-manager-paid-social

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Serbia - Remote About Smartcat Smartcat is building the future of work, where human expertise meets digital teammates to drive 10x to 1000x productivity gains for the world’s leading enterprises. We’re on the frontier of an entirely new category: Agentic AI. We enable enterprises to build high-performing hybrid workforces made up of both humans and AI agents. These AI agents aren’t generic copilots. They’re fully trained digital teammates that learn from your best people, your content, and your business strategy—ready to get to work from day one. Our platform combines generative AI, human-in-the-loop workflows, and a living Enterprise Skill Graph that continuously learns and improves. Whether you're launching a product globally, onboarding new hires, translating learning content, or aligning legal teams across regions, Smartcat turns knowledge into action and action into scale. Over 1,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Smartcat to bring their business to the world—instantly, accurately, and in every language. As a Series C company with 130% year-over-year growth, we’re scaling fast and investing in people who want to shape the future of work with us. Join us in unlocking global potential, one human and agent team at a time. Mission Smartcat positions itself as the central hub for managing your enterprise's multilingual content, seamlessly integrating diverse content assets. We offer convenient AI translation / content generation + Human review workflows to ensure best quality and faster turnaround. Your mission will be to own one of our most popular and business-critical tracks, related to translation and AI-based generation of textual content (we support over 50 document and file formats, including PDF and MS Office documents). The ability to create content directly on our platform is a new arm of this use case that we are just starting to build. You will work directly with clients to understand their pain points, ensure product-market fit, own the process of tracking usage data, define product improvement hypotheses, planning both a long-term roadmap and the day-to-day work to drive adoption, retention and expansion of translation and content generation volumes related to your use case. You will act as an entrepreneur whose goal is to achieve the breakthrough with all possible means, and will grow your part of the business, measured in the volume of words processed through the platform. Within 3 months, your outcomes will be You will have a product roadmap defined for the next quarter for the technical areas of the product you're responsible for, and own this roadmap and delivery schedule further. For each feature we ship and for each larger improvement track that spans multiple product areas, you will have a definition of key performance indicators and be accountable for their growth. You will own the acquisition funnel for this use case and understand the problems that matter the most. Together with the BI analyst, you will own dashboards to track your KPIs, as well as monitor other data sources and feedback channels, to inform your next steps and rapidly iterate to improve the product. Together with the designer and the team lead of a dedicated engineering team, you will own a process of developing new features, conducting customer interviews and ensuring proper execution with the engineering teams. Together with the Director of Product, you will align on the product strategy, get a solid understanding of how our product works, and establish a reliable product discovery & execution process. Requirements Outstanding achievement as a product manager for B2B SaaS platforms with a focus on product-led growth. At least 5 years of experience working as a product manager. Exceptional, native-level English, both written and spoken. Exceptional communication skills to interact with colleagues, customers, and partners. Experience working on projects related to document processing is a strong plus. Experience working on customer-facing user interfaces (either in B2B or B2C products) is a strong plus. Knowledge of modern developments in ML/AI related to text processing (LLM, RAG) and overall technical background is a strong plus. Knowledge of a localization industry is a strong plus. Growth-oriented mindset. Integrity, full commitment, and a strong sense of ownership. Experience working in a highly intense startup environment, requiring extreme focus, a sense of urgency, and persistence to break through. Openness to feedback and alternative opinions and ideas. Comfortable working with remote teams across time zones. Easy-going personality, high tolerance to cultural differences. Why joining Smartcat might be your best move so far Fully remote team We are a global team of 200+ enthusiastic people spread across 30+ countries. We have been fully remote since 2020, with some locations populated with more Smartcaters than others, such as Boston, Belgrade, Lisbon, Tbilisi and Yerevan. Be part of an AI Native Organization We are highly innovative, using AI across all areas of the organization to accelerate decision-making and free people to focus on strategy and high-impact work. We embrace new ideas and encourage all Smartcaters, regardless of level or department, to manage their own AI Agents. At Smartcat you’ll shape how AI transforms the workplace and play an integral role in ensuring Smartcat remains a leader in AI innovation. Innovating a $100 Billion industry Smartcat is reshaping the $100B multilingual content industry with an AI-powered platform that makes it easy for companies to create, translate, and localize global content at scale. Our platform enables enterprise teams to move away from slow, traditional outsourcing methods, and achieve fast, high-quality results, at a fraction of the cost. Join the rocketship to scale-up 10x and beyond together We are looking for someone to become an integral part of our team and play a crucial role in the most exciting part of our journey: transitioning from a post-Series C startup to a company exceeding $100M in ARR and $1B in valuation. Our journey isn’t for the faint of heart. We are growing at 130% YoY, thanks to our strong product-market fit and high-performing team, and plan to accelerate from here. Smartcat Culture : Where Diversity Meets High Performance At Smartcat, we are committed to building a culture that highlights respect and appreciation for each individual's unique background and perspective, while maintaining a strong focus on results and engagement. We believe in welcoming everyone and fostering an inclusive environment where team members can be their authentic selves at work. Our commitment to inclusion is steadfast, and we stand firmly against discrimination and harassment. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/smartcat-senior-product-manager

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Toronto Who are we? Our mission is to scale intelligence to serve humanity. We’re training and deploying frontier models for developers and enterprises who are building AI systems to power magical experiences like content generation, semantic search, RAG, and agents. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. We like to work hard and move fast to do what’s best for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are passionate about their craft. Each person is one of the best in the world at what they do. We believe that a diverse range of perspectives is a requirement for building great products. Join us on our mission and shape the future! Role Overview We are seeking a Platform Experience and Developer PM to own how developers and enterprise technical teams build on, integrate with, and operate Cohere's model platform. This is a high-leverage role sitting at the intersection of three domains: Managed Services and Models as a Service. Own Cohere's managed service offerings as a product. This is broader than model serving alone. It includes the full range of how enterprises consume and operate Cohere's capabilities, from shared multi-tenant model access to dedicated single-tenant deployments, and from synchronous real-time inference to high-volume asynchronous workloads. You will own the product thinking around deployment models, data residency and regional compliance requirements, self-serve provisioning, and the operational controls that give enterprises confidence in running production workloads on Cohere’s infrastructure. API and SDK. Own the roadmap for how developers build on Cohere. This means setting the direction for our APIs and SDKs, thinking carefully about interface design and ergonomics, and ensuring we ship developer primitives that are stable, well-documented, and a joy to build with. Developer Experience and Tooling. Own the surfaces that give developers visibility and control over their integration with Cohere. This includes the API console, credential and access management, usage and cost visibility, request observability, and sandbox and testing environments Responsibilities Drive the roadmap across managed services, APIs, SDKs, and developer tooling, balancing near-term customer needs with long-term platform investment. Translate model and infrastructure capabilities into well-designed product surfaces that developers and enterprise operators can rely on. Engage directly with customers and developers to understand integration challenges, validate priorities, and surface unmet needs. Define success metrics for platform health and developer experience, and lead initiatives to move them. Partner with engineering, research, technical writing, and developer relations to ship and document platform improvements. Requirements 5+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent owning developer-facing or platform-layer products such as APIs, SDKs, developer tools, or technical infrastructure. Strong technical fluency with API design and SDK development, including an understanding of versioning, backward compatibility, and what makes a developer experience feel polished and reliable. A track record of thinking about infrastructure as a product, with the ability to translate system-level capabilities into clearly differentiated, customer-facing features. Experience building or owning developer tooling surfaces such as consoles, dashboards, usage analytics, or observability and debugging tools. Analytical by default: you define success metrics before you build, instrument thoughtfully, and use data alongside qualitative feedback to make decisions. Strong collaborator who works well across engineering, design, infrastructure, and GTM teams, and who can communicate technical tradeoffs clearly to a range of stakeholders. Highly execution-oriented with a bias toward shipping and iterating quickly. Demonstrated ownership across the full product lifecycle — from problem definition and scoping through launch, iteration, and eventual deprecation or migration. Nice-to-Haves Experience owning a model serving or inference platform, including familiarity with deployment models such as multi-tenant and dedicated infrastructure. Exposure to data residency, sovereignty, or regional compliance requirements as they apply to AI or cloud infrastructure products. Familiarity with asynchronous and high-throughput workload patterns, and the product considerations they introduce around job management, status visibility, and cost attribution. Familiarity with the AI developer ecosystem and open standards, including orchestration frameworks such as LangChain and LlamaIndex, model serving frameworks such as vLLM, and an awareness of de facto interoperability standards and how they shape developer adoption and integration patterns. Why join Cohere? Impact: Shape the developer surface of one of the world's leading enterprise AI platforms, used by developers and enterprises building production AI systems at scale. Innovation: Work alongside leading researchers and engineers solving complex ML challenges at the frontier of AI. Growth: Enjoy competitive compensation, equity options, and opportunities for professional development. Flexibility: Hybrid work model with offices in San Francisco, New York, and Toronto. Location Remote or hybrid (San Francisco, New York, Toronto). If some of the above doesn’t line up perfectly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply! We value and celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive work environment for all. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form , and we will work together to meet your needs. Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks: An open and inclusive culture and work environment ‍ Work closely with a team on the cutting edge of AI research Weekly lunch stipend, in-office lunches & snacks Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget to take care of your mental health 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months Personal enrichment benefits towards arts and culture, fitness and well-being, quality time, and workspace improvement Remote-flexible, offices in Toronto, New York, San Francisco, London and Paris, as well as a co-working stipend ️ 6 weeks of vacation (30 working days!) To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/cohere-product-manager-platform-experience-developer-product

Our mission is to dem
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: UK URL: http://agpt.co Remote · ~3 days/week · 12-week contract · £500–£650/day · Immediate start · Paid working trial for finalists About AutoGPT At AutoGPT, we're building toward a future where AI agents do real work for people — not just answer questions, but take action, complete tasks, and move work forward. Our mission is to democratize AI by making powerful digital assistants accessible and useful to everyone, regardless of technical background. We created one of the most-starred open-source projects on GitHub, and our hosted platform is now live and accepting paying customers. We already have a large global audience and tens of thousands of branded search visitors every month. What we don't yet have is a proven, repeatable go-to-market motion. That's what you'll find. The Product AutoPilot: an AI teammate that builds and runs working automations from a conversation. AutoGPT Builder: a graph-based canvas for creating agents without coding. AutoGPT Marketplace: discover and deploy ready-made agents. Agent Library: manage, schedule, and monitor agents. Try it in 60 seconds, no signup required: platform.agpt.co/tour/chat The Role Your mandate is to find, prove, and begin scaling a repeatable path from an ICP-fit prospect with an urgent job to an activated, retained AutoGPT customer. You'll investigate and fix the constraint wherever it exists: ICP selection, positioning, proof, pricing, website conversion, checkout, onboarding, activation, lifecycle communication, product experience, or acquisition. This isn't a role where you deliver recommendations to another marketing team. You'll personally research, write, build, launch, measure, and iterate , with direct access to the founders, product, engineering, and customer and funnel data. What You'll Own Establish reliable measurement from acquisition through purchase, activation, and retention. Interview customers, non-buyers, churned users, and high-fit waitlist members. Validate or disprove our ICP and use-case hypotheses. Define the initial ICP, anti-ICP, JTBD, buying trigger, and value proposition. Improve positioning, use-case pages, proof, checkout, and onboarding. Help define and improve activation and time to value. Launch segmented waitlist campaigns. Run controlled paid-search tests around high-intent, non-branded problems. Validate SEO opportunities before scaling content. Test product-led social, YouTube, outreach, or partnerships where evidence supports them. Work directly with product and engineering on funnel and activation improvements. Maintain a prioritized experiment backlog with hypotheses, costs, results, and decisions. Provide concise weekly reporting: one async memo and one 30-minute decision meeting. Protect and elevate the AutoGPT brand throughout. What Success Looks Like Within 10 business days: A reliable view of the funnel, including qualified traffic and meaningful product activation. Evidence explaining the biggest current drop-offs. Customer and high-fit non-buyer interviews completed. Initial improvements or experiments already live. Numeric targets agreed for the remainder of the contract. By the end of the engagement: ICP and use-case hypotheses validated or rejected. Qualified conversion and/or activation and retention improved. Acquisition sources that produce genuinely valuable customers understood. The beginnings of a repeatable acquisition + activation motion — or compelling evidence identifying and addressing a more fundamental constraint. A documented growth operating system and clear recommendation for what comes next. The primary outcome isn't more traffic. It's more ICP-fit customers who successfully use AutoGPT and remain customers. Who We're Looking For You've personally operated in an early-stage product-led B2B or prosumer SaaS environment — perhaps as a first or second growth hire, founding marketer, hands-on growth lead, product-growth operator, or former founder. You can demonstrate: Relevant 0-to-1 growth results, including the starting baseline. Exactly what you personally did — real pages, emails, ads, onboarding flows, dashboards, or research. Strong customer-research and product-marketing judgment. Analytical self-sufficiency across attribution, billing, and product data. Experience improving onboarding, activation, or retention. Ability to write and ship landing pages, emails, ads, and lifecycle communication. Hands-on paid-search and experimentation experience. Excellent written English and strong brand judgment. Ability to work autonomously and communicate concisely. Experience with AI, automation, developer tools, no-code products, or open-source communities is useful, but evidence that you've solved this kind of commercial problem matters more. This Is Not An adviser-only fractional CMO role. A strategy-deck engagement. A pure paid-acquisition role. An SEO content-production contract. A social-media management role. An agency account-management role. A position for someone who needs a full design, analytics, and marketing team before shipping. Agency applications aren't suitable. We want the individual who will personally do the work. Why AutoGPT? You'll own the commercial growth problem at a pivotal moment: a famous brand, a live product, an existing audience, and a genuinely open playing field. You'll have direct access to the founders, fast decisions on experiments, and no approval bureaucracy for agreed reversible tests. We're a small, kind, globally distributed team that values empathy, autonomy, and shipping. What you prove during this engagement can become the company's long-term growth engine. Details Role: Contract GTM Lead (0-to-1) Term: Initial 12 weeks, approximately 3 days/week Location: Fully remote, async-first, with meaningful European working-hour overlap Rate: £500–£650/day, depending on evidence and experience Start: Immediate Selection: Finalists complete a paid working trial How to Apply The application takes approximately 10 minutes. Apply here: https://tally.so/r/QK94p8 We'll ask for: Two relevant examples of early-stage growth work, including the starting position, problem, your personal contribution, what you shipped, results, and what didn't work. An example where an apparent acquisition problem turned out to be a different funnel, product, or positioning problem. What you'd need access to in your first week. Your availability, time zone, day rate, and number of other active clients. A short recording after trying AutoGPT, covering the biggest unknown you'd investigate, the first metric you'd establish, and one thing you'd deliberately avoid doing prematurely. We assess candidates on relevant evidence, analytical judgment, hands-on execution, customer and product-marketing ability, brand judgment, and autonomy. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/autogpt-gtm-lead
