items.title: Consultancy for the Design and Production of Four Animated Videos Showcasing SUNCASA’s Achievements and Inspiring Youth Engagement in Sustaining Project Results
items.summary: Headquarters: Dire Dawa, Ethiopia URL: http://iisd.org Background The Scaling Urban Nature-based Solutions (NbS) for Climate Adaptation in Sub-Saharan Africa (SUNCASA) is a 3-year project aiming at enhancing climate resilience and promoting gender equality, social inclusion, and biodiversity protection across three cities: Dire Dawa (Ethiopia), Kig
items.description: Design Headquarters: Dire Dawa, Ethiopia URL: http://iisd.org Background The Scaling Urban Nature-based Solutions (NbS) for Climate Adaptation in Sub-Saharan Africa (SUNCASA) is a 3-year project aiming at enhancing climate resilience and promoting gender equality, social inclusion, and biodiversity protection across three cities: Dire Dawa (Ethiopia), Kigali (Rwanda) and Johannesburg (South Africa). Led by the International Institute for Sustainable Development and the World Resources Institute, and implemented in partnership with local organizations and communities, SUNCASA seeks to address climate change impacts—such as floods, landslides, and soil erosion—through gender-responsive and socially inclusive NbS. These include afforestation, reforestation, agroforestry, urban greening, the removal of invasive alien species, and the creation of vegetated buffer zones in flood-prone areas. Entering its third and final year of the current implementation phase, SUNCASA is already achieving significant results, generating measurable adaptation outcomes and strengthening the resilience of communities and landscapes across its project sites. To sustain these achievements beyond the project time frame, SUNCASA is investing in building local ownership and stewardship, with a particular emphasis on engaging children and youth as future custodians of their environments. For more information, visit www.suncasa.org . As part of this effort, SUNCASA is developing a series of four animated videos, with stories and scripts co-created alongside local partners to ensure they reflect community realities, priorities, and cultural contexts. Through engaging storytelling and accessible messages, the animations will encourage young audiences to understand the importance of protecting local ecosystems and livelihoods, recognize their role in sustaining climate adaptation efforts, and contribute to building more resilient and sustainable communities. Purpose of the Consultancy Within the framework of SUNCASA’s Communications Strategy, IISD is seeking an experienced animator or animation studio to conceptualize, design, and produce a series of three animated videos showcasing the project's NbS impacts and highlighting the role of local youth in sustaining these achievements across SUNCASA's three project cities. A fourth animation will focus on promoting the project's gender equality and social inclusion (GESI) approach. Working closely with SUNCASA's Communications team and representatives from the project's local partners, the consultant will be responsible for translating existing scripts into engaging visual narratives through the development of high-quality animations of approximately 2–2.5 minutes each. The videos should communicate the project's approach, results, and impact in a way that is compelling, accessible, and suitable for diverse audiences, with a particular focus on young people. Animations and supporting illustrations must be designed on Adobe Creative Cloud software—After Effects, Illustrator, and InDesign. SUNCASA will provide relevant reference materials—including photographs, videos, project documentation, and brand assets—to inform the visual concept, character design, and storytelling. The animations will be based on scripts co-created with local partners to ensure they authentically reflect the social, cultural, and environmental contexts of each project location. The consultant will be expected to develop a distinctive visual style that resonates with local audiences while maintaining consistency across the animation series. The animations are expected to be developed primarily in English. The SUNCASA Communications team will provide all voiceover and dialogue recordings, including versions in local languages such as Amharic, Afaan Oromo, and Kinyarwanda, which the consultant will integrate into the final productions. The assignment covers the full animation production process, including visual concept development, character and environment design, storyboarding, illustration, animation, editing, and post-production. Final deliverables will include landscape and portrait versions of each animation, optimized for web, social media, and mobile platforms. The consultant will also provide all editable source files—including artwork, illustrations, animation assets, and project files—to allow future adaptation and reuse by the SUNCASA Communications team. The completed animations will support educational and awareness-raising activities led by SUNCASA’s local partners, particularly among children and youth. They will also be disseminated through community WhatsApp and Telegram groups and promoted through SUNCASA’s and partners’ websites and social media channels, helping to expand outreach, strengthen engagement, and reinforce the long-term sustainability of project outcomes. Objectives of the Consultancy General Objective The overall objective of this consultancy is to design and produce a series of four short, animated videos that communicate the achievements and impacts of the SUNCASA project in an engaging and accessible way. This includes three animations highlighting the project’s NbS interventions and their contribution to community and ecosystem resilience across three cities, while one will focus on SUNCASA’s GESI approach. The animations aim to strengthen local ownership and long-term sustainability of project results by engaging children and youth as key audiences. Through culturally relevant storytelling co-developed with local partners, the animations should inspire behavioural change and reinforce the role of youth as key agents of resilience and environmental stewardship. The final products will serve as adaptable communication tools for community outreach, education, and broader dissemination through digital platforms and partner networks. Specific Objectives To design and produce four high-quality animated videos (approximately 2–2.5 minutes each) that communicate SUNCASA’s results, impacts, and approaches in an engaging, accessible, and visually compelling format, particularly to younger audiences. To develop three animations showcasing SUNCASA’s NbS interventions and their contribution to strengthening the resilience of communities and ecosystems across the project’s three cities. To produce one animation highlighting SUNCASA’s GESI approach and its role in promoting inclusive and equitable climate adaptation outcomes. To lead the full animation production process, including visual concept development, character and environment design, storyboarding, illustration, animation, editing, and post-production, in close collaboration with SUNCASA’s Communications team and local partners. To deliver final outputs in both landscape and portrait formats, as well as short versions of each video optimized for social media, along with all editable source files (including artwork, illustrations, animation assets, and project files) to enable future adaptation and reuse by the SUNCASA Communications team. Tasks and Deliverables The consultant will be responsible for leading the full animation production process as outlined below: Activity 1: Inception and Creative Development Review all aesthetics and visual reference materials provided by SUNCASA. Participate in a kickoff meeting with the SUNCASA Communications teams and representatives of the local partner organizations. Develop a creative concept and visual approach aligned with SUNCASA branding and the visual references provided. Prepare a detailed production plan and timeline, including at least three rounds of feedback and the platform on which concepts and drafts will be shared for review. Deliverable 1 : Detailed work plan, including time frame; Creative concept with animation style and visual approach. Activity 2: Storyboards - Based on the co-created scripts provided by the SUNCASA Communications team and informed by the approved creative concept, the consultant will design individual storyboards for each animation. Deliverable 2 : Individual storyboards for each video, with a detailed description of each sequence and scene. Activity 3 : Initial Video Drafts - Following the scripts provided by the SUNCASA Comms team and the approved storyboard, the consultant will develop initial versions of all four animations with no audio and submit them for review. Based on feedback, the updated versions will be created and submitted for approval. - Drafts should include motion graphics, character animations, as well as maps and geographic visualization where applicable. Deliverable 3 : The initial and updated cut of each video animation draft with no audio, including the feedback provided by the team. Activity 4: Final versions of all four animated videos in English and integration of voiceover, dialogues in local languages, as well as soundtrack; create cut-down social media cuts - The consultant will use the approved versions to integrate the voiceover, dialogues, and soundtrack into each animation. - In addition to English, one animation will have a version in Kinyarwanda; and one will have versions in Amharic and Afaan Oromo—translations to be provided by the SUNCASA Communications team. - An additional round of feedback will be required at this stage before approval of the final versions. - In addition to the full animations, the consultant will deliver a cut-down version (30 to 45 seconds) of each video, optimized for social media. Deliverable 4 : A final version of each animation in English with voiceover, dialogues, and soundtrack in local languages, as applicable. A cut-down version of each animation for social media. Activity 5: Submit all editable source files (including artwork, illustrations, animation assets, and project files) - Organize, name, and share all working files, including artwork, illustrations, animation assets, and project files. Deliverable 5 : A folder with all required assets to be shared with the SUNCASA Communications team. Read the full Terms of Reference here for Reporting, Evaluation and Selection Criteria. Consultancy for the Design and Production of Four Animated Videos Showcasing SUNCASA’s Achievements and Inspiring Youth Engagement in Sustaining Project Results Application deadline: August 3, 2026 Application Process All applications must be submitted in English. To apply for this consultancy, please send: Cover Letter outlining relevant professional experience of proposed consultant(s). Please include the name and contact details of the primary contact person. Detailed resume of proposed consultant(s) highlighting relevant experience in all stages of animation production, from creative concept to post-production. Technical Proposal outlining understanding of the assignment and how the consultant(s) plan to undertake the project, including a proposed work plan and timeline. The proposed work plan must align with the deliverables and timeline set out in Sections 4 and 5. Portfolio with at least three examples of relevant animation videos. Please indicate the links to the videos in the technical proposal. Financial Proposal that includes the consultant’s daily rate and any additional costs associated with this assignment, with all costs clearly broken down and aligned to each deliverable and key activities outlined in the Scope of Work. Financial proposals must be aligned with the scope described in Section 5 of this RFP. At least two (2) references from previous related projects. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/iisd-consultancy-for-the-design-and-production-of-four-animated-videos-showcasing-suncasa-s-achievements-and

Ensure that store teams are equipped with the necessary tools and resources to perform their duties efficiently and effectively. Foster a culture of excellence in service delivery, ensuring that all repair and maintenance activities contribute to a positive shopping experience. REQUIREMENTS: Education: High School diploma or equivalent required; Associate’s degree or higher in Facilities Management, Business Administration, or a related field preferred. Experience in facilities maintenance, repair management, or retail operations. Experience in retail environments with multi-location operations is preferred. Previous experience managing a team, including contractors, vendors, and technicians. Strong knowledge of building systems, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and general repairs. Experience with budgeting, cost control, and managing maintenance projects. Strong leadership and team management abilities. Excellent organizational and time management skills. Ability to multitask and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced retail environment. Strong communication skills and the ability to interact effectively with store managers, staff, and external vendors. Proficient in Google Suite and facilities management software(s). This position may require occasional evening or weekend work to minimize disruptions to store operations. Ability to travel between multiple retail locations may be necessary. The job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the Team Member(s) of this position. Team Members will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform any other job-related duties requested by any person authorized to give instructions or assignments.

If you’re interested in this opportunity, click APPLY TO POSITION to proceed. \*\*\****************************************************************** Title: CPT-11420 Digital Marketing & Patient Engagement Virtual Assistant Independent Contractor – CPT-11420 Digital Marketing & Patient Engagement Virtual Assistant/Marketing VA/Junior-Advanced Level (Remote). Overview 20four7VA is seeking offshore independent contractors to deliver remote services to clients worldwide, with a primary focus on developed markets such as the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, and Australia. An established California wellness center offering chiropractic, acupuncture, massage, and related wellness services is seeking an experienced Digital Marketing & Patient Engagement Virtual Assistant. The immediate priority is finding a proactive marketing professional who can take ownership of day-to-day marketing execution, particularly social media, content creation and scheduling, email/SMS campaigns, and patient nurture workflows. The client has an existing library of professional photos, videos, and content. The VA will be expected to organize and repurpose those assets, follow the clinic’s schedule and promotions, maintain consistent marketing activity, and help ensure leads and patients move through established nurture processes. This is a hands-on marketing execution role. The client will provide business direction, but wants someone experienced enough to identify what content or input is needed and keep the marketing workflow moving without constant supervision. The objective of each engagement is to assist the client in improving business efficiency, enhancing service delivery, or supporting operational functions through high-quality, task-specific services rendered by a qualified contractor. Scope of Services Contractors will be required to provide services that align with the following client tasks: Social Media & Content Manage ongoing Instagram and social media posting Build and maintain a recurring content calendar Align posts with practitioner schedules, promotions, availability, and clinic activities Repurpose existing photos and videos into social content Create graphics and short-form videos using Canva and CapCut Prepare Stories, Reels, promotional posts, and other approved content Request needed photos, videos, or information from the internal team Email, SMS & Patient Nurture Create and schedule basic email and SMS marketing campaigns Assist with patient nurture journeys within GleanTap Learn and maintain GleanTap workflows and automations Coordinate marketing activity with Mindbody Monitor nurture workflows and identify when human follow-up is needed Follow up with advertising leads when appropriate Communicate required follow-up to clinic staff when needed Marketing Coordination Maintain recurring marketing schedules and deadlines Coordinate with the internal team through Microsoft Teams Attend the weekly Tuesday team meeting from 11:30 AM–12:30 PM PST Keep promotions and campaigns organized Utilize AI tools to improve marketing efficiency and content production Assist with basic website/content updates as needed Each engagement is based on a defined scope of work and is governed by an independent contractor agreement. Services must be performed professionally, with adherence to any timelines, guidelines, and deliverables agreed upon in writing. Skills The Contractor must demonstrate proficiency in the following, depending on the Client’s requirements: Previous digital marketing experience required Social media management experience required Canva experience required Short-form video editing experience required Email and SMS marketing experience strongly preferred CRM or marketing automation experience strongly preferred Healthcare, wellness, medical, or similar experience a plus Mindbody experience a plus Klaviyo or similar platform experience a plus GleanTap experience not required; training can be provided Willingness to get a HIPPA certification if needed Basic SEO and website maintenance experience is a plus IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE Proactive and comfortable taking ownership of recurring marketing execution Strong social media and content creation background Able to work independently without waiting for every task to be assigned Strong visual judgment Excellent written communication Comfortable working with healthcare-related information confidentially Quick learner who can become proficient in new platforms Strong AI and digital productivity skills Organized and responsive when working with a busy clinic team APPLICATION SOFTWARE KNOWLEDGEABLE / REQUIRED Canva CapCut Instagram GleanTap – Training Available Mindbody – Training Available Klaviyo or Similar Email Platform Vimeo Microsoft Teams AI Content / Productivity Tools Work Schedule Contracted Hours per Week: 20 Hours Scheduled Working Days: Monday through Friday (unless otherwise mutually agreed in writing) Daily Working Time: 10 AM - 2 PM PST Note: The Company will make reasonable efforts to align the Assigned VA’s schedule with the Client’s preferred hours as set forth above. items.description: Join phData, a remote-first data and AI consultancy company with employees across the United States, Latin America, and India. We partner with industry leaders, including Snowflake, AWS, Anthropic, Glean, and dbt, to solve the complex data and AI challenges that slow large enterprises. We’re growing fast, and we give our people real ownership over their work. We hire top performers and trust them to deliver results. Why phData? Snowflake Implementation Partner of the Year — 7 consecutive years, and 2026 Snowflake AI Partner of the Year AWS Premier Tier Services Partner — the highest tier of recognition in the AWS Partner Network 2025 Fivetran Partner of the Year (4th consecutive year) 2025 dbt Labs Partner of the Year (3x winner) with Visionary partner status 2026 KNIME Customer Excellence Partner of the Year Preferred Partner in the Anthropic Claude Partner Network #1 Partner in Snowflake Advanced Certifications 600+ Expert Cloud Certifications (Sigma, AWS, Azure, Dataiku, and more) Recognized as an award-winning workplace in the US, India and LATAM We are looking for an AI Services lead to join our Client Services team. This role will lead our commercial strategy, methodology, and client success for the Anthropic private equity channel. To succeed, you will build credibility with Anthropic and with operating and investment partners at PE firms, demonstrating that you and phData can guide them in integrating Anthropic - and data and AI more broadly - into their value-creation strategies. You understand the different types of PE firms and how they think about EBITDA improvement, hold periods, and exit multiples. You know how operating and investment partners evaluate the business value of data and AI, where AI can create measurable enterprise value across a portfolio, and how to translate those opportunities into a pipeline of high-conviction engagements that phData and Anthropic can win and deliver together. Key Responsibilities Own the private equity vertical within the Anthropic partnership, building and managing relationships at the fund level and driving AI activation and client success across portfolio companies. Partner with funds and portcos to develop and apply AI value creation frameworks tailored to PE investment theses, connecting Claude-powered solutions to EBITDA improvement, operational efficiency, and exit readiness. Lead the origination and shaping of engagements across the PE portfolio lifecycle: due diligence, post-close integration, value creation, and exit preparation. Act as the primary executive sponsor for PE-focused accounts present in partner-level conversations, credible in CFO and operating partner discussions, and accountable for the outcome. Build and maintain account plans that extend across fund relationships, not just individual portfolio companies, turning a single PE firm into a multi-portfolio, multi-year program. Partner with Anthropic’s financial services and enterprise field teams to coordinate go-to-market motions, co-develop proposals, and align on account strategy. Shape how phData engages the PE market by building playbooks, value frameworks, and repeatable patterns that form the foundation for a scalable vertical. Mentor delivery leaders and account teams embedded in PE engagements, ensuring the quality of client relationships and AI outcomes meets the bar this industry demands. About You You are financially fluent, commercially aggressive, and deeply familiar with how private equity firms evaluate and create value. You understand that in PE, everything is measured, and you hold your AI programs to the same standard. The traits below aren’t aspirational; they describe who you already are: Extreme Ownership: You consider “business as usual” in your account plan a failure. Stagnant accounts are a personal problem you refuse to tolerate. You push action, create momentum, and treat every week without a clear next use case as a gap you need to close. Order Maker, Not Order Taker: PE firms don’t hire advisors who respond to RFPs. They hire people who come in with a point of view on where value is being left on the table and a concrete plan to capture it. You are that person. You walk into every GP meeting with a proposed next chapter, not a recap of the last one. Financially Grounded: You speak the language of private equity fluently, EBITDA, hold period, operating leverage, portfolio roll-up, and exit multiple. You don’t need someone to translate business outcomes into financial impact. You do that yourself, and you build it into every proposal you write. Attention to Detail: You believe sloppy account management is a trust destroyer, and trust is harder to rebuild in PE than in any other industry. The account plan is accurate. The value creation tracker is live. The engagement status reflects reality. You don’t let things drift. Required Qualifications 10–15+ years of experience in a hybrid client advisory and commercial role within consulting, professional services, or financial services with direct accountability for engagement quality and revenue growth. Demonstrated experience working with or within private equity firms, portfolio companies, or financial services organizations with a clear understanding of how PE firms make investment and operating decisions. Track record scoping and delivering $500K–$5M+ services programs with measurable financial outcomes (EBITDA improvement, cost reduction, revenue acceleration, or operational efficiency). History of building multi-account, multi-engagement programs, not just managing individual projects with responsibility for the growth of the overall portfolio. Proven ability to operate at the GP, CFO, and operating partner level as a credible, trusted advisor, not just a delivery contact. Experience building AI or data value creation frameworks that connect technology investment to quantifiable business and financial outcomes. Comfort operating with limited structure in a high-growth, matrixed environment where the playbook is still being written. Willingness to travel up to 50% based on client and partner needs. Technical / Functional Skills Sufficient AI/data fluency to shape engagements involving agentic AI, LLM-powered workflows, and data infrastructure, including RAG, agent orchestration, MCP-style integrations, and AI evals without requiring a technical co-lead to define the solution. Direct experience with Anthropic (Claude for Work, API, or Enterprise) or a comparable LLM platform, with the ability to articulate where Claude creates differentiated value for financial services use cases. Financial modeling and business case development capability able to build or validate an ROI model, connect AI outcomes to EBITDA impact, and present it credibly to a PE investment committee or operating partner. Preferred Qualifications Preferred qualifications help candidates stand out but are not required for success in this role. CPA, CFA, or MBA with a finance or accounting concentration, or equivalent, demonstrating financial fluency in a client-facing role. Direct experience building or operating within a PE-focused practice at a consulting or technology services firm. Prior success designing and executing AI value creation programs specifically within PE-backed portfolio companies with documented financial impact. Existing relationships within the private equity ecosystem (GPs, operating partners, portfolio CFOs) that are relevant to the Anthropic partnership. Experience in structuring fund-level AI strategies that span multiple portfolio companies under a single investment thesis. Why phData? Impactful Work: Partner with leading organizations on meaningful data and AI initiatives. Collaborative Culture: Work with a supportive, high-performing global team that values transparency, autonomy, and continuous improvement. Growth Opportunities: Access to challenging projects, mentorship, and structured development pathways. Values-Driven: We prioritize doing the right thing for our clients, our teams, and our community. Benefits at phData US: Remote-First Work Environment 401k plan with company match Dental and Vision insurance Home Office Equipment Stipend Annual stipend for Learning and Development Competitive comp, excellent benefits, Flexible PTO plan plus 10 Holidays (and other cool perks) phData celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our approach helps us to build a winning team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and abilities. So, regardless of how your diversity expresses itself, you can find a home here at phData. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, genetic information, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. If you would like to request an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at People Operations.

Working Hours: EU Timezone | 5 days per week including some weekends About The Opportunity: You will join a team of risk & trading professionals, serving as the first line of defense against irregular market movements. The team is responsible to ensure our users and company are well protected by identifying early signs of high risk activities (i.e liquidation events, high volatility periods) . In addition to real-time monitoring, you will also have the opportunity to work on risk alerts/tools enhancements. Responsibilities Monitor and assess key risk areas within derivatives/margin, looking into unusual trading patterns to prevent manipulative trades Develop risk models/alerts/tools/dashboards, enhancing the monitoring capaibilities Conduct daily review, and root cause analysis of the incidents Prepare accurate risk reports and findings to relevant team in a timely manner. Explore the usage of AI and automation for trading risk monitoring Proactively share timely updates on market developments/news and demonstrate deep expertise in market dynamics. Implement and maintain risk policies and procedures in alignment with organizational strategy and evolving market conditions to prevent, mitigate, and eliminate risks. Requirements You’re curious and passionate about cryptocurrency derivatives Able to work shift, 5 days per week (Including some weekends) Good knowledge of Crypto Derivatives, with defi knowledge as an added bonus (being aware of the latest developments can help in this role). Bachelors' Degree, preferably related to Mathematics, Quant Finance, Financial Engineering Experience in AI and automation is an added bonus Why Binance • Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem • Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure • Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment • Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning • Competitive salary and company benefits • Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team) Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. items.description: DevOps and Sysadmin Headquarters: ignitionit.com URL: https://ignitionit.com APPLY HERE: https://go.cultureindex.com/p/bLvP56CvGHU Fully Remote · Work from home · Full-time (Eastern or Pacific time zones) · Apple-first TL;DR ignitionit.com is a seasoned, Apple-first MSP — in business for almost 30 years — and we're hiring a Help Desk Technician to be the friendly, capable first voice our clients reach when something isn't working. This position is a remote, work-from-home, full-time role. We've written this as a junior-to-mid-level job description because that's where most great people start on our team. But if you're more seasoned — comfortable in identity, MDM, or security work — don't scroll past. We'd be delighted to find someone who can step in higher up the ladder, and we'll happily talk about a more senior scope and comp if that's you. What the actual job??? Unlike many IT shops, we believe that the technology is the tactic. The actual job is making people feel taken care of. One of our core values is “49% tech support, 51% human support.” You'll succeed by configuring devices, resetting access, untangling email, and chasing down the gremlin that's been haunting someone's conference room. But you'll know you succeeded when a client exhales and says, “Thank goodness you're on it!” That Warm Fuzzy Feeling™ is the actual product. The green lights on the dashboard are just how we get there. In a typical week, you might: Onboard a new hire at a fast-growing startup: provision their Mac, set up their Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 accounts, enroll the device in MDM, and make sure day one feels effortless. Offboard a departing employee cleanly — recover the laptop, revoke access, and close the loop so nothing's left dangling. All boxes checked, ticket notated and closed, client followed up with. Field a "my email stopped working" ticket that turns out to be a DNS thing, a phishing-filter thing, or a "they changed their password on their phone three weeks ago" thing. Help a family office or RIA get a touchy Zoom Room or conference-room AV setup behaving before a meeting — over the phone. Triage the queue so phones get answered fast, emails don't rot, and nobody feels forgotten — even when the honest answer is, “We're on it, but here's the realistic timeline." ⠀ You'll be the front line: helping with what you can, researching what you can't, and pinging the rest of the team when you're genuinely stuck. That last part is a skill, not a weakness — knowing when to ask is half the job. About ignitionit.com We're one of the oldest Apple Technical Partners on the planet, and one of the only certified Apple Premier Partners — that’s kinda like getting knighted by the ghost of Steve Jobs. We started where you’d expect to find Macs (creative agencies, non-profits, education) but our primary clients today are cutting-edge, venture-backed AI SaaS startups, VC and private equity firms, registered investment advisors — many of them operating under stringent compliance expectations (SOC 2, SEC). That means we hold ourselves to a higher standard than the scrappy shop we started as. Polished, reliable, security-minded work is the baseline now — but always with a smile! What hasn't changed: relationships are still our most valuable currency — with clients, with vendors, and with each other. We're a tight, supportive team. We teach each other what we know, cover for each other when life throws a punch, and care a little too much about doing things the right way. We're still a bit weird, and our clients seem to like us that way. We move fast, priorities shift, it’s not always documented (whatever it is), our tool set and list of supported platforms is sprawling, and some days the to-do list is longer than you'd like. If you can stay warm under pressure, create order out of chaos, learn new stuff fast because you love it, and speak up when you need help, you'll thrive here. If you need a rigid, fully-documented, never-changes environment where nobody trusts you with admin access, where you will be micro-managed so you never have to wonder whether or not you’re doing the right thing, this isn't it. You’ll have a ton of independence on our team, and freedom to use your best judgment to get the ball over the finish line, but that also means we expect you to be naturally responsible, honest, and highly accountable — to yourself, your teammates, and the clients. As they say, the price of freedom is eternal vigilance. The tech you'll work with (and grow into) Day one, you'll be living in: Apple at the core — macOS, iOS, Apple Business Manager, and MDM (Jamf / Iru / Intune / Workspace ONE / and more) Yes, PCs too — about one-third of our users are driving Windows Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 admin consoles Identity and access — SSO, MFA, and security keys (Okta, Entra ID, Yubikey, and friends) Lots of other security tools — our stack is constantly evolving and may vary from client to client The everyday productivity stack — Slack, Zoom, conference-room AV, networking basics (Meraki), and endpoint tooling ⠀ You don't need to know all of this. You need to be the kind of person who wants to. As you grow, there's a clear path into infrastructure administration, project architecture and implementation, and — for the right person — security and compliance work (phishing simulations, endpoint detection, SOC 2 / CIS / SEC readiness, due diligence questionnaire support, etc.). That's where our most senior people live, and it's wide open. Who we hope you are The hard requirements — we won't move forward unless you: Can work standard business hours in Eastern or Pacific time zones (we currently need both) Have a quiet home workspace and reliable broadband Have proven Apple aptitude — you actually use and like the Apple ecosystem Have at least 2 years of IT support experience on the job. Go-getters who are just getting started and can prove they have a deep, demonstrable history of teaching themselves technology for the sheer joy of it might also make the cut. ⠀ Everything else — and this is the longer list, on purpose. We figure technical skills are teachable; character takes a lot longer. So we're looking for someone who: Genuinely cares — about clients, teammates, and doing right by people Loves to learn, and proves it in how they spend their time Reads, and writes clearly — clear writing is clear thinking, and you'll do a lot of it Stays calm and kind with a frustrated person on the other end of the line Can tell the difference between good customer service and fantastic customer service, and refuses to settle for the former Notices when something's being done inefficiently and fixes it (you may boast about it later, that’s fine) Proofreads their own work (yes, we noticed whether you proofread your application) Has a sense of humor, and doesn't take themselves too seriously Regarding AI Our company founder/CEO is headquartered in the Bay Area. We work with innovative, ambitious companies developing AI products. Our team members hold a range of opinions about whether AI is “good or bad” for humans, but at the end of the day, we embrace the plain fact that it is here, we must embrace it to evolve, and our clients increasingly depend on us to help them embrace it, too, to help them evolve and stay competitive. Our CEO's opinion: AI will not replace human labor any time soon; rather, AI is a new opportunity to either (a) get things done faster, or (b) get a much higher quality of output than before. If you’re an AI tinkerer, great! We want to hear how you’re using it and see your latest vibe project. If you’re allergic to AI or have no interest in learning new habits to work effectively with it, this is not the place for you. Compensation & logistics Base salary: For applicants closer to the junior side who are located in the USA, $50,000–$65,000/yr, depending on experience level and your local geographical price index. With experience, comp goes up from there. Genuinely experienced, more senior candidates can be slotted higher — let's talk. Applicants outside the USA will be compensated according to your local employment market. Type & location: Full-time, work from home, fully remote. Eastern or Pacific time zones. Benefits: Medical / dental / vision for the employee, 401(k) with employer contribution, 2 weeks of PTO annually to start, and a stipend for your home internet. How to apply The first step is really easy and only takes 10 minutes — no resume, no cover letter, no essays. Here's how: Take this online Culture Index assessment (about 10 minutes): We use it to screen for people whose natural wiring fits how our team works. If your profile lines up with what we're looking for, we'll reach out and ask you to complete a 60-minute TestGorilla assessment for critical thinking skills, send us your resume, and maybe a couple of other items. From there, we conduct between 2-4 video interviews. One of these might be a live technical assessment. If the Culture Index step feels like a strange way to start a job application — that's kind of the point. Remember the phrase Think Different? Ignition is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and will consider all qualified applicants. Good luck in your search — and may the Force be with you! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ignition-inc-mac-msp-help-desk-guru-work-from-home

items.summary: At The Coca-Cola Company, we believe data is the foundation for creating personalized experiences and powering sustainable growth in today's digital-first world. As consumers engage with our brands in more connected ways than ever before, we are investing in advanced data and analytics platforms to unlock deeper insights, accelerate decision-making
items.description: Data and Analytics At The Coca-Cola Company, we believe data is the foundation for creating personalized experiences and powering sustainable growth in today's digital-first world. As consumers engage with our brands in more connected ways than ever before, we are investing in advanced data and analytics platforms to unlock deeper insights, accelerate decision-making, and enable seamless innovation at scale. In this role as a Sr. Data Engineer - Integrations, you will drive the technical strategy and architecture for how data flows across our enterprise ecosystem. By leveraging your expert-level proficiency in Spark, Scala/Java development, and JVM-based engineering, you will design scalable data products. Core Responsibilities Architect and oversee enterprise-scale data integration pipelines and data products. Establish Medallion architecture patterns (Bronze, Silver, Gold) within Microsoft Fabric to ensure data quality, scalability, and reusability. Optimization: Act as the ultimate escalation point for complex Spark performance tuning. Deep-dive into Catalyst optimizer query plans, JVM memory profiling, and advanced partitioning strategies to resolve platform-wide bottlenecks and maximize cost efficiency. Complex Backend System Design: Lead the system design and architecture of highly available, REST-based microservices and APIs on the JVM, enabling seamless, low-latency interoperability between complex internal and external systems. Engineer modular, testable, and maintainable code applying functional programming principles and industry-best patterns for reliability and performance. Optimize workflows through data partitioning strategies, storage formats, and platform configurations to enable high-performance querying and cost efficiency. Engineering Excellence & Mentorship: Champion the "You Build It, You Run It" philosophy. Define the standards for functional programming and SOLID principles in Scala. Conduct architectural reviews, lead code quality initiatives, and mentor Grade 10 and junior engineers. CI/CD & Automation: Architect and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Maven, and SBT to automate testing, deployment, and configuration of data artifacts. Required Qualifications & Experience Expert Scala & JVM Architecture: Expert-level proficiency in Scala programming and JVM internals. Demonstrated ability to design concurrent, modular systems using advanced functional programming concepts. Advanced Spark Expertise (5+ years): Deep, hands-on experience building, debugging, and optimizing enterprise-grade distributed computing applications using Apache Spark (Scala preferred). Proven track record of solving complex data skew and memory management issues at scale. Data Architecture & Strategy: Extensive experience designing scalable data models (STAR, Vault, Tabular) and building out Medallion architectures for complex enterprise analytics and structured streaming applications. Backend & API Engineering: Proven experience architecting and scaling REST-based microservices and robust backend applications on the JVM. Synapse/Fabric Leadership (4-5+ years combined): Deep architectural experience transforming large data ecosystems using Azure Data Services (Synapse, Fabric, ADF, Azure Functions). DevOps & CI/CD Mastery: Proven ability to architect automated release cycles and infrastructure deployment. Hands-on expertise with Git, GitHub Actions, build tools (Maven/SBT), and configuring environments for parallel development. Delivery: Experience in Agile development (Scrum, lean techniques) and collaborating with global engineering teams. Location(s): Mexico City/Cities: Mexico Travel Required: 00% - 25% Relocation Provided: No Job Posting End Date: August 29, 2026 Our Purpose and Growth Culture: We are taking deliberate action to nurture an inclusive culture that is grounded in our company purpose, to refresh the world and make a difference. We act with a growth mindset, take an expansive approach to what's possible and believe in continuous learning to improve our business and ourselves. We focus on four key behaviors - curious, empowered, inclusive and agile - and value how we work as much as what we achieve. We believe that our culture is one of the reasons our company continues to thrive after 130+ years. Visit Our Purpose and Vision to learn more about these behaviors and how you can bring them to life in your next role at Coca-Cola. Annual Incentive Reference Value Percentage:15 Annual Incentive reference value is a market-based competitive value for your role. It falls in the middle of the range for your role, indicating performance at target.

items.description: Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions. Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. The Opportunity: At Grafana Labs, we’re redefining what post-sales technical partnership looks like—and it starts with the Observability Architect . This is a role for deeply technical experts who are ready to step into strategic leadership with our most important customers. If you thrive at the intersection of systems thinking, architecture design, and customer impact—this is your stage. As an Observability Architect, you will be the technical owner of long-term customer success. You’ll architect and guide the implementation of complex observability solutions across a wide range of modern infrastructure and application environments. You’ll build strategic relationships with engineers, SREs, and architects—ensuring Grafana’s technology is not just deployed, but deeply embedded into mission-critical systems. Working hand-in-hand with our Engagement Managers, you’ll lead technical discovery, design, onboarding, and enablement—all with a focus on delivering tangible outcomes. You’ll spot patterns, solve hard problems, and guide customers through their observability maturity curve with authority and clarity. You’ll also represent the technical voice of our customers internally—shaping product feedback and roadmap priorities by working closely with Engineering and Product Management. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for those who want to go deep, stay technical, and directly influence customer success at scale. Join us and become part of the most respected observability team in the industry. What You'll Be Doing: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for a portfolio of Grafana customers. Design the observability maturity journey of customers and assist them on that path. Provide expert-level troubleshooting and guidance to drive adoption. Conduct regular technical reviews and health checks to ensure client success. Assist in RCA to understand issues that affect customer satisfaction, retention, and overall product experience. Advise clients on best practices and strategies for leveraging our technology to achieve their business goals Collaborate with clients to develop and execute technical roadmaps. Identify opportunities for clients to optimize their cost, expand their use of our solutions and drive adoption of new products and features. Develop and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key stakeholders. With the support of our Engagement Managers and Onboarding Solutions Architects, own customer lifecycle. Drive the adoption and effective use of our product suite within your customer portfolio to maximize their value from our platform and ensure a strong return on investment. Act as the voice of the customer within the company, advocating for their needs, priorities and feature requests. Conduct training sessions and workshops to educate clients on our technology. Develop and deliver technical documentation, guides, and tutorials. Work alongside account teams to participate in and/or conduct regular reviews with customers to identify areas for improvement, calculate ROI, assess their satisfaction, and discuss upcoming needs and projects. Prepare and present reports on client metrics, achievements, and areas of focus. What Makes You a Great Fit: Located on the West Coast Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Math or a related field (or equivalent experience). Experience deploying and operating Kubernetes. 5+ years of experience in a technical support, technical account management, consulting, SE or Professional Services role within the technology industry. Strong understanding of observability solutions. Grafana, Prometheus, and Loki a plus. Proven ability to manage multiple clients and projects simultaneously. Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills. Experience with relevant tools and technologies, e.g., CRM software, ticketing systems, specific programming languages. Ability to travel as needed to meet with clients (up to 25%). Identify and provide timely workarounds and solutions to meet a customer’s business needs. You have some observability expertise, preferably architect level First class written and oral communication skills to collaborate with our remote-first internal teams and with our worldwide customers. Ability to articulate our value proposition and the technical advantages of our products You will love solving technical challenges and thrive on bringing creative solutions to our customers Bonus Points For: 2+ years of technical sales, TAM or other post sales technical experience, ideally with open source technologies, or in the observability space. Great at connecting product usage to value (ROI). Great at managing customer lifecycle. You will be creative in solving customer adoption challenges. You can proactively assist customers with technical issues that may arise and assist in the troubleshooting and root cause analysis. You should have a technical mindset and a desire to grow technically. Great candidates may be a recent grad of a coding bootcamp or have previous post-sales or engineering experience–we are excited to see what unique experiences and skill sets you bring to the table! In the US, the OTE compensation range for this role is $139,000 - $167,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow. Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings. #LI-Remote For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy .

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, New Jersey URL: http://betmgm.com Discover What’s Possible at BetMGM Ready to make your career legendary? Join us as we bring the magic of Vegas to our players. The BetMGM team has over 1,400 talented members, revolutionizing sports betting and online gaming in the United States and Canada. We’re a brand with technology at our hearts and the most driven and focused talent in the business. As a valued team member, we’re committed to giving you the resources and support you need to thrive. Our benefits and perks include: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and Disability Insurance 401(k) with company match Pre-tax spending accounts including health care FSA and commuter savings Flexible paid time off Professional development reimbursement and ongoing skills training opportunities Employee resource groups Swag, ticket giveaways, and more! At BetMGM, we recognize that every individual plays a meaningful role in our success. That’s why we’re committed to building a respectful, inclusive workplace. It’s the strategy behind every win. By meeting people where they are, we create a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive and a workplace that reflects our values, our people, and our drive to win. The Gaming Marketing & Events Manager is a critical, highly visible role that serves as a linchpin between BetMGM’s digital gaming organization and MGM Resorts International’s land‑based casino portfolio. The role is responsible for ensuring seamless alignment between online and retail gaming experiences by positioning and promoting BetMGM (MI) /Borgata Online (NJ) brands effectively across MGM properties with a focus on MGM Grand Detroit & Borgata Hotel, Casino & Spa. Location: Must be located in NJ or Detroit, MI About the Role The Gaming Marketing & Events Manager is a critical, highly visible role that serves as a linchpin between BetMGM’s digital gaming organization and MGM Resorts International’s land‑based casino portfolio. The role is responsible for ensuring seamless alignment between online and retail gaming experiences by positioning and promoting BetMGM (MI) /Borgata Online (NJ) brands effectively across MGM properties with a focus on MGM Grand Detroit & Borgata Hotel, Casino & Spa. Responsibilities Acting as one of the primary points of contact for MGM, the Gaming Marketing & Events Manager will work alongside the Sr. Manager in strategy, execution, and optimization of integrated marketing initiatives which inspire existing land-based players to choose BetMGM (MI) /Borgata Online (NJ) as their preferred online gaming destination. This individual will play a key role in strengthening brand awareness, customer conversion, and long-term loyalty across our physical and digital channels . In addition, the Gaming Marketing & Events Manager will lead and oversee gaming event/activation execution. Some examples this includes are on-property Big Pull events, VIP experience weekends with MGMAir & co-branded digital-to-retail campaigns that drive player acquisition and engagement through Betting Hero. Oversee and provide day-to-day direction to the gaming events/marketing team, guiding planning timelines, task prioritization, vendor coordination, and on-site execution to ensure successful delivery of all gaming-related events and activations. items.title: Demand Generation Program Manager | United States | Remote
items.summary: Headquarters: United States (Remote) Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see,
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United States (Remote) Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions. Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. The Opportunity Grafana's Demand Generation team is responsible for creating and accelerating pipeline across the full customer journey — from first touch through expansion. We run a modern, AI-forward operation: lifecycle email programs driven by an AI engine, territory-level buying signals surfaced directly to sales leaders, and agentic workflows that handle work that used to take teams of specialists. We're hiring a Demand Generation Program Manager — a generalist who can own programs across channels and audiences, with a first focus on our existing-customer motion: driving expansion and cross-sell demand within accounts that already use Grafana. This is one of the biggest growth opportunities in the business and one of the least-covered by traditional demand gen. This is not a "run the playbook" role. We expect this person to build with AI as a default — designing agentic workflows that scale programs beyond what headcount alone could, and pushing the team forward on how demand gen should operate in 2026 and beyond. You'd be joining a demand gen team that is genuinely rebuilding how the function works — where AI agents run real production programs, and where the people on the team design the machine rather than turn the crank. If you want to define what a demand gen career looks like in the agentic era, this is the seat to do it from. What You'll Be Doing Own customer lifecycle demand gen. Build and run programs that create demand inside our existing customer base — expansion, cross-sell, and adoption plays across email, in-app, web, and field channels, in partnership with sales and customer teams. Work across channels, not in one. Support and strengthen programs across paid, email, events, web, and outbound as team priorities shift. You'll be the person who can step into any channel and make the program better. Build agentic workflows. Use AI tools (Claude Code, agents, internal AI infrastructure) to automate program execution — audience building, content generation, signal detection, campaign QA — and treat automation as a first-class deliverable, not a side project. Connect programs to the sales motion. Translate marketing signals into actions sellers actually take: account coverage, buying signals, campaign follow-up. Partner directly with sales leadership on what's working. Measure what matters. Instrument your programs, report on pipeline impact honestly, and kill what isn't working. What Makes You a Great Fit 5+ years in demand generation, growth marketing, or lifecycle marketing at a B2B software company (open source / developer-focused a plus). Proven range: you've run programs in at least two or three channels (email/lifecycle, paid, events, web, outbound) and can point to pipeline results in each. Experience marketing to existing customers — expansion, cross-sell, or customer lifecycle programs — not just net-new acquisition. Hands-on with AI in your actual work: you've built automations or agentic workflows (or are visibly on that path), and you think about AI as leverage, not a threat or a buzzword. Comfortable with data: you can pull your own numbers, sanity-check them, and build a program readout a VP would trust. Strong program management fundamentals — you ship on time, communicate proactively, and work well with sales, product marketing, and ops without needing a coordinator. Bonus Points For Experience with PLG or product-led motions alongside sales-led ones. Familiarity with the observability / monitoring / open source ecosystem. You've worked in Marketo, Salesforce, and a modern data stack (BigQuery or similar). You've written or shipped something public about AI in marketing operations. In the US, the base compensation range for this role is $ 100,000 - $ 120,000 . Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow. Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings. #LI-Remote For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/grafana-labs-demand-generation-program-manager-united-states-remote

Avaliar impactos de mudanças sistêmicas nos processos financeiros e operacionais. Realizar acompanhamento contínuo da saúde dos sistemas, identificando riscos e oportunidades de melhoria. Elaborar cronogramas, planos de ação, análise de riscos e acompanhamento de entregas. Conduzir cerimônias de projeto e reuniões executivas de status. Apoiar processos de testes, homologação, treinamento e gestão da mudança. Gestão de Backlog e Priorização Manter backlog de melhorias e demandas atualizado e priorizado. Definir critérios de priorização considerando impacto financeiro, riscos regulatórios, experiência do usuário e valor para o negócio. items.title: Conceptual Copywriter
items.summary: Superside is looking for a talented Conceptual Copywriter to ideate and execute impactful creative work across digital campaigns and marketing channels. In this role, you’ll partner with designers, strategists, and performance teams to develop concept-driven copy that delivers both creative impact and measurable results. You will work closely with enterprise-level customers helping translate complex technical ideas into clear, compelling messaging for global audiences. This role is ideal for a writer who enjoys turning strategic insights into powerful creative ideas while crafting high-performing copy across digital platforms.

items.title: Lead Creative Strategist (Performance Marketing)
items.summary: Superside is hiring a Creative Strategist, Performance Marketing to lead the strategic thinking behind our clients' highest-volume, highest-velocity creative programs. You'll sit at the intersection of data and creative, turning performance signals from paid social, OOH, and programmatic campaigns into sharp, testable creative direction — while acting as a trusted strategic partner to the clients whose business results depend on it. You'll run strategy across a portfolio of accounts at once, each producing a high volume of creative every month, and you'll be the person both the client and the creative team turn to when they need to know not just what to make next, but why.

items.description: Who is Boulevard? Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most. Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen . We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most . Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too. Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard. Boulevard's Education team operates at the intersection of Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing, empowering both our customers and internal teams with industry education and strategic methods to drive revenue growth. We are seeking a Knowledge Systems Manager to own and scale our knowledge ecosystem across both customer-facing and internal resources, reporting to the Manager of Education. This role drives the strategy, governance, and organization of our Support Center and all customer-facing content, while also owning the creation and management of internal documentation used cross-functionally by GTM, Marketing, Product, and Support teams. In addition, this role leads AI knowledge optimization — ensuring our AI agent and chatbot surface accurate, high-quality information and continuously improve self-service resolution. You'll use product changes, support trends, and performance data to improve how customers get help, making support more efficient and easier to scale over time. What you'll do here: Knowledge Base Ownership & Strategy Own all customer-facing Support Center content, including creation, governance, updates, and archival Define and maintain Support Center taxonomy, structure, tone of voice, and discoverability standards Create and curate engaging and informative content, including articles, guides, tutorials, and videos, to facilitate education and skill development among customers and team members Establish content quality guidelines to ensure clarity, consistency, and alignment with product functionality Support the upkeep of internal and external knowledge systems (Education Confluence, internal GPTs, LMS training content, Academy, and documentation), helping ensure content stays accurate, current, and accessible as a resource for teams Align with Product and Product Marketing to proactively update content based on releases and feature changes AI Optimization Optimize knowledge content for AI retrieval, ensuring our AI support agents (e.g., Billie/Fin) deliver accurate, high-confidence responses Own the customer experience quality of AI-generated support responses, ensuring Billie/Fin responses are not only accurate, but clear, helpful, appropriately toned, and aligned with Boulevard's support standards Monitor AI performance metrics (resolution rate, deflection rate, confidence levels) and identify opportunities to improve self-service outcomes Proactively identify and close knowledge gaps that contribute to live agent escalations Continuously refine prompts, structure, and knowledge formatting to improve AI effectiveness Collaborate with the AI Support team (e.g., Intercom) to improve knowledge ingestion and response quality Partner closely with Revenue Operations to ensure knowledge content is properly integrated into AI workflows and surfaced effectively across support systems Identify opportunities to leverage AI across the organization to enhance knowledge delivery and content accessibility beyond the support experience Support Insight & Analysis Analyze support trends and ticket data to identify recurring friction points and knowledge gaps that impact the customer and agent experience Translate recurring support trends and ticket drivers into scalable customer-facing guidance, including help content, AI response improvements, internal support guidance, and reusable support communication frameworks Partner with Support Operations to leverage reporting, tooling insights, and workflow data to identify knowledge gaps and opportunities for automation Support the evaluation and rollout of a new support/ticketing platform, ensuring knowledge structures, content, and AI-facing data are properly migrated and optimized for the new environment Serve as the knowledge liaison between Education, Support, Product Marketing, and Product Continuous Improvement & Future State Establish and track KPIs for knowledge performance and self-service effectiveness Regularly audit internal and external knowledge systems for accuracy and relevance Drive process improvements that reduce manual effort and increase scalability Build a sustainable governance model for long-term knowledge health Stay current on industry trends, tools, and best practices to continuously improve our knowledge and support experience What you'll need to thrive: Experience : Proven track record owning a help center or knowledge base end-to-end, strategy through execution, with measurable impact on deflection, resolution, or self-service outcomes. AI & Self-Service Optimization: Experience optimizing content for AI-driven support tools, chatbots, or self-service platforms, structuring knowledge to improve accuracy, deflection, and resolution rates. Information Architecture Mindset : Skilled at organizing complex product and operational information into intuitive, scalable structures for both internal teams and customers. Technical Fluency : Comfortable working across knowledge bases, CMS platforms, documentation tools, AI agents, and analytics dashboards. Able to quickly grasp product functionality and translate it into clear documentation. Includes:: Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and how it connects AI agents to external systems (CRM, billing, ops tools) for real-time data retrieval and action-taking — not just static lookup. Comfort scoping/configuring MCP or data connectors within Intercom, including OAuth-based permission scoping and read-vs-act tradeoffs. Ability to diagnose why a Fin conversation went unresolved. Distinguishing a knowledge gap (needs an article) from a context/action gap (needs a connector or workflow). Analytical judgment : Strong ability to independently query, filter, and interpret support trends, search behavior, and AI performance data directly from dashboards and reporting tools. This role requires skills at turning raw signals into prioritized action and measurable impact. Cross-Functional Influence : Skilled at partnering with Support, Product, Product Marketing, Ops, and Engineering to align on content standards, product updates, and AI optimization strategies. Clarity & Communication : Exceptional written and editorial skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts while maintaining accuracy and authority. Operational Ownership : Strong governance mindset with the ability to maintain standards, manage updates proactively, and build sustainable processes for long-term knowledge health. Course Creation Know-how: Experience designing technical course content and addressing training needs with comprehensive courses Builder Mentality : Energized by creating systems from the ground up, improving workflows, and scaling knowledge in a fast-moving, evolving environment. Bonus points if you have: Experience working with salons, spas, medspas, multi-location service-based businesses, or a strong understanding of the operational complexity of appointment-based industries Background in fast-paced SaaS, B2B technology, or high-growth startup environments Experience building or restructuring a Support Center or internal knowledge system from the ground up Experience creating multimedia learning assets Familiarity with content lifecycle management best practices Experience analyzing support metrics, search queries, or AI deflection metrics to inform strategy How we'll take care of you: At Boulevard, we work hard to structure compensation in a way that balances internal equity with local market competitiveness, and we’re happy to share a good-faith estimate of the base salary range for this role. For U.S. based candidates, the anticipated base salary range is $100,000 - $130,000 per year. In addition to this base compensation, this role may be eligible to participate in a variable compensation program. Final compensation will vary based on a variety of factors, which include but are not limited to applicable experience, location, and final leveling. In addition to the wonderful people you’ll get to work with and challenging projects that’ll push you - Boulevard is here to make sure you’re always at the top of your game emotionally, mentally, and physically. ✨ We’ve got you covered with a 401(k) match plus dental, medical, vision, and life insurance. Take a break whenever you need with our flexible vacation day policy. Fully remote so you can choose where you want to work. You’ll receive a work from home stipend every month. Family planning resources and specialized support programs. Equity: get ahead on the ground floor and grow with Boulevard. Boulevard Bucks Learning and Development program allows employees to explore businesses in the market we serve. We recommend following our official LinkedIn page to stay up to date on all things Boulevard life! Boulevard Labs, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. All employment decisions at Boulevard Labs, Inc. are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.
