items.description: ABOUT US: Digimarc Corporation (NASDAQ: DMRC) is the global leader in product digitization. A pioneer in digital watermarks, Digimarc connects every physical and digital item to a digital twin that enables the capture of product data, records events and interactions, and supports powerful new automations. Trusted to deter counterfeiting of global currency for more than 20 years, Digimarc is also recognized for ensuring product authenticity, improving plastics recycling, and more, with a commitment to promoting a prosperous, safer, and more sustainable world. In 2023, Digimarc was named to the Fortune 2023 Change the World list and honored as a 2023 Fast Company World Changing Ideas finalist. See more at Digimarc.com . ABOUT THE ROLE… The Director of Revenue Operations is a foundational hire for Digimarc's revenue organization. You will own the operations backbone of our go-to-market engine — forecasting, analytics, planning, deal desk, customer success operations, and the systems that power them. This is a builder's role for a player-coach. You will assess what exists, design what should exist, and operate hands-on while building the function around you. You will be the person who turns strategy into cadence, instinct into data, and ambition into a predictable, scalable revenue engine. WHAT YOU WILL DO… The quarterly operating cadence. Design, own, and execute a 13-week operational calendar — the drumbeat of the revenue organization. This includes weekly forecast reviews, recurring pipeline and top-of-funnel reviews, key deal and top deal reviews, renewal forecast reviews on a rolling outlook, product feedback loops with leadership, GTM leadership sessions, and an end-of-quarter deal war room ramping to daily in the final weeks. You prepare the content, run the operating rhythm, and hold the organization accountable to it. Forecasting and pipeline. Run the forecast across new business, expansion, and renewals within that cadence. Establish pipeline hygiene standards, coverage and conversion inspection, and a single source of truth for where the business stands — globally and by segment. End-to-end funnel ownership. Own, diagnose, and optimize the full revenue funnel — from lead generation and marketing through sales, close, onboarding, and expansion — as one connected system rather than a series of handoffs. You bring deep data fluency to every stage: where demand originates, where conversion breaks, where velocity stalls, and where expansion compounds. You don't just report the funnel; you recommend and drive the changes that improve it. Revenue analytics and what works. Own reporting on bookings, ARR, pipeline coverage, conversion, retention, and productivity — and go beyond the scoreboard to the answers: which sources, segments, plays, and motions actually produce revenue, and which don't. Provide the analytical foundation for executive and board-level decision-making. Enabling the outbound motion. Partner with the demand generation leader to enable a true end-to-end outbound and pipeline-build motion, AI-first throughout — AI agents for research, signal detection, and personalization; a modern SDR workflow; and automated outbound that scales pipeline generation without scaling headcount linearly. You don't own outbound, but you deeply understand how it works: you provide the systems, data, process, and measurement that let it run, and you connect its output cleanly into pipeline, forecast, and funnel analytics. GTM planning. Lead annual and quarterly planning: segmentation, territory design, capacity and coverage modeling, and quota setting — in close partnership with Finance. Incentive compensation. Partner with Finance, and HR to design, model, and administer sales and customer success compensation plans that align the field with company strategy. Deal desk and pricing operations. Stand up deal desk discipline: pricing and approval workflows, non-standard deal governance, and clean quote-to-cash handoffs across Sales, Legal, and Finance. Customer success and renewals operations. Build the operating rhythm for the post-sale motion: renewals forecasting, customer health visibility, and expansion pipeline — supporting an end-to-end view of the customer. Enablement. Build the onboarding and enablement foundation for the field: ramp programs, playbooks, and the tooling that makes sellers and CS teams productive faster. GTM systems and data. Own the revenue technology stack (Salesforce/CRM, forecasting, and CS platforms). Rationalize the stack, ensure data integrity, and make the systems serve the field — not the other way around. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YEAR ONE: A full 13-week quarterly operating cadence installed and running — forecast, pipeline, deal reviews, renewals, and end-of-quarter execution — with the leadership team operating to it. A trusted, consistent forecast the CFO can stand behind, with documented methodology and demonstrated accuracy. A unified revenue data model and executive dashboard covering pipeline, bookings, ARR movement, and retention. The annual GTM plan — territories, capacity, quotas, and comp plans — delivered on time in partnership with Finance. An instrumented end-to-end funnel — lead through expansion — with conversion visibility at every stage and a running list of diagnosed, prioritized optimization opportunities. The outbound motion fully instrumented and enabled in partnership with demand generation — systems, data, and measurement in place, with outbound-sourced pipeline visible in the funnel and forecast. Deal desk and approval workflows in place, with measurable improvement in cycle time and pricing discipline. A rationalized, well-governed systems stack with clean data and clear ownership. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR… 8+ years in revenue operations, sales operations, or GTM strategy in enterprise B2B software, including direct support of senior sales leadership. Experience building or substantially rebuilding a revenue operations function — you have been the first or most senior ops hire, or rebuilt from a low baseline. You have run a structured quarterly operating cadence before — weekly forecast calls, pipeline councils, deal reviews, and quarter-end close management — and know how to make it a discipline rather than a meeting series. Deep fluency in ARR-based business models: pipeline math, retention and expansion dynamics, and SaaS unit economics. Genuine data fluency — you can pull, model, and interrogate funnel data yourself, diagnose conversion problems across marketing, sales, and post-sale stages, and turn analysis into specific recommendations. Working fluency in how modern outbound operates — AI SDR agents, signal-based prospecting, sequencing, and workflow automation — sufficient to be a real partner to demand generation and to instrument the motion end to end. Hands-on command of Salesforce and the modern GTM stack — you can configure, administer, and evaluate tools yourself when needed. Strong financial modeling and analytics skills, and comfort partnering with Finance on planning and reporting rhythms; public-company experience is a plus. A player-coach temperament: strategic enough for executive planning discussions, hands-on enough to fix a broken report the same afternoon. Low ego, high ownership. You bring order without bureaucracy and treat the field as your customer. BENEFITS: Comprehensive Benefits Including Medical, Dental, Vision, & Retirement Savings Plan Restricted Stock Units Flexible Paid Time Off & Holidays Life Insurance Tuition Reimbursement Mentorship Opportunities Training & Development Remote work COMPENSATION: $170,000 - $220,000 a year This compensation range takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill set, experience, training, licensure, certifications, geography and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. OUR CULTURE: We are a team of problem-solvers united by our company’s immense potential to help solve complex challenges. We align to the following Digimarc core values: Collaborative – Stronger together We embrace diverse perspectives and harness our collective talent to realize our full potential. Curious – Listen and look forward We think differently and seek out opportunities for growth to exceed our stakeholders’ expectations. Courageous – Innovate with integrity We challenge each other and do the right thing – even when it’s difficult – to deliver wins for our customers. Join our team and work in support of a technology platform that can transform how consumer goods are made, bought, sold, and recycled around the globe. Digimarc is committed to the health and safety of our employees and their families. We are dedicated to diversity, professional development, and the success of our employees. For more information, visit us at www.digimarc.com. Digimarc is seeking diverse applicants. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, gender, age, color, religion, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected factor. We want the best people who share our values. This job posting is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. Principals only. No recruiters please.

items.description: At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. ABOUT THE ROLE We are hiring the next generation of product managers. AI has collapsed the work that used to sit between an idea and a working version of it, and for the first time, PMs can be true builders. The PMs who win in this era do not manage the work. They build the product, every day, with their own hands. A Senior Product Manager owns a meaningful surface of ClickUp and is accountable for whether it gets better. You decide what to build and why, then go build a working version of it. You prototype in Cursor and Claude when an idea is faster shown than written. You live in the data and the customer signal, and the time between spotting a problem and having something people can react to is measured in days, not weeks. The PMs who compound the most impact at this level are the ones who keep finding leverage that did not exist last quarter. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Own the vision, roadmap, and delivery for a defined product surface, balancing near-term wins with longer-horizon investments. Run continuous discovery. Building and using agents to monitor and synthesize that part of your job. Write sharp PRDs and specs that give engineering and design what they need to move fast without ambiguity. Define success metrics before you build, track them after you ship, and iterate when outcomes do not match expectations. Prototype your own ideas using Cursor, Claude Code, and our Prototype Playground. Show the concept before filing the ticket. Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, analytics, and GTM without needing to be managed through the process. Present your roadmap and results clearly to stakeholders and leadership, and update them when direction changes. Spot friction in how the team operates and suggest concrete improvements. QUALIFICATIONS 5 or more years in product management with demonstrated end-to-end ownership of a product area in a B2B SaaS environment. Proven track record of shipping. You have taken features from concept through launch and iterated based on data. Strong prioritization instincts. You know how to say no and can defend it. High customer empathy and the ability to separate what users say from what they actually need. Comfortable with data. You define your own metrics, query dashboards, and make arguments from numbers. Clear written and verbal communicator. Your specs and strategy docs create alignment without requiring a follow-up meeting. Comfortable with ambiguity and a fast pace. You do not wait to be told what to do. Hands-on with AI tools. You already use them and are always looking for new ways to get more out of them. AI PROFICIENCY Generate artifacts that accelerate alignment. Leverage AI to draft PRDs, map user flows, validate product launch readiness, synthesize research and customer feedback, produce competitive analyses, and write release notes. Prototype and iterate with AI coding tools. Build functional prototypes independently of design and engineering using tools like Cursor or Claude Code. QA your own work. Use browser automation tools to test flows, verify edge cases, and confirm what shipped matches what was specced. Stay current and apply it. Familiarity with tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Figma AI, and MCP integrations is expected. Actively experiment and fold new capabilities into your workflow. Equal Opportunity Employer ClickUp is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin. Privacy Notice ClickUp collects and processes personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws. You can find further details by viewing our Global Candidate Privacy Notice. If you are a Philippine Job Applicant, please also see our Philippine Data Privacy Notice for further details. Visa Sponsorship Please note we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for roles outside of engineering and product at this time. Sponsorship for engineering and product roles is not guaranteed, but is instead based on the business needs for that specific role at that time. Please reach out to the recruiter with any questions. Fraud Alert ClickUp Talent Acquisition will only initiate contact via an @ clickup.com email or through our official careers portal on clickup.com . We will never request fees, payments, or sensitive personal information. Please disregard any offers received outside these channels and report them to support@clickup.com. AI Processing Notice ClickUp may use artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies to help review and screen candidates' employment applications against role-related criteria. These tools support, but do not replace, human decision‑making. If you have questions or need an accommodation in the recruitment process, please contact us at AskPeople@ClickUp.com.

items.description: At Counterpart Health (CPH), we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care with our innovative primary care tool, Counterpart Assistant (CA). By supporting Primary Care Physicians (PCPs), we are able to deliver improved outcomes to patients at a lower cost through early diagnosis and longitudinal care management of chronic conditions. We're seeking a Commercial Partnerships & Operations Director to shape and drive key commercial initiatives and strategic partnerships. Reporting to the VP of Commercial Innovations & Partnerships, you'll partner closely with CPH leadership, owning a portfolio of high-impact initiatives and external partnerships. This role is a senior individual contributor who is a highly organized, analytical, and execution-focused operator who can move fluidly between the details of execution and the strategic context, bringing forward recommendations and insights that shape leadership decisions. You'll lead cross-functional programs, keep priorities on track, align stakeholders, manage external relationships, and deliver the insights and materials needed to support strategic decisions and accelerate Counterpart Health's growth and execution capabilities. As a Commercial Partnerships & Operations Director, you will: Lead high-priority commercial initiatives: Own the execution of high priority cross-functional programs by defining project plans, tracking milestones, mitigating risks, resolving dependencies, and ensuring timely delivery of strategic outcomes. Drive cross-functional execution: Lead efforts across Commercial, Product, Engineering, Clinical, Operations, Legal, and external partners to align stakeholders, maintain momentum, and deliver on commitments. Manage strategic partnerships: Own key external partnerships by establishing governance, aligning strategic objectives, driving executive engagement, resolving risks, and ensuring successful execution throughout the partnership lifecycle. Deliver business insights: Develop and lead analytical models, dashboards, and performance trackers to monitor results, generate insights, and inform commercial decision-making. Prepare executive communications: Develop executive-level presentations, reports, and recommendations that frame strategic options, clarify tradeoffs, and guide decisions by leadership and external partners. Strengthen program execution: Translate enterprise commercial priorities into actionable plans with defined owners, timelines, deliverables, and accountability while proactively identifying and resolving execution risks. Enhance operational effectiveness: Design and implement scalable processes, tools, templates, and reporting mechanisms that improve coordination, visibility, and execution across the Commercial Innovations & Partnerships team. Serve as a trusted operator: Serve as a trusted commercial advisor by anticipating enterprise risks, challenging assumptions, recommending solutions, and maintaining alignment across multiple high-stakes initiatives. Success in this Role Looks Like: In the first 90 days: Build a strong understanding of CPH's commercial strategy, products, partnerships, and operating model. Establish relationships across internal teams and external partners. Take ownership of key initiatives and establish greater strategic clarity, accountability, visibility, and execution discipline. In the first 6 months: Independently own a portfolio of commercial initiatives and strategic partnership workstreams. Implement effective project management processes and reporting frameworks.Deliver high-quality analyses and recommendations that influence executive decision-making and drive progress. At the end of your first year: Become a trusted execution partner to the VP of Commercial Innovations & Partnerships and the CPH leadership team. Successfully lead multiple complex initiatives from planning through execution.Strengthen partnership performance, enhance cross-functional execution, and scale the Commercial Innovations & Partnerships function. You should get in touch if: 6–10 years of experience in healthcare consulting, a healthcare technology company, or a similar execution-focused role in a high-growth healthcare organization. Strong preference for candidates with experience in Medicare, Medicare Advantage, value-based care, payer-provider dynamics, healthcare operations, and roles such as business operations, program management, partnerships, or cross-functional execution. Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and competing priorities; experience in a Project Management Office (PMO) or dedicated program management role is a plus. Exceptional organizational and project management skills, with a track record of bringing structure, accountability, and execution to complex initiatives. Experience managing external partner or customer relationships, including coordinating meetings, driving follow-ups, and ensuring successful execution. Strong analytical skills with advanced proficiency in AI tools, Excel, and Google Sheets, including experience building financial models, dashboards, trackers, and other reporting tools. Excellent written and visual communication skills, with the ability to create executive-ready presentations and synthesize complex information into clear, actionable insights. Strong knowledge of Medicare and Medicare Advantage, value-based care, healthcare operations, and payer-provider dynamics. Ability to thrive in fast-paced environments, manage multiple priorities, and adapt to changing business needs while maintaining a high standard of quality. Demonstrated ability to influence and drive results through strong organization, collaboration, communication, and execution rather than formal authority. Benefits Overview : Financial Well-Being : Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions. Physical Well-Being : We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare. Mental Well-Being : We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location. Professional Development : Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews. Additional Perks: Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities Reimbursement for office setup expenses Monthly cell phone & internet stipend Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams Paid parental leave for all new parents And much more! About Counterpart Health: In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions. Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care. With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software. Counterpart Health is a subsidiary of Clover Health. From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility. #LI-Remote Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are an E-Verify company. Final pay is based on several factors including but not limited to internal equity, market data, and the applicant’s education, work experience, certifications, etc. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is: $150,000—$195,000 USD

items.description: 1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing. About 1Password At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work. If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future. We’re looking for a Digital Customer Success Campaign Manager to design, launch, and improve digital customer journeys at scale. You’ll turn customer and product signals into timely, useful programs that help customers move from trial through activation, adoption, and ongoing value. This is a hands-on, program-focused role for someone who enjoys combining thoughtful communication, data, experimentation, and emerging technology. Reporting into the Senior Manager, Digital Customer Success, this role is based remotely in North America, with hiring locations in the United States or Canada. How we’re using AI today Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here. What we're looking for: • Bring experience in Digital Customer Success, Customer Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing, Growth Operations, Customer Success Operations, or Product-led Growth within a Software as a Service (SaaS) environment. • Have owned or significantly contributed to lifecycle or digital customer programs with measurable impact. • Write clear, engaging customer-facing communications and adapt messaging for different audiences and customer needs. • Interpret customer and product usage data, identify patterns, and turn insights into practical campaign and journey improvements. • Work effectively across Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Data, Operations, and Content teams while navigating changing priorities and building new programs from the ground up. Bonus points for: • Experience using artificial intelligence (AI) tools to accelerate campaign development, analysis, experimentation, or content creation. • Experience with 1Password, cybersecurity, or a similar technology product. What you can expect: • Design, launch, and continuously improve digital customer journeys across onboarding, activation, adoption, expansion, and renewal. • Develop targeted campaigns that help customers move from trial to meaningful product adoption and guide them toward the right next step. • Draft, edit, and optimize customer-facing email campaigns, connecting them with education resources and other digital experiences. • Use customer signals, milestones, and behaviors to identify moments of friction or opportunity and create timely interventions. • Monitor campaign performance through metrics such as engagement, activation, product usage, retention, and expansion; use experimentation and cohort analysis to improve results. • Partner with Data and Analytics teams to support dashboards and reporting, then use those insights to make informed recommendations. • Collaborate with Product, Customer Success, Marketing, Operations, and Content partners to keep programs accurate, useful, and aligned with the customer journey. • Use tools such as Gainsight, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, and AI solutions to increase campaign quality, testing speed, and operational efficiency. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building in an evolving environment, can work independently through ambiguity, and is motivated by creating scalable customer experiences that help more people get value from 1Password. USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $96,000 USD and $134,000 USD. This role is also immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs. Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $88,000 CAD and $123,000 CAD. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs. At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set. This posting is for an existing vacancy. Our culture At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone . Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. How we work with AI We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password. This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. Our approach to work We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement. For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average. Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto. What we offer We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: Health and wellbeing Maternity and parental leave top-up programs Competitive health benefits Generous PTO policy Growth and future RSU program for most employees Retirement matching program Free 1Password account Community Paid volunteer days Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly Remote-first work environment *Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting. You belong here. 1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love. Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs. Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you. Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law. 1Password uses artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) technologies, including natural language processing and predictive analytics, to assist in the initial screening of employment applications and improve our recruitment process. See here for the latest third party bias audit information. If you prefer not to have your application assessed using AI/ML features, you may opt out by completing this form . For additional information see our Candidate Privacy Notice .

items.description: About Zscaler Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an AI-forward enterprise , we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world’s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate —we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on customer obsession , collaboration, ownership, and accountability. We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity. Role We are looking for a Business Operations Manager, Customer Success to join our team. This is a Remote role reporting to the Director, Business Operations in the Customer Success organization. This role is critical to supporting the global Technical Success organization, partnering with leaders across Americas, EMEA, and APJ to drive operational rigor, planning discipline, and business performance. This individual contributor will help scale and run the business operations motion for Technical Success by driving core operating rhythms, supporting resource and headcount planning, enabling business reviews, and delivering actionable performance insights. What you’ll do (Role Expectations) Partner with Technical Success leadership to manage and drive the business operations cadence for the organization, ensuring strong execution against priorities and visibility into business performance Support resource management and capacity planning processes to help leaders align coverage, workload, and investments against business needs Drive preparation and coordination for Monthly Business Reviews, Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and Annual Operating Planning (AOP) activities for the Technical Success organization Build, maintain, and enhance KPIs, dashboards, scorecards, and performance reporting that provide leaders with clear, actionable insights Identify and help implement AI and automation use cases that improve reporting, workflows, productivity, and operational scale Who You Are (Success Profile) You thrive in ambiguity and can bring structure, organization, and follow-through to evolving business needs. You are analytical and comfortable working with data to understand performance, spot trends, and support decision-making. You are a strong cross-functional partner who builds trust through responsiveness, clarity, and consistency. You are comfortable moving between strategic context and tactical execution, helping leaders connect long-term goals to day-to-day actions. You are curious about AI, automation, and new technologies, and you look for practical ways to improve how work gets done. items.summary: At Clover Health, we’re focused on improving the health of our members by leveraging technology and data-driven insights to provide personalized, high-quality care. items.description: At Clover Health, we’re focused on improving the health of our members by leveraging technology and data-driven insights to provide personalized, high-quality care. As a Medicare Advantage plan, we aim to empower our members by helping them navigate the complexities of healthcare and live healthier lives. We are passionate about making healthcare easier, more affordable, and more accessible for everyone. We are looking for an AI-forward Business Analyst, Clinical & Reimbursement Policy to serve as the strategic bridge between regulatory requirements and automated execution. In this high-impact role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of Clover’s clinical and reimbursement policies, ensuring they are accurately interpreted, regularly updated, and seamlessly integrated into our claims environment. You will act as a primary Subject Matter Expert (SME), translating complex Medicare guidelines—including National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs)—into actionable logic. You will also play a critical role in vendor management, partnering with external vendors to enhance policy oversight. Your mission is to accelerate Clover's transition toward a high-precision payment ecosystem where monitoring and research are highly automated, ensuring clinical and reimbursement policies are seamlessly and accurately operationalized. As a Business Analyst, Clinical & Reimbursement Policy, you will: Policy Lifecycle & Compliance: Own the accountability for the development and maintenance of clinical and reimbursement policies, ensuring perfect alignment with CMS regulations. Medicare Regulatory SME: Serve as the authority on Medicare guidelines, specifically interpreting and operationalizing NCDs, LCDs, and general national coding guidelines. Strategic Vendor Management: Serve as the primary oversight for external vendor performance regarding policy monitoring and accuracy. Hold partners to world-class standards through data-driven performance reviews and collaborative workflow design. AI-Driven Evolution: Lead the implementation of AI initiatives to automate the monitoring of reimbursement policies. Utilize advanced LLMs (such as Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT) to conduct regular deep research on ongoing industry trends. System Integration: Partner with the Configuration and Data Science teams to ensure that clinical and reimbursement policy intent is perfectly synchronized with technical adjudication. Cross-Functional Influence: Act as the strategic bridge between Clinical, Claims, and Compliance teams to ensure a unified vision of payment excellence. Success in this role looks like: By the end of your initial 90-day period: You will have established a recurring review framework and a comprehensive project plan for Clover's clinical and reimbursement policy library to ensure baseline quality and strict adherence to clinical guidelines. By 6 months: You will have ensured that all existing clinical and reimbursement policies are current and up to date, reflecting the latest regulatory requirements. You will also have implemented an AI-forward oversight framework that utilizes advanced research tools and early-detection monitoring to enhance accuracy within our adjudication systems. You will be actively leveraging AI tools like Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT to perform deep-dive research on industry trends and regulatory updates. Continued success: You will lead the evolution of Clover’s policy management into a proactive strategic powerhouse. By championing automated monitoring and data-driven research, you will ensure Clover’s payment ecosystem achieves market-leading precision and technological sophistication. You should get in touch if: You have 5+ years of experience in healthcare claims, configuration, or reimbursement policy, with a heavy emphasis on Medicare Advantage. You are extremely AI-forward and are passionate about how emerging technologies and LLMs (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, etc.) can be applied to drive operational precision in research and monitoring. You are a Medicare expert with a proven track record of interpreting and operationalizing complex clinical policies, NCDs, and LCDs. You have experience managing vendor relationships at a strategic level, ensuring external partners meet rigorous performance standards. Preferred qualifications include coding certifications such as CPC, CCS, COC, or CIC. You are a data-focused professional who builds strategy based on dashboards and trend analysis. You are familiar with enterprise claims engines and understand how these systems interact to drive adjudication accuracy. Benefits Overview: Financial Well-Being : Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions. Physical Well-Being : We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare. Mental Well-Being : We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location. Professional Development : Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews. Additional Perks: Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities Reimbursement for office setup expenses Monthly cell phone & internet stipend Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams Paid parental leave for all new parents And much more! About Clover: We are reinventing health insurance by combining the power of data with human empathy to keep our members healthier. We believe the healthcare system is broken, so we've created custom software and analytics to empower our clinical staff to intervene and provide personalized care to the people who need it most. We always put our members first, and our success as a team is measured by the quality of life of the people we serve. Those who work at Clover are passionate and mission-driven individuals with diverse areas of expertise, working together to solve the most complicated problem in the world: healthcare. From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility. #LI-REMOTE Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are an E-Verify company. Final pay is based on several factors including but not limited to internal equity, market data, and the applicant’s education, work experience, certifications, etc. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is: $107,000—$130,000 USD

items.title: Chief Financial Officer
items.summary: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!
items.description: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process! About the role The CFO’s mission is to continue building upon Grüns ' already strong finance and data function — evolving it into a best-in-class engine that empowers the entire organization to make faster, smarter decisions. Leading a team of three strong leaders, this role is about leading the strong teams below them to democratize financial intelligence across the Grüns organization: self-serve dashboards, on-demand reporting, and real-time visibility that puts decision-making power in the hands of every team member. The CFO is a relentless, collaborative business partner, never satisfied with where the business is on revenue scale or profitability, always pushing for the next point of EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and driving efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. They will ensure Grüns scales with confidence while meeting all external requirements seamlessly in the background. This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL. What success looks like: If we look ahead a year from now, the right person in this role would have: Leveraged what we’ve built so far, found areas for improvement, and fully operationalized a goal accountability framework that keeps business initiatives tied to financial outcomes, ensuring the leadership team is consistently tracking toward revenue and profitability targets. Driven meaningful EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and improved LTV:CAC efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. Delivered self-serve dashboards, templatized reporting, and real-time P&L visibility across functions so every team has the data access they need without relying on ad-hoc requests. Business decisions are democratized and exponentially quicker. Created the conditions for a high-performing, motivated team empowering vs. micromanaging, actively developing leaders, and driving strong results and performance without burnout. Built the systems and processes to meet all external reporting and compliance requirements seamlessly, keeping the team focused on growth. We're looking for someone with: Relentless Growth Mindset: Always asking what it takes to get to the next level, whether that's another point of margin, better efficiency, or a faster path to revenue growth - a genuine internal drive to make the business the best it can be. Finding new opportunities across the business and proposing these opportunities to the CEO and functional leads. Integrity and Business-First Thinking: Prioritizes the truth over “looking good”. Navigates competing stakeholder interests honestly and thoroughly rather than taking the path of least resistance. Empowering Leadership: Leads by giving people the tools, clarity, and confidence to make great decisions vs. controlling the work directly. Actively develops their functional leaders, makes their team better than they were before. Drives sustainable high performance. Paper Wall Pusher: Treats perceived constraints as hypotheses, not facts. When told something takes six weeks or "this is how it's done," they ask why and push for faster, smarter, or different. Actively hunts for process bloat and inherited ways of working to find improvements. AI-Native Operator: Uses AI natively in their own workflow and actively builds AI fluency into the team's operating model. Sees AI as a core lever for scaling the function's impact without scaling headcount. Direct, but kind: Direct and honest in every conversation, saying what needs to be said, even when it's uncomfortable. Deeply committed to the business and the people in it. Experience: 10+ years leadership experience in a high-growth, profitable businesses; some level of physical inventory experience (CPG, retail, e-commerce, or similar) is a must Experience leading the functions in scope - finance, accounting, data, and BizOps functions Experience within a high-growth company that is adapting to public company practices Compensation & Benefits: At Grüns , we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary is $350,000 + incentive compensation, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team. A bit about us... At Grüns , we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you. Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all. So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious. What we care about... Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation. Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners. Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most. Compensation & Perks: For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth. Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns subscriptions, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about! items.title: PnP Pipeline On-call Support Engineer
items.summary: Role SummaryYour primary mission is to ensure the consistent health and stability of our PnP (Power and Performance) pipelines.
items.description: Role Summary Your primary mission is to ensure the consistent health and stability of our PnP (Power and Performance) pipelines. You will serve as the first line of defense, monitoring pipelines and performing initial triaging to reduce manual overhead for our engineering teams. This role is critical to maintaining the velocity of our post-silicon PnP work as we scale. Core Responsibilities Pipeline Monitoring: Conduct regular, proactive health checks on functional and PnP-enabled flows. Ensure data integrity by verifying that test results are populating correctly on the RLS PnP dashboard. Initial Triage: Investigate pipeline failures and categorize them to streamline resolution: Infrastructure/Deployment Issues: CI pools, hargow issues, or platform environments (e.g., Artemis/Coleman HW/FW mismatches). UTF / PnP Analyzer Issues: Troubleshoot problems within the Unified Test Framework (UTF) or artifact deployment. Mature Pipeline Issues: Address issues specific to pipeline logic for stable flows that are no longer under active development. Resolution & Escalation: Perform bug fixes for straightforward issues (e.g., patching deployment or execution changes). For infrastructure issues, post to the appropriate internal channels for escalation and follow-up. Escalate complex or systemic issues to pipeline owners by providing necessary logs and context. Collaborate with pipeline owners and XFN (Cross-Functional) DRIs to ensure proper placement of PnP trace tags and alignment of measurement windows. Qualifications & Technical Requirements Core Requirements: Proven experience in monitoring alerts and dashboards. Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify patterns in failure logs and suggest improvements. Ability to differentiate between infrastructure, firmware, and analyzer-specific errors. Preferred Qualifications: Familiarity with jest-e2e and the Unified Test Framework (UTF). Experience working within internal infrastructure (e.g., buck, sandcastle, phabricator, internal AI tooling). Ability to read and interpret CI pipeline logs effectively. Ability to leverage AI tooling effectively (claude code, Metamate, etc.) Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Sr. Clinical Operations Manager
items.summary: About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life.
items.description: About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide. Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at . The Opportunity 🚀 This role serves as the operational backbone of the Global Clinical Operations (GCO) team, developing a deep understanding of GCO's day-to-day workings in order to help operationalize its running. You'll coordinate new projects, identify the right stakeholders, and partner closely with the GCO team, including GCO clinical leadership, to keep programs running smoothly. This is a hands-on operations role where success is measured by reliable execution, clean reporting, and strong cross-functional coordination. You'll be the connective tissue between GCO sub-teams and partners across product, commercial, GTM, and customer success, giving you visibility into how clinical operations decisions ripple across the business. What You’ll Own 💼 In this role, you will: Serve as the operations point person across GCO sub-teams, keeping frameworks, timelines, and ways of working consistent. Coordinate the GCO components of new projects end-to-end: identify stakeholders, track deliverables, and keep work moving across global clinical operations, product, and other partner teams. Track spend against program budgets, flagging variances to leadership. Spot and help close gaps or silos between GCO sub-teams by maintaining regular alignment touchpoints. Build and maintain dashboards and reporting infrastructure that give leadership real-time visibility into program status, trends, and open decisions. Pull together monthly operational updates, synthesizing data from Jira, Zendesk, Airtable, Salesforce, BI tools, and other program analytics into clear, actionable summaries. Help connect operational metrics to clinical and business outcomes so leadership has a clear line of sight from day-to-day activity to impact. Serve as a connector between GCO and commercial, GTM, and customer success teams, ensuring the right subject-matter expert is looped into RFPs, RFIs, and retention/expansion conversations. Ensure feedback from client-facing teams is incorporated into GCO program planning and prioritization. Identify opportunities to use AI tools, automation, and workflow improvements to save the team time and reduce manual work. Support team members in getting up to speed on new tools and best practices as they're introduced. What Success Looks Like 📈 In your first 12–18 months, you will have: Created and rolled out dashboards and reporting infrastructure that are adopted by GCO leadership.Improved operational efficiency across GCO, including reduced redundant meetings and streamlined recurring processes.Established a strong working rhythm with key GCO leadership and cross-functional partners. Successfully managed multiple projects concurrently, hitting key milestones and deadlines, with consistent reporting/status updates so stakeholders always know where each project stands. About You ✨ You likely have: A Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business, public health, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience in clinical/healthcare operations. Demonstrated, hands-on experience in scheduling, budgets, and cross-functional coordination within clinical operations. Strong program and process-design skills, shown through a program management certification or 2+ years of project management experience, including building/maintaining SOPs, governance documentation, and decision-informing reporting. High comfort level with modern productivity and data tools (Google Workspace, Slack, Jira, Salesforce, Airtable, BI dashboards) and the ability to quickly learn new systems, including AI-enabled tools. A demonstrated ability to operate across multiple fast-moving workstreams simultaneously without losing track of details. Strong documentation skills, with the ability to create and maintain clear, reusable, well-organized documentation. Extreme organization, with the ability to manage and maintain large databases and datasets accurately. The ability to establish a process and cadence for audits, ensuring data and documentation stay accurate and current over time. Nice to Have ⭐ While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring: Experience in reproductive and/or hormonal health (fertility, pregnancy, menopause, low testosterone, gender-affirming care) and related coverage/benefit policies. A track record of using data to drive decisions — defining KPIs, building dashboards, running monthly/quarterly operational reviews. Comfortable operating in high-growth, ambiguous environments with a bias toward scalable systems and automation. Why This Role Matters 🧡 This role sits at the center of Carrot's Global Clinical Operations function, translating day-to-day execution into the reporting and coordination that leadership relies on to make decisions. By keeping GCO's sub-teams aligned and connecting clinical operations to commercial and customer-facing teams, this person directly shapes how reliably Carrot delivers on its clinical programs — and how clearly that impact gets communicated across the business. Why Candidates Join Carrot 🌍 Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission. Highlights include: A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally. A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact. Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits. Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge. Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits. A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture. The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide. Compensation 💰 Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from$128,000.00 - $150,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from the posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: A Note on AI At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other.
